paper.title: Streaming Communication in Multi-Agent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Abstract: Multi-agent reasoning systems adopt a "generate-then-transfer" paradigm that forces end-to-end latency to scale linearly with pipeline depth. We introduce StreamMA, a multi-agent reasoning system that streams each reasoning step to downstream agents as soon as it is generated, pipelining adjacent agents and thus reducing latency. Surprisingly, this pipelining also improves effectiveness: because multi-step reasoning quality is non-uniform and early steps are more reliable than later ones, working with these reliable early steps instead of the full chain prevents error-prone late steps from misleading downstream agents. We formalize both advantages with the first closed-form joint analysis of stream, serial, and single protocols, deriving the effectiveness ordering, speedup upper bound, and cost ratio. Across eight reasoning benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4), and three topologies (Chain, Tree, Graph), StreamMA outperforms both baselines (avg. +7.3 pp, max +22.4 pp on HMMT 2026; Claude Opus 4.6-high). Beyond these contributions, we discover a "step-level scaling law": increasing per-agent steps consistently improves both effectiveness and efficiency, a new scaling dimension orthogonal to and composable with agent-count scaling.

summary.oneLiner: 提出StreamMA：以推理步为粒度的流式多智能体通信，在降低端到端延迟的同时，利用早期可靠步骤规避后期错误，在8项推理基准上显著优于串行与单智能体基线。
summary.motivation: 现有多智能体推理普遍采用“生成后传递”的串行协议，下游智能体必须等待上游完整响应，导致端到端延迟随流水线深度线性增长；同时，多步推理质量呈位置依赖——早期步骤更可靠、后期易退化，强制下游消费完整链条会把错误尾部一并传递。
summary.method: 提出Stream协议与StreamMA系统：将智能体间传输单元从完整响应改为推理步，每生成一步即转发给下游，实现相邻智能体流水线并行；在任意DAG拓扑上执行。理论上给出Stream、Serial、Single三种协议的首个闭式联合分析：定理1给出有效性排序（当头强尾弱时Stream最优），定理2给出加速上界，定理3给出精确成本比。机制上，下游在可靠前缀上先形成独立推理轨迹，从而稀释后期错误步的影响。
summary.experimentSetup: 在8项基准（AIME 2025/2026、HMMT 2026、GPQA-Diamond、HLE、LiveCodeBench生成/执行/测试输出）上评估；骨干模型为Claude Opus 4.6-High、GPT-5.4-None、GLM-5.2-None；拓扑为Chain/Tree/Graph（通常4个智能体A–D）；对比Single、Serial与StreamMA；除Stream特有的END_STEP边界与根智能体求解提示外，其余提示与解码/运行设置与Serial一致；多数配置每格3次独立运行，AIME与HMMT因样本小增至8次；另含GPQA-D案例研究、S=4步级扰动实验（100次/掩码）、五种角色协议泛化，以及A∈{8,16,32,64}与S扩展的步级缩放实验。
results: Claude Opus 4.6：StreamMA相对Serial平均+7.3 pp，相对Single平均+16.3 pp；Chain/Tree/Graph平均准确率分别为81.70%/82.81%/83.34%，对应Serial 73.48%/79.43%/72.92%
HMMT 2026峰值：Claude Chain拓扑Stream 85.61% vs Serial 63.26%，提升+22.35 pp（摘要记+22.4 pp）
GPT-5.4：相对Serial平均+1.5 pp，相对Single平均+4.9 pp；三拓扑平均72.25%/71.70%/72.79% vs Serial 70.16%/70.51%/71.23%
GLM-5.2：三拓扑Stream平均72.38%/73.40%/72.57%，均高于对应Serial
步级扰动（Agent1→Agent2，S=4）：仅尾部扰动时Stream相对Serial最高+24.0 pp；仅头部扰动时Stream可落后至−36.0 pp
角色泛化（HMMT 2026）：如GLM-5.2在Adversarial Verify上59.85% vs Serial 50.00%；GPT-5.4在Decompose & Merge上56.82% vs 50.38%
步级缩放（HMMT 2026，GPT-5.4-None）：仅增智能体数A从2到64，准确率58.3%→68.2%；再增每智能体步数S至64达73.5%（较A=64再+5.3 pp），墙钟加速26.9×，达定理2上界的83%
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露。该工作为推理/通信协议与多智能体编排研究，未训练新模型；Claude Opus 4.6与GPT-5.4经商业API调用，GLM-5.2亦作评估骨干，但未报告预训练或微调所用GPU时数、参数量或训练预算。
limitations: 有效性依赖步级质量的头部—尾部不对称：早期步骤可靠、后期退化时Stream占优；头部被污染时Serial可接近100%而Stream落后约35 pp
Stream增益与Serial基线强度负相关：Serial已很强（步级错误少）时提升缩小；接近天花板任务（如GPT-5.4 LCB-T约99%）变化常<0.6 pp
方法假设推理可按END_STEP切分为离散步，并依赖下游Reviewer-Corrector式提示；对任意任务/提示格式的普适性未充分验证
步级扰动实验揭示中间步可被注入 subtle errors 误导下游，存在对抗性篡改风险
成本/加速分析基于KV-cache命中、prefill/decode/cache读速度等Serving假设，真实部署中因缓存率与拓扑而异
summary.significance: 将多智能体通信粒度从“整段响应”细化到“推理步”，同时成为推理增强器与推理加速器；首次闭式刻画Stream/Serial/Single的有效性与效率权衡，并发现与智能体数量正交的“步级缩放律”——固定A时增大S可同时提升准确率与加速，可与agent-count scaling组合，为低延迟高可靠多智能体推理提供新设计轴。

paper.title: Latent Collaboration in Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) extend large language models (LLMs) from independent single-model reasoning to coordinative system-level intelligence. While existing LLM agents depend on text-based mediation for reasoning and communication, we take a step forward by enabling models to collaborate directly within the continuous latent space. We introduce LatentMAS, an end-to-end training-free framework that enables pure latent collaboration among LLM agents. In LatentMAS, each agent first performs auto-regressive latent thoughts generation through last-layer hidden embeddings instead of text. Then, a shared latent working memory preserves and transfers each agent's internal representations and latent thoughts, ensuring lossless information exchange without re-encoding. We provide detailed theoretical analyses showing that LatentMAS achieves higher expressiveness and lossless information preservation with lower overall complexity than standard text-based MAS. In addition, empirical evaluations across 9 comprehensive benchmarks spanning math and science reasoning, commonsense understanding, and code generation show that LatentMAS outperforms advanced single agents and text-based MAS baselines, achieving up to 14.6% higher accuracy, reducing output token usage by 70.8%-83.7%, and providing 4$\times$-4.3$\times$ faster end-to-end inference. Code and data are fully open-sourced at https://github.com/Gen-Verse/LatentMAS.

explanation: abstract keywords agent, memory, multi-agent, reasoning (+4)

summary.oneLiner: LatentMAS 是一种无需训练的端到端多智能体框架，使 LLM 智能体在连续隐空间而非文本中完成推理与协作，在 9 项基准上同时提升准确率并显著降低 token 与推理时延。
summary.motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）普遍以自然语言作为智能体间推理与通信媒介，信息需经离散 token 编解码，表达受限且易产生信息损失；同时文本化链式推理会生成极长输出，带来高昂推理开销。论文追问：能否实现纯隐空间协作，即在连续表示中完成内部 latent 推理，并以无损方式在智能体间传递信息。
summary.method: 提出 LatentMAS：完全 training-free。每个智能体以最后一层 hidden embedding 自回归生成 latent thoughts，而非解码文本 token；跨智能体通过共享 latent working memory（逐层 KV cache）保存并传递输入上下文与新生成的 latent 表示，避免重编码以实现无损信息交换。框架基于三项原则：隐推理表达力更强、隐通信保真、协作复杂度低于文本 MAS；并提供基于线性表示假设的信息论复杂度分析，以及 KV cache 等价性证明（Theorem 3.3）。支持 Sequential 与 Hierarchical MAS（如 math/science/code/summarizer 分工），最终智能体才进行少量文本解码输出答案。
summary.experimentSetup: 在 9 个基准上评估：数学/科学推理（GSM8K、AIME24/25、GPQA-Diamond、MedQA）、常识（ARC-Easy/Challenge）、代码（MBPP-Plus、HumanEval-Plus）。对比 Single、TextMAS 与 LatentMAS，覆盖 Sequential 与 Hierarchical 两种 MAS 设置；骨干模型含 Qwen3 与 Llama3 共 5 个规模。实现基于 Python、PyTorch、HuggingFace Transformers，TextMAS 可选 vLLM 加速；非代码任务按归一化答案匹配计准确率，代码任务在 10 秒沙箱内执行单元测试。MedQA 语义分析实验中 LatentMAS 使用 40 个 latent steps，TextMAS max-token 为 4096。
results: 相对 Single 与 TextMAS，LatentMAS 在 9 项基准上 consistently 提升系统级推理准确率，摘要报告最高 +14.6%，Figure 1 在 Hierarchical 设置下平均 +13.3% 准确率。
输出 token 相对 TextMAS 减少 70.8%–83.7%（摘要）；相对 TextMAS 更广范围为 59.4%–87.9%，Figure 1 平均减少 83.7%；相对 Single 减少 15.0%–60.3%。
端到端推理加速：摘要报告 4×–4.3×；Figure 1 Hierarchical 平均 4.3×（单任务 3.1×–7.0×）；即使 TextMAS 使用 vLLM 优化，仍快 2.6×–7×。
Qwen3-14B Hierarchical 上 AIME24 准确率 73.3%（TextMAS 70.0%，Single 63.3%）；AIME25 66.7%；GPQA-Diamond 53.0%；token 与 speed 均显著优于 TextMAS（如 GPQA token 3606 vs 20931，↓82.8%）。
LatentMAS 通常 <50 个 latent steps 即可在 AIME24/25 等任务达到或超过 TextMAS 性能，而 TextMAS 常需 >20K 输出 token 完成文本 CoT。
最终 answering agent 的解码 token 平均比 TextMAS 少 29.1%（Table 5）。
Llama3 骨干上趋势一致：如 Llama-3.1-8B Sequential ARC-E 准确率 91.2%（TextMAS 89.6%），token ↓88.5%，speed ×5.2。
summary.trainingResources: 完全 training-free，无需额外微调或训练多智能体模型；论文未披露训练算力（因无训练阶段）。推理实现使用 PyTorch/HuggingFace Transformers，可选 vLLM 做 TextMAS 基线加速；论文未披露推理所用 GPU 数量、型号或总 GPU-hours。
limitations: 跨智能体传递 latent 表示需 input-output alignment（对齐矩阵 W_a），异构或跨族模型协作可能受限。
理论分析依赖 Linear Representation Hypothesis，实际语义保真度在该假设不成立时无保证。
隐空间推理与通信不可直接人类可读，调试与错误追踪难度高于文本 MAS（论文专设调试附录）。
Hierarchical 设置下部分任务增益有限甚至略降（如 Llama-3.2-3B Hierarchical MedQA 50.0% vs TextMAS 50.3%）。
评估主要在同一模型族多实例协作下进行，对跨厂商/跨架构异构多模型的普适性证据有限。
summary.significance: LatentMAS 将 MAS 从“文本中介协作”推进到“纯隐空间协作”，在理论上论证 latent 推理的信息表达优势、KV cache 传递的无损性与更低协作复杂度，并在数学、科学、常识与代码任务上实证同时提升准确率与推理效率，为 Agentic AI 的可扩展多智能体协调提供一种低开销、高保真的新范式；代码与数据已开源。

paper.title: Where Reasoning Diverges: Localized Multi-Agent Debate
paper.abstract: Abstract: Multi-agent debate commonly exchanges complete reasoning traces even when disagreements concern only a few intermediate claims. We introduce Localized Multi-Agent Debate (LMAD), an inference-time protocol that represents agent traces as typed nodes, locates their earliest conflict, and restricts debate to the corresponding local segments. Guarded resolution extends a shared committed state so that later conflicts can be addressed without reopening accepted steps. We evaluate a single fixed LMAD configuration on four multi-hop question-answering benchmarks using ten backbones from four model families. Our method achieves the highest macro-averaged judge accuracy across all ten backbones, outperforming the strongest conventional baseline by up to 7.20 percentage points.

summary.oneLiner: LMAD将多智能体辩论从整段推理交换改为定位最早冲突并仅辩论局部片段，配合受保护提交机制，在四个多跳QA基准与十个骨干模型上取得最高宏平均判官准确率。
summary.motivation: 现有多智能体辩论（MAD）通常以完整答案或整段推理轨迹作为共享状态：答案级投票无法揭示分歧起点，而全轨迹辩论会重开智能体已达成一致的中间步骤。在多跳问答中，早期事实可能一致，但后续某一跳实体或关系选择不同会使分歧沿轨迹传播并导致不同答案，因此协调单元应是“最早冲突步骤”及其局部推理，而非整条轨迹。
summary.method: 提出推理时协议LMAD：K个同质智能体（同骨干、不同采样温度）在共享已提交状态P上并行生成自由形式解；零温度抽取器E将解映射为有序typed节点链Z_i并保留原答案；若答案不一致，定位器L扫描各链返回最早跨智能体语义冲突δ及每智能体见证索引t_i，仅对前缀段S_i=Z_i[1:t_i]进行局部辩论；解析器提出替换节点修复b_Z，提交守卫G要求修复被上下文逐字引用支持且关系与证据一致，通过后P←P∥b_Z且已提交节点不再重开；否则保持P并从当前答案选最终结果；答案一致、提交失败或达最大迭代（参考配置：每轮1次局部辩论、最多10轮）时停止；另设答案类型粒度守卫限制答案扩展。
summary.experimentSetup: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue、StrategyQA四个多跳QA基准上，用Qwen2.5（7B/14B/32B）、Qwen3（8B/14B/32B）、Qwen3.5（4B/9B）、Gemma3（4B/12B）共10个开源骨干、单一固定LMAD配置，与CoT、三样本自洽（SC）、迭代Consensus、标准MAD、dMAD对比；多智能体方法均为同质智能体、温度(0.1,0.5,0.9)，辅助模块（节点抽取、冲突定位、解析）均用同骨干且temperature=0；vLLM运行于4×NVIDIA A100 80GB；预测以Qwen2.5-32B判官评估准确率（%）。
results: 十个骨干在四基准上的宏平均判官准确率均为最高；相对每行最强常规基线最高提升+7.20个百分点（Qwen2.5-7B×MuSiQue：LMAD 55.00% vs 最强基线Consensus 47.80%）
40个骨干–数据集组合中：36项优于最强基线、1项持平、3项落后；骨干级宏平均提升范围1.30–6.50个百分点，平均+2.94个百分点

代表性结果（Qwen2.5-32B判官，%）：Qwen2.5-7B在HotpotQA 67.20（+4.20）、2Wiki 76.00（+3.20）、MuSiQue 55.00（+7.20）、StrategyQA 94.00（+3.20）；Qwen3-8B在MuSiQue 63.40（+4.40）；Qwen3.5-4B在HotpotQA 79.33（+6.66）、MuSiQue 76.00（+6.67）；Gemma3-12B在StrategyQA 97.00（+1.20）；少数落后例：Gemma3-4B在2Wiki 64.20 vs 基线68.00（−3.80）、Qwen2.5-14B在HotpotQA 71.20 vs SC 71.40（−0.20）
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露任何模型训练或微调；LMAD为纯推理时协议，无参数更新。实验硬件：4×NVIDIA A100 80GB，vLLM推理；每骨干复用同一模型承担求解与全部辅助模块（节点抽取、定位、解析）。
limitations: 推理表示为有序中间状态链，难以覆盖真实世界中分支假设、证据汇聚等非线性/图结构推理
提交守卫仅保证协议内被上下文逐字引用支持与关系一致性，‘已提交’不等于相对标注真值已验证
依赖节点抽取、冲突定位等辅助模块质量；定位器不估计下游答案相关性，索引不对齐时辩论段选择需依赖见证索引机制
参考配置固定为每迭代1轮局部辩论、最多10迭代；论文未系统报告延迟、token成本及相对全轨迹MAD的开销对比
summary.significance: 将多智能体辩论重新表述为“冲突局部化的状态修复”问题，以最早分歧为辩论单元并配合受保护共享状态，避免重开已一致步骤；在四个模型族、十种规模与四类多跳推理任务上展示稳定迁移性，表明‘定位分歧’是可独立于角色设计、通信拓扑或置信度机制的有效MAD设计维度，并为未来扩展到树/ DAG 等非链式推理表示提供方向。

paper.title: HapticVLA: Contact-Rich Manipulation via Vision-Language-Action Model without Inference-Time Tactile Sensing
paper.abstract: Abstract: Tactile sensing is a crucial capability for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures, as it enables dexterous and safe manipulation in contact-rich tasks. However, reliance on dedicated tactile hardware increases cost and reduces reproducibility across robotic platforms. We argue that tactile-aware manipulation can be learned offline and deployed without direct haptic feedback at inference. To this end, we present HapticVLA, which proceeds in two tightly coupled stages: Safety-Aware Reward-Weighted Flow Matching (SA-RWFM) and Tactile Distillation (TD). SA-RWFM trains a flow-matching action expert that incorporates precomputed, safety-aware tactile rewards penalizing excessive grasping force and suboptimal grasping trajectories. TD further transfers this tactile-aware capability into a conventional VLA: we distill a compact tactile token from the SA-RWFM teacher and train a student VLA to predict that token from vision and state modalities, enabling tactile-aware action generation at inference without requiring on-board tactile sensors. This design preserves contact-rich tactile-aware reasoning within VLA while removing the need for on-board tactile sensors during deployment. On real-world experiments, HapticVLA achieves a mean success rate of 86.7%, consistently outperforming baseline VLAs - including versions provided with direct tactile feedback during inference.

explanation: title keywords action model, manipulation, vision language action, vision-language-action (+12)
abstract keywords manipulation, vision language action, vision-language-action, vla (+4)

summary.oneLiner: HapticVLA 通过安全感知奖励加权流匹配（SA-RWFM）与触觉蒸馏（TD），在推理阶段无需 onboard 触觉传感器即可实现接触丰富、力感知的 VLA 操控，真实任务平均成功率 86.7%。
summary.motivation: 现有 VLA 主要依赖视觉与本体感知，难以感知物体硬度与接触力，在抓取软/易碎物体时安全性与精度不足；而多数触觉增强 VLA 在推理时仍依赖昂贵的视觉-力/触觉传感器，成本高、跨平台复现性差。论文主张：触觉感知能力可在离线阶段从带触觉的数据中学习，并在部署时无需实时触觉反馈即可保留。
summary.method: 三阶段流水线：（1）离线触觉奖励计算——基于机械臂状态与触觉反馈为每条轨迹预计算安全感知奖励，惩罚对易碎物体过大的抓取力与次优抓取轨迹；（2）SA-RWFM——在 SmolVLA 上微调流匹配动作专家，将预计算触觉奖励纳入 Reward-Weighted Flow Matching，使策略在训练时利用真实触觉信号学习安全接触操控；（3）触觉蒸馏（TD）——以 SA-RWFM 教师蒸馏紧凑触觉 token，训练学生 VLA 仅由视觉与状态预测该 token，推理时将预测 token 注入 VLA 生成动作，从而无需 onboard 触觉传感器。
summary.experimentSetup: 真实机器人接触丰富操控评估：三个任务（Jar、Waffles、Egg 抓取放置），每任务 20 次独立试验；使用自采 in-house 数据集，对所有基线（SmolVLA、SmolVLA+SA-RWFM、X-VLA、VLA-0）与 HapticVLA 进行相同微调；训练阶段使用 Kajimoto 等提供的指尖触觉传感器采集数据，最终 HapticVLA 推理不依赖触觉传感器；另对比同步/异步推理及是否启用 TD 的消融。
results: HapticVLA（SA-RWFM+TD，同步推理）三任务平均成功率 86.7%（Jar 15/20、Waffles 18/20、Egg 19/20），一致优于所有基线，包括推理时直接使用触觉反馈的配置
相较基础 SmolVLA，Egg 任务绝对成功率提升 45%；仅 SA-RWFM、无 TD 时平均 75%（Jar 11/20、Waffles 17/20、Egg 17/20）
X-VLA 与 VLA-0 在三任务上成功率均为 0%，未能泛化到高精度接触丰富场景
消融：无 TD 且需推理时触觉——同步 75%、异步 81.7%；有 TD 但异步 80%；完整 HapticVLA 同步 86.7% 为最高
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露 GPU 数量、训练时长、算力规模等计算资源。已披露：基座模型 SmolVLA；训练/数据采集使用外部提供的指尖触觉传感器与自采 in-house 数据集；代码、模型、数据集及数字孪生环境已公开于项目网站；研究由 RSF 24-41-02039 资助。
limitations: 推理阶段虽无需触觉传感器，但训练与奖励计算仍依赖带触觉的数据采集与预计算奖励，无法完全摆脱触觉硬件与标注流程
评估仅覆盖三个真实抓取放置任务，任务类型与场景泛化范围有限
异步分块推理因触觉观测与控制动作时序错位、有效延迟增大而显著降性能（如 TD+async 80% vs 同步 86.7%）
对预定义安全感知触觉奖励的质量与任务适配性敏感，奖励设计不当可能限制策略上限
全文未给出大规模仿真或跨机器人平台系统性验证
summary.significance: 提出首个可在推理时完全移除 onboard 触觉/力传感器的触觉感知 VLA 框架，通过“训练用触觉、部署用蒸馏 token”降低硬件成本并提升跨平台可复现性；在易碎物体操控上显著优于视觉-only 及更大基线，且实证上可超过推理时仍接入触觉反馈的 VLA，为接触丰富操控的低成本部署提供可复现路径。

paper.title: ReTouch: Empowering Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation with Online-Refined Tactile Prediction
paper.abstract: Abstract: Fusing tactile signals has proven effective for contact-rich manipulation, enabling robots to perceive contact states and adapt to rapidly changing physical interactions. Yet effectively integrating tactile feedback into dexterous manipulation remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce ReTouch, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that supports contact-rich dexterous manipulation through tactile predictions continually refined online using execution-time feedback. ReTouch builds on two main innovations for tactile representation and closed-loop action generation. First, its Tactile-Patch Encoder represents tactile observations as structured tactile patch features that preserve finger identity and local contact structure, providing contact cues for fine-grained dexterous control. Second, its high-frequency action module jointly predicts future tactile states and action chunks and refines both using incoming tactile feedback during execution. This closed-loop refinement keeps tactile predictions aligned with evolving physical interactions, enabling responsive action correction and improving robustness to contact changes and execution errors. We further introduce XHT-Dataset, comprising 900 real-world demonstrations across seven contact-rich tasks collected on an XHand--UR7e platform, and evaluate ReTouch through closed-loop real-robot experiments. ReTouch surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.4 and 23.8 percentage points in average success rate under standard and challenging conditions, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.

explanation: abstract keywords action model, manipulation, vision language action, vision-language-action, vla (+5)

summary.oneLiner: ReTouch 是一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过触觉补丁编码与执行期在线递归精炼未来触觉预测，实现接触丰富场景下的灵巧手闭环操控。
summary.motivation: 多指灵巧操控需要持续感知局部手-物接触（哪根手指接触、是否滑移、多指接触是否稳定），但纯视觉难以可靠揭示接触位置、力与抓取稳定性，且手-物遮挡会进一步掩盖接触区域。现有触觉策略常将密集触觉观测压平为通用 token 或压缩单指时序力历史，丢失指别与局部接触空间结构，难以将局部接触变化映射到细粒度指端调整；同时，动作块开始时预测的未来触觉状态会因滑移、接触位移与执行误差在块内迅速过时，而多数方法不在执行过程中用最新触觉反馈持续更新这些预测，导致预测-反应闭环不完整。
summary.method: ReTouch 基于预训练 π0 初始化，输入包括 3 路 224×224 RGB 视角、语言指令、18 维本体状态（UR7e 6 关节 + XHand 12 关节）及 10 帧触觉历史（每帧 5 指 × 120 taxel × 3 轴力，τ∈R^{5×120×3}），输出 18 维绝对关节位置命令。核心组件包括：（1）Tactile-Patch Encoder：将原始触觉组织为保留指别与局部接触结构的触觉 patch 特征（拇指 T30、其余四指 T16 固定 taxel-to-patch 映射），经接触加权统计、时空聚合与预训练（接触/分布/力三头平衡目标，20k updates，batch 32）得到结构化 token；（2）Hindsight Action Expert（HAE，18 层 Transformer，hidden 1024，8 heads）在训练时用真实未来触觉 patch 生成动作相关目标 latent；（3）Foresight Action Expert（FAE，同架构）预测未来触觉 latent 并与 HAE 在第 12 层对齐（cosine 距离权重 0.1），作为高频动作模块与 VLM 异步运行。执行时预测 16 步动作块，并在 offset {4,8,12} 处用最新触觉反馈递归精炼未来触觉 latent 与剩余动作后缀（blocking refinement：等待更新完成再执行新后缀），形成预测-反应联合闭环。
summary.experimentSetup: 构建 XHT-Dataset：XHand–UR7e 平台（UR7e 臂 + XHand 五指手 + 1 腕部 + 2 固定外参 RGB 相机；遥操使用 VIVE 腕部追踪与 MANUS 手套），7 项接触丰富任务共 900 条成功示教（800 训练 / 100 离线测试），任务包括 Pipette Press、Bottle Grasp、Cob Grasp、Sponge Wipe、Button Press、Cabinet Retrieval、Liquid Transfer。ReTouch 与 Tactile-VLA、π 系列基线联合七任务训练 80k updates（batch 8）；RDP、ViTacFormer 为任务专属训练。标准评测：每任务 20 次真机 rollout，前 5 任务限时 60 s，后 2 任务 120 s，采用阶段式 [0,1] 归一化得分。挑战/OOD 设置：Sponge Wipe 高度变化、Cob Grasp 物体位置偏移、Liquid Transfer 光照变化、Bottle Grasp 抬升后向下拉拽扰动及自主恢复。
results: 标准设置七任务平均成功率：ReTouch 83.6%，最强基线 Tactile-VLA 65.2%，绝对提升 +18.4 percentage points；ReTouch 单任务为 Pipette Press 86.0%、Bottle Grasp 95.0%、Cob Grasp 100.0%、Sponge Wipe 87.5%、Button Press 85.0%、Cabinet Retrieval 62.5%、Liquid Transfer 69.0%。

挑战/OOD 四设置平均成功率：ReTouch 73.1%，最强基线 π0.5+tactile 49.3%，绝对提升 +23.8 percentage points；分项为 Height(Sponge Wipe) 42.5% vs Tactile-VLA 25.0%、Sponge Position(Cob Grasp) 98.5% vs π0.5+tactile 80.5%、Cob Lighting(Liquid Transfer) 66.5% vs Tactile-VLA 39.5%、Liquid Pull(Bottle Grasp) 85.0% vs π0.5+tactile 55.0%。
离线诊断（100 条 held-out 轨迹，offset 4/8/12 聚合）：接触后阶段递归精炼 tactile latent 使平均 cosine similarity 从 0.93879 提升至 0.94732（相对 +0.908%）；动作后缀 MSE 从 0.02100 降至 0.02055（相对 −2.139%），且随连续精炼 offset 增大而增加。
部署推理延迟（NVIDIA RTX 5090，仅模型计算）：初始 VLM–FAE pass 52.25 ms，缓存上下文 FAE refinement 19.54 ms；每周期 1 次完整 pass + 3 次 refinement 对应约 9 Hz 完整周期与 36 Hz FAE 更新。
summary.trainingResources: 论文披露：策略与编码器训练使用 8×NVIDIA A800 GPU、bfloat16 混合精度；AdamW + 梯度裁剪 1.0；1k warmup 后 cosine 学习率从 2.5×10⁻⁵ 衰减至 2.5×10⁻⁶。Tactile-Patch Encoder 预训练 global batch size 32、20k updates；ReTouch 策略训练 global batch size 8、80k updates（与 Tactile-VLA 及 π 系列基线同 schedule）。数据规模 900 条真机示教。推理评测在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上报告延迟。论文未披露总 GPU 小时、wall-clock 训练时长或 π0 预训练 checkpoint 的具体训练成本。
limitations: 论文未单独设立 limitations 章节；从方法与实验可推断：完整 ReTouch 采用 blocking refinement，更新动作块时会暂停执行末条命令，可能限制极高频控制场景。
评测平台与传感器布局绑定 XHand（5 指 × 120 taxel）及 UR7e–XHand 18 维关节空间，跨硬件泛化未验证。
XHT-Dataset 规模相对有限（900 条、7 任务），且部分强基线（RDP、ViTacFormer）为任务专属训练，与 ReTouch 的多任务联合训练设定不完全对称。
触觉预测精炼收益在 pre-contact 阶段几乎无增益（latent cosine 与 action MSE 与 one-shot 接近），主要收益集中在 in-contact 阶段。
summary.significance: ReTouch 将触觉从“当前态条件化”推进到“执行期持续精炼的未来触觉预测 + 动作块联合更新”，并通过 Tactile-Patch Encoder 显式保留指别与局部 patch 结构，为接触丰富灵巧操控提供了可解释的触觉表征与闭环控制范式；配套 XHT-Dataset 与大规模真机对比实验显示，在标准与扰动/OOD 条件下均取得显著成功率提升（分别 +18.4 与 +23.8 pp），表明在线触觉预测对齐对滑移、接触变化与执行误差具有实质鲁棒性价值。

paper.title: FabriVLA: A Lightweight Vision-Language-Action Model with Conformal Action Chunk Uncertainty
paper.abstract: Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a leading paradigm for general purpose robotic manipulation, but their computational cost and limited uncertainty awareness hinder practical deployment. We present FabriVLA, a lightweight VLA that fuses shallow and intermediate VLM layers to preserve fine-grained visual features, and gates self-attention among action tokens so that its flow matching head admits inter step structure only as far as training warrants. Trained end-to-end in a single stage, FabriVLA reaches a state-of-the-art 90.0\% average success on Meta-World MT50 with only 0.88B parameters. We further introduce Joint Conformal Action Chunk Calibration (JCAC), a post-training method that augments a frozen policy with a lightweight residual scale head. From a single policy query, JCAC turns a learned elementwise error scale into a set that covers the whole executed action prefix at a user chosen confidence level, 3.3$\times$ tighter in mean radius than an unconditional conformal set. On LIBERO-Safety, these bounds rank rollouts by risk before execution, supporting risk ranked review. Together, FabriVLA and JCAC provide a lightweight and auditable framework for multi-task manipulation with calibrated action uncertainty.

explanation: title keywords action model, vision language action, vision-language-action (+9)
abstract keywords manipulation, vision language action, vision-language-action, vla (+4)

summary.oneLiner: FabriVLA 是以 InternVL3.5-1B 为骨干的 0.88B 轻量 VLA，融合浅层/中间层视觉特征并用门控动作自注意力生成动作块；JCAC 在冻结策略上通过后训练残差尺度头，以单次前向为整个执行前缀提供保形联合不确定集。
summary.motivation: 大规模 VLA 计算与推理成本高，且部署时缺乏对动作预测可信度的显式指示，难以在实时控制中安全落地。现有轻量 VLA 多将策略视为黑盒，无法在执行前说明动作块可能偏离正确值的程度。作者因此希望用远少于主流大模型的参数量，同时获得强操作性能与可审计的动作不确定性。
summary.method: FabriVLA 采用 InternVL3.5 作为视觉-语言骨干，仅保留语言模型前 M 层并保留完整视觉编码器；将图像与指令交错输入，融合最后一层保留层与浅层特征以保留细粒度空间信息；本体状态与经多 embodiment 编码器升维的噪声动作块 x_t 一并送入基于 flow matching 的动作头；在动作 token 间引入零初始化门控自注意力，使块内步间依赖仅在训练支持范围内建模。策略在 receding-horizon 下仅执行前缀 bA_e^k（H_e≪H）。JCAC 为后训练模块：冻结主策略，附加仅 0.58M 参数的残差尺度头 φ，单次查询同时输出动作块 Â 与逐元素误差尺度 σ_φ；再用单一保形分位数 q̂_α 构造联合集合 |A−Â|≤q̂_α σ_φ，在用户指定置信水平下覆盖整个执行前缀的全部维度。
summary.experimentSetup: 仿真：Meta-World MT50 多任务操作（Table 1 对比 TinyVLA 1.3B、SmolVLA 2.3B、RoboTron-Mani 4B、Evo-1 0.8B、Evo-Depth 0.9B、π0 3.5B、LA4VLA 1B 等）；LIBERO-Safety 上评估保形界对 rollout 的事前风险排序；真机：同一单阶段配方在真实机械臂闭环部署并记录部署时得分。FabriVLA 无独立机器人数据预训练，端到端单阶段训练；JCAC 在冻结策略上单独校准。论文未披露训练/校准所用 GPU 数量、时长、批量大小与演示数据规模。
results: Meta-World MT50 平均成功率 90.0%，参数量 0.88B，论文称在对比轻量 VLA 中达到 SOTA
JCAC 残差尺度头仅增 0.58M 参数；在 90% 联合执行前缀覆盖目标下，平均半径比无条件保形集紧 3.3×
单次策略查询即可同时得到动作块与逐元素误差尺度，无需多次前向或候选采样
LIBERO-Safety 上，保形动作界可在执行前按风险对 rollout 排序，支持风险分级审查

limitations: 保形覆盖依赖 exchangeability 等标准保形假设，有限样本下为边际覆盖而非逐点保证
不确定性针对动作残差/执行前缀，与基于最近邻等的分布外上下文诊断是互补问题，不能相互替代
仅执行前缀 bA_e^k 被校准与评估，完整预测块中未执行部分被丢弃

summary.significance: FabriVLA 表明轻量 VLA 可在不牺牲操作精度的情况下接近或领先更大模型，并首次在 VLA 部署接口中提供“一次查询、联合前缀”的可审计动作不确定集；JCAC 以极小开销将学习到的逐元素尺度转化为分布无关的保形界，使操作者在执行前按风险审查动作块，为可部署、可问责的多任务机器人操控提供轻量框架。

paper.title: Device-First Feedback: Toward Mobile-Native LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
paper.abstract: Abstract: Deploying convolutional neural networks generated by large language models (LLMs) on real mobile hardware requires more than GPU validation accuracy: INT8 TensorFlow Lite export, delegate selection, and on-device latency jointly determine whether a model is usable. We present an automated mobile deployment pipeline that closes the loop from QLoRA fine-tuning of an architecture-generating LLM through GPU evaluation, INT8 export, and physical-device benchmarking to gated augmentation of the training corpus. The pipeline is fully scripted and runs cycle-by-cycle without manual intervention, with resume support after interruptions. We evaluate the same frozen protocol on two benchmarks, CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, on a Samsung SM-P613 tablet (seed 42, 20 models per cycle, cycles 0-6). On CIFAR-10, cycle 1 is gate-accepted and improves the mobile deployment score approximately 25.6x over the baseline with a mean quantized accuracy of 46.9%; later cycles raise GPU accuracy but fail the non-decreasing mobile gate. On CIFAR-100, the pre-QLoRA baseline retains the best mobile score; iterative rounds improve GPU accuracy (up to 26.2%) yet cannot surpass cycle 0 on-device, and the training pool stalls at 19 examples after the first accepted round. Together, the two studies show that closed-loop GPU fine-tuning does not guarantee monotonic mobile gains, especially on harder classification tasks, and that multi-dataset, on-device measurement is needed to stress-test deployment objectives. We release per-cycle metrics with 95% confidence intervals, all figures, and complete reproduction commands.

explanation: title keywords architecture, neural architecture search (+6)

summary.oneLiner: 提出端到端自动化移动部署闭环：从架构生成LLM的QLoRA微调，经GPU评估、INT8 TFLite导出与真机基准测试，以设备优先指标门控训练语料增广。
summary.motivation: 将大语言模型生成的卷积神经网络部署到真实移动硬件时，仅依赖工作站GPU验证精度不足以判断可用性；训练后INT8量化会改变精度，NNAPI/GPU/CPU等delegate的延迟差异显著，且既有LLM驱动架构生成工作多在PyTorch域评估，缺乏用真实设备反馈迭代改进生成器的机制。
summary.method: 实现可脚本化、可断点续跑的MobileDeploymentFinetuner流水线（TuneNNGen --mobile_deployment）：每轮读取训练池，对基础模型ABrain/NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag进行QLoRA微调3个epoch；生成最多K=20个LEMUR兼容Net模块；各候选在目标数据集上GPU训练1个epoch并按数据集阈值过滤；导出INT8 TFLite，在256张holdout上测量化top-1精度，并在CPU/GPU/NNAPI三类delegate上各测20次取最小中位延迟；以移动部署分数score=量化精度/最佳延迟排序，经哈希 novelty 过滤后，仅当本轮最佳分数≥0.99×历史门控参考且至少2个有效模型时才接受并增广聊天式训练语料，否则训练池不变。
summary.experimentSetup: 在CIFAR-10与CIFAR-100（32×32）上采用冻结协议：随机种子42，每轮20个模型，报告cycles 0–6（计划8轮）；基准设备为Samsung Galaxy Tab SM-P613（Android 14，USB真机非模拟器）；GPU精度阈值CIFAR-10为0.40、CIFAR-100为0.20；候选训练1 epoch；移动阶段为训练后INT8量化；QLoRA微调与GPU评估在配备NVIDIA GPU的Linux工作站上运行；种子语料由LEMUR架构聊天数据与INT8可部署allowlist交集构建，cycle 0为未适配基线参考且不参与门控增广。
results: CIFAR-10：cycle 0基线最佳移动分数1.09×10⁻⁷，16个有效模型平均量化精度14.4%±2.0%；cycle 1被门控接受，最佳移动分数2.786×10⁻⁶，相对基线约25.6×，平均量化精度46.9%±3.6%，GPU最佳精度57.7%，训练池增至190条；后续cycles GPU最佳精度最高达67.6%（cycle 2），但均因未达非递减门控被拒绝，cycles 5–6平均量化精度降至约18%而GPU仍>56%。

CIFAR-100：cycle 0基线仍为全周期最佳移动分数9.657×10⁻⁸（GPU最佳21.8%，平均量化精度1.2%±0.7%）；cycle 1虽被接受（无先前门控参考）但移动分数5.115×10⁻⁸已低于基线，训练池仅增到19条后冻结；cycle 3最接近基线（8.613×10⁻⁸）仍被拒；cycle 6 GPU最佳精度升至26.2%，平均量化精度仍约1.3%–1.6%，无法超越cycle 0设备表现。
两数据集各周期TFLite导出与真机运行成功率均接近或等于100%（有效样本95% CI下界≥0.82），表明瓶颈在“量化精度/延迟”而非可部署性；GPU精度上升与移动分数脱节在两任务上均出现。
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露：未给出NVIDIA GPU具体型号、显存、训练时长、QLoRA可训练参数量或每轮微调算力成本；仅说明QLoRA微调与GPU评估在Linux工作站的NVIDIA GPU上完成。
limitations: 仅使用单台平板SM-P613、每个数据集单一随机种子42，外推性有限
报告cycles 0–6，相对计划8轮预算不完整
移动分数将精度与延迟压缩为单一比值，在绝对精度很低时（如CIFAR-100）可能偏向快速低精度模型
门控拒绝后训练池停止增长，后续轮次难以通过数据恢复；CIFAR-100首轮接受即低于基线的设计可能过早增广
CIFAR-10 cycle 0的GPU聚合日志在归档JSON中未回填（移动测量完整）
summary.significance: 首次将完全脚本化的多轮QLoRA、物理Android基准与门控语料增广串联为端到端系统，并以CIFAR-10/100对照实验表明：闭环GPU微调不保证移动部署指标单调提升，任务越难越可能无法超越未微调基线；论证生成式AutoML必须在INT8导出与真机测量下以移动原生目标优化，而非仅依赖工作站精度。

paper.title: Keyless Attention: Value-Space Routing and Value-Only Caching for Efficient Transformers
paper.abstract: Abstract: Transformer architectures form the foundation of modern natural language processing, yet the Key-Value (KV) cache introduces substantial memory and bandwidth overhead during long-context generation, increasingly bottlenecking large-scale deployment. We propose Keyless Attention, a novel attention mechanism that replaces the conventional key projection with a dedicated value-space routing projection, eliminating key representations from the attention computation entirely and yielding a Value-Only Cache that reduces KV-cache memory by 50% while improving decode throughput. Experiments across multiple models and architectures demonstrate that Keyless Attention achieves comparable perplexity and downstream task performance to standard QKV attention, while consistently reducing KV-cache memory by 50%. Furthermore, Keyless Attention exhibits slower validation loss degradation after the best epoch, indicating improved robustness against overfitting. Ablation studies confirm that the dedicated value-space routing projection is critical, with Keyless Attention outperforming KV-sharing methods that eliminate the key cache without replacing its routing role. Experiments in the pretraining regime further confirm the viability of Keyless Attention in industrial settings.

explanation: abstract keywords attention, long context, transformer (+3)

summary.oneLiner: 提出 Keyless Attention：用 value-space routing 矩阵替代 key 投影，仅缓存 value，KV cache 内存减半且解码更快，在五种模型/四种架构上 perplexity 与下游任务与标准 QKV 相当。
summary.motivation: 自回归推理中 KV cache 随序列长度、batch、层数与头数线性增长，在长上下文部署中常超过模型参数并成为瓶颈；MQA/GQA、MLA、量化、剪枝等方法仍保留或间接依赖 per-token 的 KV 表示，而 KV-sharing 虽可减半缓存但未显式替代 key 的 token 路由作用。论文希望在不牺牲表达力、且兼容标准 LLM 训练流程的前提下，彻底消除 key 表示并降低推理内存与带宽开销。
summary.method: 将标准 scaled dot-product attention 改写为 query 与 value 直接计算注意力分数；用专用 value-space routing 投影 W_R 取代 key 投影，自回归推理只需 Value-Only Cache。方法置于 Depth-m Attention Factorization 框架：标准 attention 为 depth-2 双线性分解，Keyless Attention 为 depth-m 实例；论文实现 QVV(3)（m=3），投影矩阵数量与标准 QKV 相同。GQA 架构下 value-routing 头数与 KV 头数对齐，W_Q2 按 query head 独立以保持 head-specific routing。
summary.experimentSetup: 在 Hugging Face Transformers 上从零训练五类模型（GPT-2 280M/557M、Pythia 410M、Qwen2 1.5B、Llama 3.2 1B），覆盖绝对/部分/全 RoPE、顺序/并行残差、MHA/GQA 等架构变体；除 attention 机制外超参一致。优化器 AdamW（lr=1e-4，weight decay=0.01），GPT-2 线性 LR+5% warmup，其余 cosine+5% warmup；GPT-2 三随机种子、每模型 10 epoch（12 层 FP32、36 层 FP16）。36 层 GPT-2 在 HellaSwag、ARC-Challenge、StoryCloze、SciQ、BoolQ 上零样本评测。另在 Qwen2.5-3B 上用 FineWeb-Edu 约 980M token（98/1/1 划分、1024 token 非重叠窗口、batch=2、梯度累积 32、有效 batch 65536 token/step）预训练 1 epoch，并在六项下游任务与 WikiText-103 上评估。
results: KV cache 内存相对标准 attention  consistently 减少 50%（五模型均 50% cache）
Table 5：五模型中 Keyless 在 4/5 上 best validation perplexity 更优：GPT-2 280M 33.84 vs 33.71；557M 33.26 vs 33.50；Pythia 39.22 vs 40.99；Qwen2 1.5B 33.79 vs 34.38；Llama 3.2 1B 38.59 vs 39.09
GPT-2 12 层：best val loss 3.5216 vs 3.5180；过拟合 gap +0.0519 vs +0.0778；Welch t-test p=0.266（无显著退化）
GPT-2 36 层：best val loss 3.5044 vs 3.5116，PPL 33.26 vs 33.50；过拟合 gap +0.6866 vs +0.8404；Welch t-test p=0.070（改善趋势）
Qwen2.5-3B 预训练：in-distribution val PPL 25.80 vs 24.83（差距 0.97 PPL，相对 3.9%）；WikiText-103 PPL 57.73 vs 55.20
六项下游准确率均值：Keyless 0.359 vs QKV 0.355；单项：HellaSwag 0.240 vs 0.230，OpenBookQA 0.145 vs 0.115，BoolQ 0.670 vs 0.620；WinoGrande 0.475 vs 0.525，ARC-Easy 0.435 vs 0.440，LAMBADA 0.180 vs 0.198
best epoch 之后 validation loss 退化更慢，五模型均观察到更强抗过拟合性
消融：带专用 value-space routing 的 Keyless 优于仅 KV-sharing、不替换路由角色的方法
summary.trainingResources: 论文披露：全部实验在单卡 NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB 上进行；GPT-2 12/36 层实验（三种子×10 epoch）合计约 102.30 GPU-hours（12 层每 epoch QKV/QVV(3) 约 29.3/29.6 分钟，36 层约 70.2/75.5 分钟）。Qwen2.5-3B 预训练为 FineWeb-Edu 约 980M token、1 epoch，batch=2、梯度累积 32；未披露该预训练 run 的总 GPU-hours 或更大规模多卡配置。
limitations: 训练阶段 QVV(3) 每 epoch 略慢于 QKV（如 36 层 75.5 vs 70.2 分钟），训练计算开销略高
工业预训练设置下存在 modest perplexity gap：val PPL 相对高 3.9%（25.80 vs 24.83），OOD WikiText-103 亦落后（57.73 vs 55.20）
多 shot 评测需 instruction tuning 或显著更大预训练算力，当前规模下结果噪声大、难以理论解释
更大数据集、更长上下文、更大模型的 scaling 行为尚未验证（作者列为 future work）
下游任务上两种方法互有胜负，无一方稳定 dominate
summary.significance: 从机制层面消除 key 表示并引入显式 value-space routing，在推理侧实现确定性的 50% KV cache 削减与更高 decode throughput，同时保持与标准 QKV 可比的建模质量；相对 KV-sharing 更完整地保留 token 路由功能。跨多种 positional encoding、残差与 GQA/MHA 配置的一致性结果表明该方法可作为大规模 LLM 内存高效 attention 的新设计方向，且 best epoch 后更慢的 val loss 上升提示可能改善训练鲁棒性。

paper.title: Understanding Sparse Attention Selectivity in Long-Context Foundation Models via Counterfactual Evaluation
paper.abstract: Abstract: Sparse attention is widely deployed in long-context serving stacks, yet no framework audits how discarding blocks changes the influence of specific content on model output. We first establish that the phenomenon is real and causal: Block Sparse Flash Attention (BSFA) route replay across four architectures changes output decisions in 13 of 16 cells, with zero identity-replay label flips. We then introduce a dense-calibrated counterfactual audit using matched probe cards---Gold (carrying the correct answer label), Poison (carrying a target wrong label), and Benign (filler only)---under six-layout position symmetry, isolating the sparsification-specific effect. Two patterns compete. Signal concentration: the selector preserves Gold and Poison blocks far above filler-matched Benign blocks (G$\approx$P$\gg$B across all model--task pairs). Integration loss: discarding blocks severs cross-block attention---confirmed by an ablation where isolating the probe block collapses its influence from 4.48 logits to zero. Compression ratio governs the balance: a full sweep from mild ($c=0.25$) to aggressive ($c=0.75$) compression across four model--task pairs reveals that three of four cells move toward stronger sparse amplification at higher compression, with two exhibiting sign reversals. Three independent arms---BSFA route replay, controlled block-top-$k$, and KV-cache eviction---converge: sparsification changes content influence in ways aggregate accuracy cannot detect. We provide an open measurement framework deployable on any model exposing block identities.

summary.oneLiner: 提出面向长上下文稀疏注意力的密集校准反事实审计框架，证明块丢弃会因果性改变特定内容对模型输出的影响，且该效应被聚合准确率指标掩盖。
summary.motivation: 稀疏注意力已广泛用于长上下文推理服务，但现有评估仅关注吞吐量、内存与聚合基准准确率，无法审计“丢弃哪些块”如何改变特定证据对答案的行为性影响；注意力权重等内生诊断亦不可靠。作者进一步指出，三项预指定 pooled 检验在 Holm 校正后均不显著（p=0.995、0.771、0.541），但单元内 bootstrap 置信区间显示符号相反的稀疏特异性效应，说明正负方向效应在聚合中相互抵消，因而平均准确率无法检测内容选择性偏移。
summary.method: 采用三条独立测量臂三角验证：（1）Block Sparse Flash Attention（BSFA）强制路由重放，在同一 BSFA 内核路径下仅操纵可见块，以 wrong-minus-gold 答案边际 gap 检验因果性；（2）密集校准反事实审计：在 128-token 块划分与末行 exact-score top-k 稀疏算子下，注入匹配的 Gold（正确答案标签）、Poison（错误目标标签）、Benign（仅填充）探针卡，经六布局位置对称与 forced routing，以稀疏相对 dense 的配对差分 Δ 隔离稀疏化特异性效应，并记录路由收据与内核路径文档；（3）KVPress（Expected Attention、SnapKV）KV-cache 驱逐实验。辅以跨块通道消融以检验 integration loss。
summary.experimentSetup: 在 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B 四个开源架构上，于 SCBench-KV 与 SciFact 任务评估；压缩比 c∈{0.25,0.50,0.75}，无剪枝对照 c=0。BSFA 与受控协议使用 clean-correct 队列（每 model–task 单元 n=58–100）；受控协议每 item 六排列布局，real-evidence 探针每单元 n=16。共 52 个评估单元（16 BSFA、24 controlled、8 KVPress、4 个 c=0.75 thin-probe）。BSFA/受控臂以 float16 + eager attention 推理，dense 校准用 sdpa；每条反事实路由独立全前向。置信区间基于 10,000 次 item-clustered bootstrap，随机化检验 100,000 次 blocked sign flip 并经 Holm 族校正。
results: BSFA 路由重放：16 个 model–task–ratio 单元中 13 个显著为正、0 个显著为负、3 个 null；identity replay 标签翻转数为 0；显著正 gap 范围 0.022–2.078 logits（如 Qwen3-8B SciFact c=0.25：+2.078 [+1.705,+2.474]；c=0.50：+1.635 [+1.308,+1.974]）
信号集中（signal concentration）：选择器对 Gold 与 Poison 块的保留率显著高于填充匹配的 Benign（G≈P≫B，覆盖全部 model–task 对）
整合损失（integration loss）：跨块通道消融显示，隔离探针块后其影响从 4.48 logits 坍缩至 0
压缩比 sweep（四 model–task 对，c=0.25→0.75）：4 单元中 3 个随更高压缩呈现更强稀疏放大，2 个出现符号反转
KVPress SciFact（n=100）：Qwen3-8B Expected Attention c=0.50 配对 compression-minus-dense 中毒率变化 −0.1644 [−0.1796,−0.1504]；SnapKV c=0.50：−0.1081 [−0.1204,−0.0963]；Qwen2.5-7B 各策略变化约 −0.0115 至 −0.0144
内核路径基线：c=0 时 patched eager 与 native dense SDPA 标签一致率 100%，mean |H3| 路径差 0.044，相对主效应（0.47–2.15 logits）可忽略
summary.trainingResources: 论文未披露训练算力或训练资源；工作仅表征推理时稀疏化行为，明确未研究训练阶段动态。
limitations: 受控协议固定 128-token 块大小且选择与 BSFA 稀疏算子绑定，更大/可变块大小或其他层/查询位置可能产生不同路由模式
thin label-token 探针刻意极简，难以捕获复合语义信号（以 n=16 的 real-evidence 探针补充，但样本量较小）
KVPress 使用 poisoning rate 变化，与受控协议 Δ 数值不可直接横比，收敛性为方向性而非定量可比
仅覆盖 7B–8B 参数级四类架构，更大模型缩放行为未验证
填充/格式内容会影响选择器，不能默认视为中性
仅测量推理时稀疏化，不涉及训练时机制
summary.significance: 首次提供可部署于任意暴露块身份模型的开放测量框架，以密集校准、反事实路由重放与对称控制使稀疏执行对内容影响力的改变可观测、可归因、可跨 BSFA、受控 top-k 与 KV-cache 驱逐路径比较；揭示稀疏模型可在保持聚合准确率的同时放大误导内容并压制纠正证据，对长上下文稀疏注意力部署的安全审计与评测范式具有直接实践意义。

idea.title: Does the Repair Index Matter? Equal-Budget Localization Arms for Conflict-Triggered Latent Step Streaming (CLSS)
idea.hypothesis: On a frozen Qwen3-14B two-agent latent chain with S=4 latent steps and k=2 probe cadence, under strict equalization of decoded tokens, peak memory, and end-to-end wall-clock (all arms within 5%), repairing the earliest probe-detected divergence outperforms repairing any other equal-budget location. Primary test: simultaneous 95% cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals for earliest minus each competing arm (max-entropy, max-probe-divergence, random, and the causal-prefix online counterparts of each) all have lower bound >0, holding in the same direction on HotpotQA dev-1000 and MuSiQue dev-500 evaluated separately, not pooled. The claim is falsified if (a) any competing equal-budget arm's simultaneous CI includes 0, (b) the probe fails the Day-2.5 faithfulness gate on natural blind-labeled divergences, or (c) per-example logit-KL-matched head-only versus tail-only perturbation shows no directional separation on the untouched held-out slice. Under falsification the pre-registered headline is 'one extra round of local computation helps under equal budget; the repair index does not matter', reported as such in the abstract rather than reframed as a mechanism finding.
idea.motivation: StreamMA shows step-granular streaming exploits reliable early steps but degrades when the head is polluted; LatentMAS cuts token cost and latency via latent KV transfer but has no explicit disagreement handling; LMAD shows debating only the earliest conflicting segment beats full-trajectory debate, but operates in text. The open question is not whether stacking these helps — one extra round of local computation plausibly helps for trivial reasons — but whether the choice of where to repair carries an effect once compute, memory, latency, and candidate positions are all held fixed. Three rounds of adversarial review eliminated the weaker versions of this study: the 2x2 localization-by-debate factorial (localization has no treatment meaning with debate off), probe non-interference testing (decoding from a cache copy makes near-zero KL a construction artifact rather than evidence), assumed variance reduction from pairing (never pilot-verified), accuracy-drop-based perturbation matching (selects injection strength on the outcome), and 'earliest minus best other arm' comparisons (winner's curse). What survives is a single small, cleanly identified question plus two reusable artifacts: a probe-faithfulness benchmark combining controlled injections with blind-labeled natural divergences, and a per-example KL-matched head/tail perturbation suite.
method: Days 1-2 (~250 GPU-hours): Build the minimal latent stack — last-layer hidden autoregression with layer-wise KV pass-through on frozen Qwen3-14B — and run a 50-example held-out handoff micro-benchmark against a LatentMAS batch reference. Parity is measured by per-step logit KL and cache numerical error, not answer match plus shape checks alone. Abort and report an implementation negative result if mean per-step KL >0.05 nats, answer mismatch >5%, or latency >2x reference. Freeze S=4 and k=2 for all of Phase-1.

Day 2.5 probe-faithfulness gate (~40 GPU-hours, blocking): Build two evaluation sets. (i) Controlled injections: >=300 examples with known earliest-conflict index t*, spanning at least three injection types (entity swap, numeric contradiction, premise negation); report recall, precision, exact-position accuracy, and leave-one-injection-type-out generalization. (ii) Natural divergences: >=100 examples where two blinded annotators independently mark the earliest genuine disagreement; report exact-position accuracy against the consensus label and inter-annotator agreement. Gates: injected recall >=80%, exact-position accuracy >=60% on both sets, cross-prompt agreement >=85% over 3 equivalent prompts x 2 parsers. Median-offset criteria are reported but are not gates (at S=4 with 3 candidates they are near-vacuous). The non-interference check is demoted to an implementation self-check for cache write-back contamination and disclosed as such. Failing the gate terminates the main experiment and publishes 'the probe cannot localize divergence' as the result.

Days 3-4 (~300 GPU-hours): Implement CLSS and the arm suite. A single frozen candidate-position set C is generated once from the no-debate trajectory before any arm selects, preventing entropy or divergence arms from consuming future information. Arms, all debate-on and all with exactly one localized latent debate round exchanging prefix KV caches with commit-guard literal verification: earliest, max-entropy, max-probe-divergence, random, plus causal-prefix online counterparts of each that may use only information available up to the decision point. Budget endpoints: no-debate and FullDebate. Every arm is matched within 5% on decoded tokens, peak memory, and wall-clock; matching residuals are reported per arm. Because oracle-frozen arms are not deployable, the causal-prefix arms carry the deployability claim and the frozen arms carry the mechanism claim; both are reported.

Day 4.5 blinded power pilot (~20 GPU-hours, blocking on study type not on continuation): 200 items x 5 instances, outcome-blinded, to estimate the per-example paired-difference standard deviation sigma_d and publish the minimum detectable effect before unblinding. If power at +2pp is <80%, the study is pre-registered to downgrade to an estimation-only report (effect sizes and intervals, no accept/reject verdict); this downgrade is announced in the paper as a pilot-driven decision, not a post-hoc reinterpretation.

Day 5 main evaluation (~200 GPU-hours): HotpotQA dev-1000 and MuSiQue dev-500 as the two primary benchmarks, analyzed separately with a same-direction requirement; GPQA-Diamond (198) is exploratory only, direction reported, excluded from the primary criterion because its half-width (~7pp) cannot support it. Five independent instances defined as distinct agent prompt templates crossed with sampling seeds; cluster bootstrap over instances, plus mandatory per-instance effect reporting, leave-one-template-out robustness, within-item randomization tests, and explicit disclosure of any template with a reversed sign. Simultaneous confidence intervals (closed testing across all competing-arm contrasts) replace any 'best competitor' comparison.

Days 5-6 perturbation suite (~120 GPU-hours): Head-only (step 1) versus tail-only (step S-1) injection matched per example by pre/post logit KL to within 0.02 nats, with strength levels searched on a 200-item calibration set and evaluated on a disjoint 100-item held-out slice. The matching rule is fixed in advance and applied to all held-out examples; unmatched examples are down-weighted, never deleted, and the unmatched fraction is reported. Injection position is blinded to the evaluation and parsing pipeline; token distance from injection point to answer is reported as a covariate. Directional separation counts as evidence only after matching and blinding.

Days 6-7 conditional (<=240 GPU-hours, requires >=25% slack remaining after Day-5 accounting): no-commit-guard and text-CLSS ablations on the same two primary benchmarks, latency-accuracy Pareto against LatentMAS and StreamMA, and a natural-divergence error analysis of probe misses. S=8, S=16, A=4, LatentMAD, and math benchmarks (AIME25, HMMT) are deferred entirely. A trigger rate below 10% activates cheap early stopping of the affected arm.
evaluation: Primary metric: task accuracy (normalized match on HotpotQA, F1 and EM both reported; answer accuracy on MuSiQue), with end-to-end latency, decoded tokens, and peak memory reported for budget-matching verification on every arm.

Primary criterion: simultaneous 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower bounds >0 for earliest versus every competing equal-budget localization arm, satisfied independently on HotpotQA dev-1000 and MuSiQue dev-500. Pooling across benchmarks is prohibited; any benchmark with a reversed direction is reported as an inconsistency, not averaged away.

Deployability criterion, reported separately: the causal-prefix online earliest arm must beat no-debate and must not be beaten by any causal-prefix competitor, under the same budget-matching tolerances.

Probe faithfulness (Day 2.5, blocking): injected-truth recall >=80% with exact-position accuracy >=60% and leave-one-injection-type-out generalization; natural blind-labeled exact-position accuracy >=60%; cross-prompt/parser agreement >=85%. Failure terminates the main experiment and is published as a negative result about latent-to-text probing.
Latent-handoff parity (Day 2, blocking): per-step logit KL <=0.05 nats, answer mismatch <=5%, latency <=2x LatentMAS reference on 50 held-out examples.

Perturbation falsification: on the disjoint held-out slice with per-example KL-matched strengths and blinded positions, head-only injection must degrade accuracy relative to Serial text (CI upper bound <0) while tail-only injection must retain an advantage over text StreamMA (CI lower bound >0). Absence of separation after matching refutes the head-strong/tail-weak account regardless of clean-run results.
Power and study type: pilot-estimated sigma_d and MDE published before unblinding; if +2pp power <80%, the study reports effect sizes and intervals only, with no accept/reject verdict.

Pre-registered negative headline: if all localization arms tie under matched budget, the paper's stated conclusion is that one extra round of local latent computation helps and the repair index does not, with the probe-faithfulness benchmark and matched perturbation suite released as the contribution.
idea.expectedContribution: A clean identification test for a question the multi-agent literature has assumed rather than measured: whether the location of a repair matters once compute, memory, latency, and candidate positions are equalized. Concretely: (1) an equal-budget multi-arm localization design with a frozen candidate set plus causal-prefix online counterparts, separating mechanism from deployability; (2) a probe-faithfulness benchmark that pairs controlled multi-type injections with blind human-labeled natural divergences and reports exact-position accuracy and cross-injection-type generalization; (3) a per-example logit-KL-matched head/tail perturbation suite with weighted handling of unmatched examples and position blinding; (4) a pilot-driven pre-registration that converts an underpowered outcome into an honest estimation-only report. Artifacts (2) and (3) are reusable independently of the outcome.
idea.impactAssessment: Modest but real. A positive result gives a deployable training-free recipe for lower-latency multi-agent reasoning and a design rule for where to spend a repair round. A negative result is arguably more useful: it would show that much of the apparent benefit in earliest-conflict debate methods is equal-budget extra computation rather than localization, which directly bears on how StreamMA/LMAD-style results should be read. The probe-faithfulness benchmark also supplies evidence on whether temperature-0 text probes can localize divergence in latent chains at all, a prerequisite for a broader class of proposed methods.
idea.noveltyAssessment: Low-to-moderate and honestly scoped. The components (StreamMA, LatentMAS, LMAD) exist; the composition is incremental. Novelty resides in the identification apparatus rather than the system: equal-budget multi-arm localization with a pre-frozen candidate set, the oracle-frozen versus causal-prefix split, simultaneous inference across arms instead of best-competitor comparison, and a probe-faithfulness gate spanning both constructed and natural divergences. No new model, training recipe, or architecture is claimed, and the paper commits in advance to a deflationary headline if localization ties.
idea.resourceAssessment: Inference-only on frozen Qwen3-14B. Nominal envelope 8x H100 80GB x 7 days = 1344 GPU-hours; planning uses a conservative 960 GPU-hour working budget. Allocation: latent stack and parity micro-benchmark ~250; probe-faithfulness gate ~40; arm implementation and budget matching ~300; blinded power pilot ~20; Day-5 main evaluation ~200; perturbation calibration and held-out evaluation ~120; remainder held as slack, with conditional Days 6-7 ablations capped at whatever remains above the 25% reserve. The expanded arm suite is the cheapest part of the plan: 6 arms x 5 instances x 1500 items is roughly 45k example-runs, about 3-6 hours of 8-GPU wall-clock at 32-wide vLLM batching with shared KV templates. Engineering time, not GPU time, is the binding constraint; the Day-2 and Day-2.5 gates exist to fail fast before the expensive sweeps.
idea.trainingResources: None. All agents share a single frozen Qwen3-14B; no fine-tuning, no alignment matrices beyond same-model latent pass-through, no pretraining. Human annotation is required for the ~100-example natural-divergence set (two blinded annotators).
risks: The surviving claim is narrow: if all localization arms tie, the paper reports that extra local computation helps and location does not. This is accepted in advance as a publishable but deflationary outcome, not a failure to be reframed.

Probe faithfulness may hold on constructed injections but collapse on natural blind-labeled divergences, in which case 'earliest' has no stable referent and the main experiment is terminated at Day 2.5.

Only five instances means the upper-level (prompt/run) variance estimate stays coarse regardless of item count; per-instance reporting and leave-one-template-out mitigate but do not solve this, and a reversed-sign template would materially weaken any positive claim.
The Day-4.5 pilot may show +2pp is underpowered at n=1500, downgrading the study to estimation-only with no verdict.

Per-example logit-KL matching may not equalize semantic damage between head and tail injections; weighting unmatched examples reduces but does not remove selection concerns, and residual confounding with distance-to-answer may persist.

Budget matching across arms within 5% on tokens, memory, and wall-clock simultaneously may prove infeasible for the causal-prefix online arms, which pay detection cost at positions they do not repair; matching residuals must then be reported and the deployability comparison weakened accordingly.
Latent KV handoff may fail parity on Day 2, converting the whole program into an implementation negative result.
Engineering schedule risk: latent stack, six arms, two calibration sets, and a blinded pilot inside seven days is tight; ablations are the first thing sacrificed, primary comparisons the last.
Findings are confined to one frozen 14B model, S=4, two agents, and multi-hop QA; nothing generalizes to longer chains, more agents, or math reasoning without further work.

refinements.originalIdeaTitle: Conflict-Triggered Latent Step Streaming (CLSS): Earliest-Divergence Repair for Training-Free Multi-Agent Reasoning
critiquesAddressed: Benchmark inconsistency: method cites HMMT 2026 while evaluation pre-registers AIME25, GPQA-Diamond, HotpotQA, MuSiQue—unify to a fixed three-benchmark core (HotpotQA dev 500, GPQA-Diamond 198, MuSiQue dev 500) and treat math sets as optional stretch goals.

Compute budget mismatch: draft claims ≤4× H100 but factorial design (6 baselines × 4 benchmarks × 3 seeds × 2 perturbation suites × S∈{4,8,16} × A∈{2,4}) exceeds 8 H100×7 days—collapse to Phase-1 gate on two benchmarks before full ablation matrix.

Latent localized debate is underspecified: define debate as exactly one round exchanging prefix KV caches up to conflict index t, with replacement chosen by temperature-0 probe agreement and commit-guard literal-match on ≤32-token decodes.

Falsification logic depends on probe fidelity but includes no detector-calibration control—add oracle-probe ablation (ground-truth conflict index injected) on 50 masks to separate detector failure from protocol failure.

Pre-registered ±3 pp / ±5 pp / ±10 pp thresholds are brittle with n≈500 and 3 seeds—require bootstrap CIs and treat directional separation under head vs tail perturbation as primary falsification, not fixed point gains.

Scope creep across six baselines plus three ablations risks implementation bugs mimicking negative results—prioritize CLSS vs LatentStream-no-debate vs text StreamMA vs Serial text as mandatory; defer LatentMAD full-trajectory and TextMAS to Phase-2 if Phase-1 passes.
refinements.revisedHypothesis: On a frozen Qwen3-14B two-agent chain with S=4–8 latent steps, conflict-triggered localized latent debate after earliest text-probe mismatch will improve macro-average accuracy by ≥+3 pp over the best training-free baseline (LatentStream-no-debate or text StreamMA) on HotpotQA and GPQA-Diamond under clean runs, while head-only step-1 perturbation will reduce accuracy by ≥10 pp relative to Serial text—if head perturbation gap is <5 pp or tail perturbation does not recover ≥+3 pp vs StreamMA, the head-strong-tail-weak synergy claim is falsified.
revisedMethod: Phase-1 core (Days 1–5, 8× H100 80GB): Implement 2-agent CLSS on Qwen3-14B via last-layer hidden autoregression with layer-wise KV pass-through (LatentMAS-style, no fine-tuning); downstream forks independent latent continuation on received prefix while upstream streams S∈{4,8} steps.

Every k=2 steps, temperature-0 typed-node extractor decodes ≤32 tokens per step to build ordered chains Z_i; on first semantic mismatch δ at index t, halt streaming and run one debate round exchanging only prefix KV caches S_i=Z_i[1:t], accepting replacements only if commit-guard verifies literal support in probe text.

Mandatory baselines under matched topology and decode budget: Serial text, text StreamMA, LatentMAS batch handoff, LatentStream-no-debate; evaluate on HotpotQA dev-500 and GPQA-Diamond (full set), 3 seeds, clean plus 100 head (step-1) and 100 tail (step-S−1) perturbation masks following StreamMA protocol.
Detector calibration: on 50 injected-conflict masks, run oracle-probe ablation with ground-truth t to bound false-negative rate; abort Phase-2 if probe misses >20% of conflicts.

Phase-2 conditional (Days 6–7, same cluster): if Phase-1 meets ≥+2 pp clean gain and passes head/tail separation, run ablations (no localization, no commit guard, text CLSS) and add MuSiQue dev-500; defer A∈{4}, S=16, LatentMAD full-trajectory, and math benchmarks unless wall-clock budget remains >20%.
refinements.rationale: The composition of step streaming, latent KV transfer, and earliest-conflict repair is scientifically well-motivated and falsifiable, but the draft overcommits on benchmarks, baselines, and factorial axes relative to an 8×H100 7-day envelope, and latent debate remains operationally vague. Feasibility is capped at 3 until scope is gated behind Phase-1 with unified benchmarks, explicit debate semantics, and probe calibration; novelty is incremental (3) because all primitives exist independently. Revise and resubmit with a locked Phase-1 protocol before refinement 2.
