Novelty remains 3: CLSS is an incremental composition of StreamMA step streaming, LatentMAS KV handoff, and LMAD earliest-conflict localization without a new representational or learning mechanism; the cross-modal probe and perturbation harness are useful engineering but not sufficient for a top-tier methodological claim. Feasibility is 3 under strict accounting: Day 5 allocates 192 GPU-hours to five methods × three seeds × two benchmarks × three condition families (~16.5k multi-agent trajectories with latent debate overhead), plus oracle-probe calibration, while Days 1–4 already consume 768 GPU-hours with no schedule buffer—any micro-benchmark failure, batching underperformance, or debate latency above the assumed 2× Serial-text multiplier forces Phase-2 cannibalization and invalidates the pre-registered ablation plan. Impact is 4 but insufficient to override sub-threshold novelty and tight compute margins; recommend reframing as a focused 4-day replication study (micro-benchmark + clean-run comparison only) or publishing the falsification harness separately before committing full GPU-week integration.

debate.topic: Conflict-Triggered Latent Step Streaming (CLSS): whether repairing the earliest detected divergence in a training-free latent multi-agent chain has an effect separable from simply spending one extra round of local computation

turns.claim:
CLSS 值得保留，但核心可辩护点不是「三件套拼装」，而是它把一个组合性命题写成了可证伪协议：潜变量流传递，温度 0 文本探针在步级定位最早分歧，仅在该处做一次局部潜变量辩论。我主张保留主干，并接受三处修正。

一、方向性分离应坚持并强化。head/tail 双向判据使「干净集 +2pp」无法单独救活假设，这在多智能体工作中罕见。但我承认存在混淆：局部辩论额外花了一轮交互与 token，任何增益都可能只是「多算了一点」。建议新增等预算对照 RandStep-CLSS——在随机步 t'≠t 触发同规模的一次辩论，token 预算配平在 ±5% 内。若 CLSS 相对该对照的配对差 95% CI 下界不 >0，则「最早分歧定位」本身无效，此判据应与 head/tail 并列为主判据。

二、统计功效是真实弱点，我让步。GPQA-Diamond 仅 198 题，+2pp 约等于 4 题，三个种子撑不起其独立 CI。修正：以 HotpotQA 500 与 GPQA 198 合计 698 题的配对自助（同题同种子的逐例差、1 万次重采样、种子作随机效应）为唯一主判据，单基准结果降级为探索性；同时预注册最小可检测效应，并在 Day-5 前用 100 题预跑估计配对差方差。

三、算力账目应更诚实。Days 1–2 的「384 GPU-hours」实为 8 卡 ×48 小时的日历折算，不是真实推理负载；Day-5 实际约 1.6 万例次，在 32-wide vLLM 下远低于 192 GPU-hours。这说明瓶颈在工程实现而非算力，Day-2 的 parity gate 正是正确的风险定位，而非多余的仪式。

另需补一个廉价早停量：探针触发率。若冲突触发率低于 10%，即便每次修复都正确，宏平均上限也仅约 1pp，此时应直接判定该基准无空间，而不必等 CI 裁决；此数在 100 题上一天内可得。

我不主张 CLSS 有强新颖性（3 分合理）。它的价值在于把「流式、潜变量、局部辩论是否可加」变成一次可被证伪的测量，且即使失败，探针校准数据与 head/tail 扰动套件仍可复用。
evidence: 功效算术：GPQA-Diamond n=198 时 +2pp 仅约 4 题，p≈0.5 的二项近似下单基准 95% CI 半宽约 ±7pp，远大于目标效应；合并至 698 题后半宽降至约 ±3.7pp，配对设计消去题目难度共同方差后通常再降 40–60%，故只有「合并 + 配对自助」才具备检出可能，原文的单基准 CI 判据应改写。
算力核算：Day-5 主实验约 5 方法 × 3 种子 ×（698 干净 + 400 扰动）≈ 1.65 万例次；按每例 2–4 秒（潜变量方法取串行文本 2× 上界）单卡约 9–18 小时，8 卡并行约 1.5–3 小时，不足 192 GPU-hours 预算的 10%，说明 25% 的 Phase-2 slack 估计保守可信，真实风险集中在实现而非吞吐。
触发率上限：宏平均增益 ≤ 冲突触发率 × 单例修复成功率 × 可翻转样本比例。触发率 <10% 时上限约 1pp，低于 +2pp 目标；该量可在 100 题、单卡数十分钟内先行测得，应作为 Day-5 之前的廉价早停门，优先级高于现有的 oracle-probe 20% 漏检门。
混淆缺口：现有五方法中缺少等预算随机步辩论对照，LatentStream-no-debate 与 CLSS 之差同时包含「多一轮辩论」与「定位在最早分歧」两个因素，无法归因。加入 RandStep-CLSS 仅需 1 方法 × 3 种子 ≈ 3300 例次，成本在 1 GPU-hour 量级，是分离二者的最小增量改动。

turns.claim: 当前方案仍不足以支持“最早分歧修复”这一因果主张。首先，新增 RandStep-CLSS 只能排除随机位置，不能排除“选到高不确定性位置”或“多一次计算”的解释；至少还需等 token 的 EntropyStep、FullDebate 对照，并以同题配对差检验 CLSS 是否独胜。其次，“跨基准合并 698 题”并未自动解决功效：HotpotQA 与 GPQA 的指标、难度和效应异质，题目也不能替代独立种子；把种子作为仅三水平的随机效应估计不稳定。应预注册分层 cluster bootstrap（先种子、后题目）及效应异质性检验，若任一基准方向相反，不得用宏平均掩盖。第三，所谓 latent step、前缀 KV 交换与“第 t 步”缺乏语义可识别性：自回归隐藏状态不是离散推理步骤，32-token 文本探针可能创造而非观测分歧；answer parity 也不能证明内部轨迹等价。需做探针介入测试：同一 latent cache 在有/无探针解码时后续答案与 logits 应近似不变，并比较多个等价提示/解析器的触发一致性。第四，head/tail 扰动是人为位置操纵，若扰动强度、可恢复信息量或距答案距离不匹配，方向性差异不能归因于“头强尾弱”。应以语义影响或 logit-KL 配平扰动强度并盲化注入位置。若 CLSS不能同时胜过等预算定位对照、通过探针非干扰与稳定性测试、并在配平扰动下复现方向分离，则其结果最多说明额外推理或探针启发式有效；新颖性仍是工程组合，而非已识别的新机制。
evidence: GPQA n=198 时约4题即对应2pp；三个种子多为同一冻结模型上的采样重复，不能将有效独立样本量简单扩大三倍，cluster bootstrap 的区间很可能仍覆盖零。
RandStep 对照只检验“随机位置”；EntropyStep 或最高探针差异位置可能以相同预算获得同等增益，因此它不是最早分歧机制的充分反事实。
KV形状检查与答案匹配率只验证接口和终点，不能验证缓存传递后的条件分布；应直接报告逐步 logit KL、cache 数值误差及探针前后答案翻转率。
决定性2×2测试：定位规则（earliest/entropy-matched）×辩论（开/关），严格匹配 token 与延迟；只有定位×辩论交互项的分层配对CI下界>0，才支持CLSS特有贡献。

turns.claim:
我接受质疑者的四点中的三点，并把它们转成可执行的预注册修改；保留主干的理由在最后。

一、主判据改为2×2（接受）。定位规则∈{earliest, entropy-matched, random}×辩论∈{on, off}，token与端到端延迟配平±5%。主判据是交互项 (earliest−entropy)×(debate on−off) 的分层配对自助 CI 下界>0，而非CLSS对基线的单点差。若 entropy-matched 与 earliest 无显著差异，结论明确降级为「等预算下多一轮局部辩论有效」，写入正文而不包装成机制发现。

二、功效不能靠合并指标解决，只能靠加样本（部分让步）。我在R1已核出 Day-5 真实吞吐不足预算10%，因此正确修法是扩题量：HotpotQA dev 扩至1000、MuSiQue dev-500 提前进 Phase-1，GPQA-Diamond(198) 降级为探索性，不进主判据、只报方向。统计改为分层 cluster bootstrap（先按种子重采样、再按题目），预注册 MDE，并加基准间异质性检验：任一基准方向相反即判为不一致，禁止用宏平均掩盖。

三、探针非干扰性先验证（新增 Day-2.5 门，完全接受）。同一 latent cache 在有/无探针解码两条路径下：后续答案翻转率≤2%、逐步 logit 平均 KL≤0.05 nats、Top-1 一致率≥98%；再以3组等价提示×2个解析器测触发位置精确同位率≥70%。不过门则不启动主实验，直接报「探针制造而非观测分歧」的负结果。我同时收回语义主张：t 只定义为流水线固定切分下的探针索引，不声称其为可识别的推理步骤，KV 验证由 shape+answer-match 升级为逐步 logit KL 与 cache 数值误差。

四、扰动必须配平并盲化（接受）。以 Serial text 上的准确率降幅为强度标尺，调节 head/tail 注入使降幅差≤1pp，记录注入点到答案的 token 距离，注入位置对评测管线盲化；仅配平后仍出现的方向分离才计入证据。

保留触发率<10% 的廉价早停。新颖性维持3分：机制主张已收窄为「定位索引效应」这一可测量、可证伪的小命题。
evidence: 对照的增量成本可忽略：新增 entropy-matched、random 两个定位臂与 FullDebate 共约3方法×3种子×1500题≈1.35万例次，按R1口径（每例2–4秒、8卡并行）约1.5–3小时，仍不足总预算5%。因此这些反事实不是「能否加」的取舍，而是必须加。
功效重算：主判据样本由698升至1500（Hotpot 1000+MuSiQue 500）后，未配对自助半宽约±2.5pp，配对消去题目难度共同方差后经验降幅40–60%，落到±1.0–1.5pp，方可检出+2pp；GPQA 198题半宽约±7pp，确实无法独立支撑，降级为探索性是唯一诚实处理。
探针干扰可直接测量：温度0、≤32 token 的解码若真属只读观测，其对后续条件分布的影响应接近数值噪声，故 KL≤0.05 nats 与翻转率≤2% 是比 answer parity 强得多的接口证据；200题上约1 GPU-hour 即可完成，成本远低于其证伪力。
扰动配平的必要性：未配平时 head 注入天然距答案更远、可覆写的中间信息更多，方向分离可被强度差异完全解释。以 Serial text 降幅等值化（≤1pp）加位置盲化后，方向分离才具因果解释力；该校准仅需2位置×5强度档×100题≈1000例次。

turns.claim: 修订增强了可证伪性，却仍未识别“最早分歧”的独立作用。其一，2×2交互定义不完整：debate-off时定位规则通常不产生处理，earliest−entropy应恒为零或仅反映探针开销，交互便退化为两个on臂之差。应比较等预算 earliest、最大熵、最大语义差异和随机位置，并冻结候选位置集合；否则entropy臂可能使用更多未来信息。其二，三种子cluster bootstrap无法稳定估计种子层方差，1500道异质题也不等于1500次独立机制复现；“配对后CI缩窄40–60%”是未经预跑支持的假设。先用盲化预跑估计配对方差，若+2pp的功效不足80%，应扩大独立模型/提示实例，而非继续加同分布题。其三，探针非干扰测试可能是伪门槛：若探针在缓存副本上解码，原路径天然不变；若探针token写回缓存，则测试的是实现污染。真正风险是探针是否忠实反映latent冲突，需以人工标注或可控注入真值测定位精确率、召回率及跨提示位置偏差；70%同位率过低，足以让“earliest”含义漂移。其四，用Serial准确率降幅配平head/tail会按结果选择扰动强度，且1pp在100题上仅一题，不足以证明等强。应预先按logit-KL或隐藏态范数逐例匹配，再在未参与校准的留出集验证。决定性结论标准应是：盲化留出集上，CLSS胜过所有等预算定位臂，跨至少两个主基准同向，探针定位相对真值可靠，且配平扰动仍有交互；否则只能声称局部额外计算有效。
evidence: debate-off若不执行定位后的修复，定位主效应没有实际处理含义；所谓2×2交互等价于earliest-on与entropy-on的差，不能自动提供更强因果识别。
仅3个种子时上层cluster bootstrap只有3个可重采样簇，区间高度离散；题量增加主要降低题目噪声，不能可靠估计跨运行变异。
缓存副本上的只读解码必然给出近零KL，因此非干扰性不等于探针忠实性；需要带已知最早冲突位置的注入数据测定位误差。
100题准确率分辨率为1pp，以≤1pp配平等同容许一题差且易过拟合；逐例KL匹配加独立留出验证更具判别力。

turns.claim:
我接受质疑者第2轮的四点，全部转为预注册改动；保留主干的理由已收窄为一条可被这四道门直接判死的小命题。

一、撤回 2×2，改为等预算多臂定位对照。承认 debate-off 时定位无处理含义，交互项退化为两个 on 臂之差。改法：所有臂一律 debate-on，共享同一冻结候选位置集合 C（由 no-debate 轨迹在任何臂选择前一次性生成并锁存，杜绝 entropy 臂使用未来信息），四臂为 earliest、max-entropy、max-probe-divergence、random，另加 no-debate 与 FullDebate 作预算端点。主判据改为单因素配对差：earliest 减「其余定位臂中最优者」的分层配对自助 CI 下界>0。不成立则正文直接写「等预算下多一轮局部计算有效、定位索引不重要」，不包装成机制发现。

二、探针非干扰门降级，忠实性门升级（完全接受）。承认探针在缓存副本上解码时 KL 近零是构造必然，该测试只能检出写回污染，故降为实现自检并如实披露实现细节。真正的门改为可控注入真值：≥300 例已知最早冲突位置 t\* 的样本上报告定位召回率、精确率与 |t̂−t\*| 中位数，门槛召回≥80%、中位偏移≤1 步；跨等价提示×解析器的精确同位率门槛由 70% 提到 85%。不过门即报「探针不可用于定位」的负结果并终止主实验。

三、功效让步：先盲化预跑，再决定研究性质。撤回「配对后半宽降 40–60%」这一未经预跑支持的假设。Day-4.5 用 200 题×5 实例盲化预跑估计逐例配对差标准差，据此公布 MDE 与功效；若 +2pp 处功效<80%，预注册降级为估计型研究（只报效应量与 CI，不做接受/拒绝）。独立性来源由「3 种子」改为 5 个独立实例（不同智能体提示模板×采样种子），cluster bootstrap 以实例为簇；我承认 5 簇的上层方差估计仍粗糙，故强制同时逐实例报告效应，禁止只报合并值。

四、扰动配平改为逐例匹配加留出验证（接受）。放弃按 Serial 准确率降幅配平这一按结果选强度的做法。改为逐例以注入前后 logit-KL 匹配 head/tail 强度（每例 |ΔKL|≤0.02 nats），在 200 题校准集上搜索强度档，在不参与校准的 100 题留出集上评测，注入位置对评测与解析盲化，注入点到答案的 token 距离作为协变量报告。

保留触发率<10% 的廉价早停。剩余可辩护命题仅剩：预算、候选集、扰动强度全部配平后，「修哪一步」是否有独立效应；即便判死，注入真值集与配平扰动套件仍可复用。新颖性维持 3 分。
evidence: 多臂对照成本可忽略：6 方法（4 定位臂+no-debate+FullDebate）×5 实例×1500 题≈4.5 万例次，按每例 2–4 秒、8 卡并行约 3–6 小时，占 960 GPU-hours 总预算约 4%。因此这些反事实不是取舍问题，而是必须全上；冻结候选集 C 是零成本改动，却是排除「entropy 臂偷看未来」的关键。
忠实性可直接测且比非干扰更强：在 300 例注入真值样本上，随机猜测的位置命中率在 S=4、候选 3 位时约 33%，故召回≥80%、|t̂−t\*| 中位≤1 步是有判别力的门槛；该测试约 1500 例次、1 GPU-hour 内完成，其证伪力远高于缓存副本上的近零 KL 检验。
功效必须实测而非假设：200 题×5 实例盲化预跑（1000 例次，<1 GPU-hour）可直接给出逐例配对差标准差 σ_d；+2pp、双侧 α=0.05、80% 功效要求 n≈(2.8σ_d/0.02)²，若 σ_d≥0.30 则需 n≥1800，超出 Hotpot 1000+MuSiQue 500 的 1500 题，此时只能降级为估计型研究——这是预跑而非事后调整才能作出的诚实判断。
配平必须逐例且留出验证：100 题上准确率分辨率为 1pp（1 题），以≤1pp 作等强判据等价于容许一题差且易过拟合；改用逐例 |ΔKL|≤0.02 nats 匹配（2 位置×5 强度档×200 题≈2000 例次校准）并在 100 题留出集验证，方向分离才可能归因于位置而非强度。

turns.claim: 修订仍未充分识别“最早”优势。首先，冻结完整候选集虽防止臂间轨迹变化，却使 max-entropy/max-divergence 使用 earliest 在线决策时不可得的未来信息；这可比较定位规则，却不能证明 CLSS 的在线可部署优势。必须同时报告因果前缀臂，并严格匹配解码量、峰值显存和墙钟延迟。其次，以 earliest 减“其余臂中最优者”再做普通 bootstrap 会产生选择偏差与多重比较问题；应预先固定主要竞争臂，或对三个配对差使用同时置信区间/闭合检验，且要求两个主基准分别同向通过。第三，5个“提示模板×种子”实例把提示效应与随机性混在一起，不是5个同质独立重复；仅5簇的 cluster bootstrap仍不可靠。应采用题目内随机化检验、逐模板固定效应及 leave-one-template-out 稳健性分析，任何模板反向都应披露。第四，人工注入真值只证明探针能找回其自身构造的冲突；S=4时中位偏移≤1步过宽，且若每例只有一个真值，精确率定义含混。需加入人工盲标自然分歧、跨注入类型留一泛化，并报告精确位置准确率。KL配平也不保证语义破坏等强；未匹配样本若被删除会引入选择偏差。决定性测试应在全部留出样本上预先规定匹配规则，以加权而非删例处理失配，并证明 earliest 对所有等预算在线臂的同时CI下界>0；否则贡献仍只是工程组合与额外局部计算。
evidence: “最佳竞争臂”由同一数据选出后再推断会造成赢家诅咒；需要同时推断，而非三个比较中挑最有利结果。
5个提示与种子组合无法分别估计提示敏感性和运行方差；增加题目数不能修复仅5簇的上层不确定性。
S=4、候选3位时允许中位误差1步可容纳大量相邻误定位，不能支持“最早”这一精确位置主张。
关键压力测试：自然分歧盲标集×跨注入类型留一泛化；若人工注入召回高而自然精确位置准确率低，探针门只是构造内有效。

debate.consensus: After three rounds the two sides converged on almost everything except the size of what remains to be claimed. Both agree the original framing — CLSS versus a handful of pipeline baselines with a +2pp macro-average target — could not identify the mechanism, because any gain would be confounded with extra compute, probe overhead, and unmatched perturbation strength. The advocate withdrew the 2x2 design (localization has no treatment meaning when debate is off), withdrew the probe non-interference gate (near-zero KL is a construction artifact of decoding from a cache copy, not evidence of faithfulness), withdrew the unsupported claim that pairing shrinks the bootstrap half-width by 40-60%, and withdrew accuracy-drop-based perturbation matching (it selects injection strength on the outcome). The skeptic's remaining objections are accepted here as binding design requirements rather than as grounds for rejection: (a) a frozen candidate-position set removes cross-arm trajectory drift but lets max-entropy and max-divergence arms see information an online system cannot, so causal-prefix online arms must be run and reported alongside them, with decoded tokens, peak memory, and wall-clock matched within 5%; (b) 'earliest minus the best other arm' is a winner's-curse comparison, so the primary test becomes simultaneous confidence intervals against all equal-budget arms, required to hold in the same direction on each of the two primary benchmarks separately; (c) five prompt-template-by-seed instances confound prompt sensitivity with run variance and give only five clusters, so per-instance effects, leave-one-template-out robustness, and within-item randomization tests are mandatory and any template with a reversed sign must be disclosed; (d) injected-conflict ground truth only shows the probe can recover conflicts it constructed, so a blind human-labeled natural-divergence set, leave-one-injection-type-out generalization, and exact-position accuracy (not median offset <=1 step, which at S=4 with three candidates is nearly vacuous) are required; (e) logit-KL matching does not guarantee equal semantic damage, and dropping unmatched examples introduces selection bias, so the matching rule is pre-registered over the full held-out slice with weighting rather than deletion. The idea is approved because the surviving claim, though small, is now sharply falsifiable, the abort gates are ordered so that failures produce interpretable negative results instead of budget overruns, and the whole program stays inference-only on a frozen 14B model well inside the 8xH100 / 7-day envelope (the added arms and calibration sets cost roughly 5-10% of the budget). Approval is explicitly of a downgraded contribution: impact is lowered from 4 to 3 and the headline is pre-committed to 'one extra round of local computation helps, location does not' if the localization arms tie, with the injected-and-natural probe-faithfulness benchmark and the KL-matched perturbation suite standing as reusable artifacts either way.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether five prompt-template-by-seed instances can separate prompt sensitivity from run-to-run variance at all; with only five clusters the upper-level variance estimate stays coarse, and no amount of additional items fixes it within a 7-day budget.

Whether the probe clears the faithfulness gate on blind-labeled natural divergences rather than only on self-constructed injections; high injected recall with low natural exact-position accuracy would mean 'earliest' has no stable referent, and the pre-registered fallback has not been tested empirically.
Whether the causal-prefix online arm can be budget-matched fairly against oracle-frozen candidate arms, since the online arm must pay detection cost on positions it ultimately does not repair.
Whether +2pp is powered at n=1500 pooled items; this is deliberately deferred to the Day-4.5 blinded pilot, and the study may legitimately end as estimation-only with no accept/reject verdict.
Whether per-example logit-KL matching corresponds to equal semantic damage for head versus tail injections, and how much residual confounding the distance-to-answer covariate leaves after weighting.
External validity beyond a single frozen Qwen3-14B, S=4, two agents, and two multi-hop QA benchmarks; nothing in Phase-1 speaks to larger models, longer chains, more agents, or math-style reasoning.

finalIdea.title: Does the Repair Index Matter? Equal-Budget Localization Arms for Conflict-Triggered Latent Step Streaming (CLSS)
finalIdea.hypothesis: On a frozen Qwen3-14B two-agent latent chain with S=4 latent steps and k=2 probe cadence, under strict equalization of decoded tokens, peak memory, and end-to-end wall-clock (all arms within 5%), repairing the earliest probe-detected divergence outperforms repairing any other equal-budget location. Primary test: simultaneous 95% cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals for earliest minus each competing arm (max-entropy, max-probe-divergence, random, and the causal-prefix online counterparts of each) all have lower bound >0, holding in the same direction on HotpotQA dev-1000 and MuSiQue dev-500 evaluated separately, not pooled. The claim is falsified if (a) any competing equal-budget arm's simultaneous CI includes 0, (b) the probe fails the Day-2.5 faithfulness gate on natural blind-labeled divergences, or (c) per-example logit-KL-matched head-only versus tail-only perturbation shows no directional separation on the untouched held-out slice. Under falsification the pre-registered headline is 'one extra round of local computation helps under equal budget; the repair index does not matter', reported as such in the abstract rather than reframed as a mechanism finding.
finalIdea.motivation: StreamMA shows step-granular streaming exploits reliable early steps but degrades when the head is polluted; LatentMAS cuts token cost and latency via latent KV transfer but has no explicit disagreement handling; LMAD shows debating only the earliest conflicting segment beats full-trajectory debate, but operates in text. The open question is not whether stacking these helps — one extra round of local computation plausibly helps for trivial reasons — but whether the choice of where to repair carries an effect once compute, memory, latency, and candidate positions are all held fixed. Three rounds of adversarial review eliminated the weaker versions of this study: the 2x2 localization-by-debate factorial (localization has no treatment meaning with debate off), probe non-interference testing (decoding from a cache copy makes near-zero KL a construction artifact rather than evidence), assumed variance reduction from pairing (never pilot-verified), accuracy-drop-based perturbation matching (selects injection strength on the outcome), and 'earliest minus best other arm' comparisons (winner's curse). What survives is a single small, cleanly identified question plus two reusable artifacts: a probe-faithfulness benchmark combining controlled injections with blind-labeled natural divergences, and a per-example KL-matched head/tail perturbation suite.
method: Days 1-2 (~250 GPU-hours): Build the minimal latent stack — last-layer hidden autoregression with layer-wise KV pass-through on frozen Qwen3-14B — and run a 50-example held-out handoff micro-benchmark against a LatentMAS batch reference. Parity is measured by per-step logit KL and cache numerical error, not answer match plus shape checks alone. Abort and report an implementation negative result if mean per-step KL >0.05 nats, answer mismatch >5%, or latency >2x reference. Freeze S=4 and k=2 for all of Phase-1.

Day 2.5 probe-faithfulness gate (~40 GPU-hours, blocking): Build two evaluation sets. (i) Controlled injections: >=300 examples with known earliest-conflict index t*, spanning at least three injection types (entity swap, numeric contradiction, premise negation); report recall, precision, exact-position accuracy, and leave-one-injection-type-out generalization. (ii) Natural divergences: >=100 examples where two blinded annotators independently mark the earliest genuine disagreement; report exact-position accuracy against the consensus label and inter-annotator agreement. Gates: injected recall >=80%, exact-position accuracy >=60% on both sets, cross-prompt agreement >=85% over 3 equivalent prompts x 2 parsers. Median-offset criteria are reported but are not gates (at S=4 with 3 candidates they are near-vacuous). The non-interference check is demoted to an implementation self-check for cache write-back contamination and disclosed as such. Failing the gate terminates the main experiment and publishes 'the probe cannot localize divergence' as the result.

Days 3-4 (~300 GPU-hours): Implement CLSS and the arm suite. A single frozen candidate-position set C is generated once from the no-debate trajectory before any arm selects, preventing entropy or divergence arms from consuming future information. Arms, all debate-on and all with exactly one localized latent debate round exchanging prefix KV caches with commit-guard literal verification: earliest, max-entropy, max-probe-divergence, random, plus causal-prefix online counterparts of each that may use only information available up to the decision point. Budget endpoints: no-debate and FullDebate. Every arm is matched within 5% on decoded tokens, peak memory, and wall-clock; matching residuals are reported per arm. Because oracle-frozen arms are not deployable, the causal-prefix arms carry the deployability claim and the frozen arms carry the mechanism claim; both are reported.

Day 4.5 blinded power pilot (~20 GPU-hours, blocking on study type not on continuation): 200 items x 5 instances, outcome-blinded, to estimate the per-example paired-difference standard deviation sigma_d and publish the minimum detectable effect before unblinding. If power at +2pp is <80%, the study is pre-registered to downgrade to an estimation-only report (effect sizes and intervals, no accept/reject verdict); this downgrade is announced in the paper as a pilot-driven decision, not a post-hoc reinterpretation.

Day 5 main evaluation (~200 GPU-hours): HotpotQA dev-1000 and MuSiQue dev-500 as the two primary benchmarks, analyzed separately with a same-direction requirement; GPQA-Diamond (198) is exploratory only, direction reported, excluded from the primary criterion because its half-width (~7pp) cannot support it. Five independent instances defined as distinct agent prompt templates crossed with sampling seeds; cluster bootstrap over instances, plus mandatory per-instance effect reporting, leave-one-template-out robustness, within-item randomization tests, and explicit disclosure of any template with a reversed sign. Simultaneous confidence intervals (closed testing across all competing-arm contrasts) replace any 'best competitor' comparison.

Days 5-6 perturbation suite (~120 GPU-hours): Head-only (step 1) versus tail-only (step S-1) injection matched per example by pre/post logit KL to within 0.02 nats, with strength levels searched on a 200-item calibration set and evaluated on a disjoint 100-item held-out slice. The matching rule is fixed in advance and applied to all held-out examples; unmatched examples are down-weighted, never deleted, and the unmatched fraction is reported. Injection position is blinded to the evaluation and parsing pipeline; token distance from injection point to answer is reported as a covariate. Directional separation counts as evidence only after matching and blinding.

Days 6-7 conditional (<=240 GPU-hours, requires >=25% slack remaining after Day-5 accounting): no-commit-guard and text-CLSS ablations on the same two primary benchmarks, latency-accuracy Pareto against LatentMAS and StreamMA, and a natural-divergence error analysis of probe misses. S=8, S=16, A=4, LatentMAD, and math benchmarks (AIME25, HMMT) are deferred entirely. A trigger rate below 10% activates cheap early stopping of the affected arm.
evaluation: Primary metric: task accuracy (normalized match on HotpotQA, F1 and EM both reported; answer accuracy on MuSiQue), with end-to-end latency, decoded tokens, and peak memory reported for budget-matching verification on every arm.

Primary criterion: simultaneous 95% cluster-bootstrap CI lower bounds >0 for earliest versus every competing equal-budget localization arm, satisfied independently on HotpotQA dev-1000 and MuSiQue dev-500. Pooling across benchmarks is prohibited; any benchmark with a reversed direction is reported as an inconsistency, not averaged away.

Deployability criterion, reported separately: the causal-prefix online earliest arm must beat no-debate and must not be beaten by any causal-prefix competitor, under the same budget-matching tolerances.

Probe faithfulness (Day 2.5, blocking): injected-truth recall >=80% with exact-position accuracy >=60% and leave-one-injection-type-out generalization; natural blind-labeled exact-position accuracy >=60%; cross-prompt/parser agreement >=85%. Failure terminates the main experiment and is published as a negative result about latent-to-text probing.
Latent-handoff parity (Day 2, blocking): per-step logit KL <=0.05 nats, answer mismatch <=5%, latency <=2x LatentMAS reference on 50 held-out examples.

Perturbation falsification: on the disjoint held-out slice with per-example KL-matched strengths and blinded positions, head-only injection must degrade accuracy relative to Serial text (CI upper bound <0) while tail-only injection must retain an advantage over text StreamMA (CI lower bound >0). Absence of separation after matching refutes the head-strong/tail-weak account regardless of clean-run results.
Power and study type: pilot-estimated sigma_d and MDE published before unblinding; if +2pp power <80%, the study reports effect sizes and intervals only, with no accept/reject verdict.

Pre-registered negative headline: if all localization arms tie under matched budget, the paper's stated conclusion is that one extra round of local latent computation helps and the repair index does not, with the probe-faithfulness benchmark and matched perturbation suite released as the contribution.
finalIdea.expectedContribution: A clean identification test for a question the multi-agent literature has assumed rather than measured: whether the location of a repair matters once compute, memory, latency, and candidate positions are equalized. Concretely: (1) an equal-budget multi-arm localization design with a frozen candidate set plus causal-prefix online counterparts, separating mechanism from deployability; (2) a probe-faithfulness benchmark that pairs controlled multi-type injections with blind human-labeled natural divergences and reports exact-position accuracy and cross-injection-type generalization; (3) a per-example logit-KL-matched head/tail perturbation suite with weighted handling of unmatched examples and position blinding; (4) a pilot-driven pre-registration that converts an underpowered outcome into an honest estimation-only report. Artifacts (2) and (3) are reusable independently of the outcome.
finalIdea.impactAssessment: Modest but real. A positive result gives a deployable training-free recipe for lower-latency multi-agent reasoning and a design rule for where to spend a repair round. A negative result is arguably more useful: it would show that much of the apparent benefit in earliest-conflict debate methods is equal-budget extra computation rather than localization, which directly bears on how StreamMA/LMAD-style results should be read. The probe-faithfulness benchmark also supplies evidence on whether temperature-0 text probes can localize divergence in latent chains at all, a prerequisite for a broader class of proposed methods.
finalIdea.noveltyAssessment: Low-to-moderate and honestly scoped. The components (StreamMA, LatentMAS, LMAD) exist; the composition is incremental. Novelty resides in the identification apparatus rather than the system: equal-budget multi-arm localization with a pre-frozen candidate set, the oracle-frozen versus causal-prefix split, simultaneous inference across arms instead of best-competitor comparison, and a probe-faithfulness gate spanning both constructed and natural divergences. No new model, training recipe, or architecture is claimed, and the paper commits in advance to a deflationary headline if localization ties.
finalIdea.resourceAssessment: Inference-only on frozen Qwen3-14B. Nominal envelope 8x H100 80GB x 7 days = 1344 GPU-hours; planning uses a conservative 960 GPU-hour working budget. Allocation: latent stack and parity micro-benchmark ~250; probe-faithfulness gate ~40; arm implementation and budget matching ~300; blinded power pilot ~20; Day-5 main evaluation ~200; perturbation calibration and held-out evaluation ~120; remainder held as slack, with conditional Days 6-7 ablations capped at whatever remains above the 25% reserve. The expanded arm suite is the cheapest part of the plan: 6 arms x 5 instances x 1500 items is roughly 45k example-runs, about 3-6 hours of 8-GPU wall-clock at 32-wide vLLM batching with shared KV templates. Engineering time, not GPU time, is the binding constraint; the Day-2 and Day-2.5 gates exist to fail fast before the expensive sweeps.
finalIdea.trainingResources: None. All agents share a single frozen Qwen3-14B; no fine-tuning, no alignment matrices beyond same-model latent pass-through, no pretraining. Human annotation is required for the ~100-example natural-divergence set (two blinded annotators).
risks: The surviving claim is narrow: if all localization arms tie, the paper reports that extra local computation helps and location does not. This is accepted in advance as a publishable but deflationary outcome, not a failure to be reframed.

Probe faithfulness may hold on constructed injections but collapse on natural blind-labeled divergences, in which case 'earliest' has no stable referent and the main experiment is terminated at Day 2.5.

Only five instances means the upper-level (prompt/run) variance estimate stays coarse regardless of item count; per-instance reporting and leave-one-template-out mitigate but do not solve this, and a reversed-sign template would materially weaken any positive claim.
The Day-4.5 pilot may show +2pp is underpowered at n=1500, downgrading the study to estimation-only with no verdict.

Per-example logit-KL matching may not equalize semantic damage between head and tail injections; weighting unmatched examples reduces but does not remove selection concerns, and residual confounding with distance-to-answer may persist.

Budget matching across arms within 5% on tokens, memory, and wall-clock simultaneously may prove infeasible for the causal-prefix online arms, which pay detection cost at positions they do not repair; matching residuals must then be reported and the deployability comparison weakened accordingly.
Latent KV handoff may fail parity on Day 2, converting the whole program into an implementation negative result.
Engineering schedule risk: latent stack, six arms, two calibration sets, and a blinded pilot inside seven days is tight; ablations are the first thing sacrificed, primary comparisons the last.
Findings are confined to one frozen 14B model, S=4, two agents, and multi-hop QA; nothing generalizes to longer chains, more agents, or math reasoning without further work.

idea.title: Tactile-Error Risk Gating for Distilled VLAs (TRG-TD), with Conformal Coverage Audit
idea.hypothesis: For a frozen tactile-distilled VLA student (vision + proprioception only at inference), a lightweight scale head ŝ trained on frozen student features predicts latent tactile-distillation error well enough to rank in-contact risk: on a nested, episode- and object-disjoint test split, ŝ achieves block-bootstrap ΔAUROC >= 0.07 with 95% CI lower bound > 0 against unscaled JCAC action-residual scores, visual-difficulty baselines (RGB entropy, optical-flow magnitude), and a label-permuted head, and is not inferior to a capacity-matched classifier trained directly on measured contact-force/failure labels. Mechanistically, on-manifold interpolation of the student tactile token toward teacher-token neighbors produces a monotone dose-response in independently measured fingertip peak contact force under randomized closed-loop execution (pre-registered Jonckheere-Terpstra p < 0.05), estimated as a total effect without conditioning on action magnitude. Deployment-wise, gating triggered by ŝ (shortened prefix, reduced approach/grasp velocity, re-query) reduces paired log fingertip peak contact force on egg grasp-place relative to phase-matched sham gating and to a contact-progress-only deceleration baseline, showing that risk-aligned trigger timing, not deceleration per se, carries the effect. The conformal layer is claimed only as a coverage audit on the defined action-prefix nonconformity score under the ungated held-out distribution; it is pre-registered to be withdrawn as a contribution if it is empirically indistinguishable from a validation-set quantile threshold.
idea.motivation: HapticVLA-style distillation removes tactile hardware at deployment but offers no runtime audit of when the hallucinated tactile token is wrong; ReTouch shows contact-phase prediction error drives failure but needs onboard tactile and blocking refinement. The natural bridge—conformal action uncertainty—was examined across three debate rounds and does not survive as a mechanism: with R = q̂_alpha * ŝ(x), the conformal constant carries no ranking information, and finite-sample coverage attaches to the action-residual score under exchangeability, not to token error, failure, peak force, or a closed-loop gated distribution. What remains defensible, and still unaddressed in prior work, is narrower and more directly useful: distillation error may be an online-observable quantity from frozen student features, and gating that is aligned in time with predicted tactile unreliability may protect fragile objects better than the obvious heuristic of slowing down whenever contact is imminent. The program is therefore restructured around a cheap offline kill gate, an on-manifold causal dose-response using a model-independent force criterion, and a deployment test whose only manipulated variable is trigger alignment.
method: Stage-0 kill gate, fully offline, <= 1 GPU-day, executed before any new teleoperation: using only the public HapticVLA teleop release and an existing frozen distilled student, split strictly by episode and object into train/calibration/test with a nested independent test set never touched during model or hyperparameter selection; train the 0.5-1M-parameter scale head ŝ on frozen student features and compare against unscaled JCAC action-residual scores, visual-difficulty baselines (RGB entropy, optical-flow magnitude), a label-permuted head, and a capacity-matched classifier trained directly on logged contact-force/failure labels. Pre-registered pass criteria: block-bootstrap ΔAUROC >= 0.07 with CI lower bound > 0 versus unscaled JCAC and visual baselines, and non-inferiority to the direct risk classifier. Failing the first criterion terminates the program; failing the second replaces ŝ with the direct classifier and withdraws the distillation-residual framing.

Data lock (only if Stage-0 passes): reuse the public HapticVLA teleop corpus (jar, compliant food, egg; roughly 400-500 contact-rich trajectories with fingertip tactile, proprioception, multi-view RGB) plus at most 150 new egg-focused teleop episodes on one 6-7 DoF arm with identical sensor layout and protocol; splits and all endpoints registered before any new data are collected, with 15-20% held out for calibration and audit.

Fine-tune a SmolVLA-scale safety-aware teacher with tactile rewards on the combined corpus (roughly 30-40k updates, batch 8-16, <= 2 GPU-days on 8xH100); distill and freeze the vision+proprioception tactile-token student and refit ŝ on the full corpus (<= 1.5 GPU-days).

Stage-1 mechanism test, on-manifold and closed-loop: perturb the student tactile token toward teacher content along an on-manifold path (nearest teacher-token neighbors or conditional generative sampling rather than raw linear interpolation), at 5 dose levels, with randomized assignment and closed-loop execution from randomized initial poses; criterion is independently measured fingertip peak contact force and binary failure, and the total effect is estimated without conditioning on action magnitude. Pre-registered Jonckheere-Terpstra p < 0.05 for monotone dose-response. D_act (action-prefix change under token swap) is logged as a descriptive mediator only and cannot support any safety claim. Non-monotonicity withdraws the tactile-error mechanism claim and falls back to training ŝ directly on measured fingertip force labels.

Threshold selection and conformal coverage audit (<= 0.5 GPU-day): fit both a plain validation-quantile threshold tau_val and a split-conformal threshold tau_conf on in-contact action-prefix residuals rescaled by ŝ; report empirical coverage deviation and trigger rate for both on egg and, without recalibration, on jar and compliant-food transfer splits. State explicitly that no coverage guarantee holds under transfer or under the gated closed-loop distribution. When effective egg calibration episodes fall below 60, report Beta tolerance intervals only and make no coverage claim. Pre-registered withdrawal clause: if |Δ coverage deviation| < 3 points and force endpoints are indistinguishable, the conformal contribution is publicly withdrawn and the method is renamed supervised risk gating.

Stage-2 deployment test, paired two-arm plus baselines: real ŝ-triggered gating (execute k_safe << H prefix steps at reduced velocity, then re-query) versus phase-matched sham gating that preserves marginal score distribution, trigger rate, temporal autocorrelation, and contact-phase trigger distribution while destroying risk alignment; at least two sham constructions are pre-registered because no single sham is known to preserve phase distribution and break alignment simultaneously. Additional arms: contact-progress-only deceleration (slow down as a function of estimated time-to-contact, no risk score) and the ungated student. Velocity profiles, executed step counts, and re-query counts are matched across gating arms.

Power by simulation, not by effect-size shorthand: run a pilot of 10-12 paired trials, then simulate Wilcoxon power on the observed paired log-force difference distribution including ties and zero differences, and adjust for multiplicity across Stage-0, Stage-1, and Stage-2 gates; final Stage-2 sample size is fixed by this simulation before confirmatory trials begin.

Joint-prefix versus marginal per-step gating is analyzed only offline on replayed rollouts and in simulation, as an exploratory comparison; no real-robot claim of joint-prefix superiority is made, because adequately powered factorial arms exceed the real-robot budget.

Real-robot budget: about 50 Stage-1 dose-response trials, 30 paired Stage-2 comparisons (60 trials), 30 contact-progress baseline trials, 30 ungated reference trials, and 20 transfer checks on jar and compliant food without recalibration, for roughly 190-200 trials total, all outside the GPU envelope.
GPU envelope: <= 4 GPU-days for teacher fine-tuning, distillation, scale-head fitting, and calibration; <= 3 further days for bounded sweeps, within 8xH100 for 7 days.
evaluation: Stage-0 gate (must pass before any new collection): ΔAUROC of ŝ over unscaled JCAC and visual-difficulty baselines on the nested independent test split, block-bootstrapped at episode level, requiring >= 0.07 with CI lower bound > 0; plus non-inferiority of ŝ to a capacity-matched direct force/failure classifier.

Stage-1 mechanism endpoint: monotone dose-response of independently measured fingertip peak contact force across on-manifold token perturbation levels under randomized closed-loop execution (Jonckheere-Terpstra, pre-registered p < 0.05), reported as a total effect with no mediator conditioning; D_act reported descriptively only.

Stage-2 primary endpoint: paired log fingertip peak contact force, real gating versus each phase-matched sham, Wilcoxon signed-rank with sample size fixed by pilot-based power simulation and multiplicity adjustment across gates; fingertip force sensing is the criterion, wrist F/T is auxiliary with gravity and inertia compensation.

Stage-2 discriminative baseline: real gating versus contact-progress-only deceleration on the same endpoint; failure to beat this baseline downgrades the contribution to generic time-to-contact gating and is pre-registered as such.
Descriptive secondary: egg task success difference versus ungated policy with paired 95% CI and a 10-point reference band, explicitly non-inferential at this sample size.

Coverage audit: empirical coverage and trigger rate for tau_conf versus tau_val on egg and on jar/compliant-food transfer without recalibration, with Beta tolerance intervals when effective calibration episodes are under 60, and an explicit statement that gated closed-loop coverage is not guaranteed.
Operational cost: false-abort rate, mean control frequency, wall-clock overhead versus ungated policy.

Control set: label-permuted scale head, unscaled JCAC, visual-difficulty baselines, direct force/failure classifier, contact-progress deceleration, ungated student, and an offline oracle-tactile-at-inference upper bound.
Exploratory only: joint-prefix versus marginal per-step gating on offline replay and simulation, reported with effect sizes and CIs and no deployment claim.
OOD stress tests (pose jitter, mid-grasp pull, height variation) reported descriptively, including whether gating benefit concentrates in in-contact phases.
idea.expectedContribution: An honest, staged, pre-registered test of one claim: that latent tactile-distillation error in a sensor-free VLA student is predictable online from frozen features and that gating aligned in time with that prediction lowers peak contact force beyond what deceleration heuristics achieve. The methodological contributions are the cheap offline kill gate that terminates the program for about one GPU-day, the on-manifold randomized closed-loop dose-response that grounds the mechanism in a model-independent force criterion rather than model-internal token or action distances, and the phase-matched sham design that isolates trigger alignment from mechanical slowdown. Conformal calibration is retained only as an auditable coverage report with a pre-registered withdrawal clause, not as a claimed source of ranking, safety coverage, or transfer robustness.
idea.impactAssessment: If the mechanism and deployment endpoints hold, autonomy stacks gain a low-overhead, hardware-free way to detect when a distilled tactile representation is unreliable and to modulate execution before damaging contact, using only RGB and proprioception at inference. If Stage-0 or Stage-1 fails, the negative result is informative and cheap: it shows that distillation error is not recoverable from frozen student features, or that token content does not causally drive contact force in a dose-dependent way, and it publicly closes off action-space conformal scores as a proxy for latent haptic error. Impact is moderate rather than field-changing, because the surviving contribution is an empirical risk-gating result on one fragile-object task family rather than a general uncertainty-quantification guarantee.
idea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate and deliberately downgraded from the original framing. The conformal-uncertainty novelty did not survive scrutiny: R factorizes into a calibration constant times the supervised score, so ranking comes entirely from ŝ, and coverage does not transfer to token error, force, transfer splits, or the gated distribution; the split-conformal threshold is a rank-corrected calibration quantile rather than an independent algorithmic contribution. What remains new is the empirical demonstration that tactile-distillation error is online-predictable from frozen student features and beats both unscaled action-residual scores and a capacity-matched direct risk model, together with the phase-matched sham and contact-progress baselines that separate risk-aligned timing from generic deceleration, and the on-manifold closed-loop dose-response that avoids the circularity of model-internal criteria. Self-assessed novelty is 3 and drops to 2 if the conformal withdrawal clause triggers or if the direct force classifier matches ŝ.
idea.resourceAssessment: Comfortably inside 8xH100 for 7 days: Stage-0 costs about 1 GPU-day and is the worst-case total loss if the program terminates; teacher fine-tuning about 2 days, distillation plus scale-head fitting about 1.5 days, calibration and coverage audit about 0.5 day, keeping core compute at or below 4 GPU-days, with up to 3 days of bounded sweeps. The binding constraints are outside the GPU envelope: at most 150 new egg teleoperation episodes and roughly 190-200 real-robot trials across Stage-1 dose-response, Stage-2 paired comparisons, baselines, and transfer checks. Trimming the 2x2 factorial and moving joint-versus-marginal offline is what makes the real-robot budget feasible; retaining them would have required at least 120 additional trials.
idea.trainingResources: 8x NVIDIA H100 (80 GB), <= 7 days wall-clock. Stage-0 offline kill gate <= 1 GPU-day on the public corpus with an existing frozen student. If passed: ~2 days safety-aware teacher fine-tuning on a SmolVLA-scale backbone (30-40k updates, batch 8-16), ~1.5 days tactile-token distillation and scale-head training, ~0.5 day threshold fitting and conformal coverage audit, <= 3 days bounded sweeps; core training and calibration <= 4 GPU-days. Single 6-7 DoF arm with fingertip tactile for data collection and as the independent Stage-1/Stage-2 force criterion; inference uses RGB plus proprioception only. Teleoperation and roughly 190-200 real-robot trials are scheduled outside the GPU budget and dominate calendar time.
risks: ŝ may fail Stage-0 outright, or may merely match a capacity-matched direct force/failure classifier, reducing the contribution to a standard supervised risk model with no distillation-specific insight.

On-manifold token perturbation may still leave the token manifold or may change contact geometry and object slip so much that the dose-response reflects trajectory divergence rather than token content.

No sham may simultaneously match contact-phase trigger distribution and destroy risk alignment, leaving the Stage-2 primary comparison partially confounded between alignment and phase-specific deceleration.
Real gating may fail to beat the contact-progress-only deceleration baseline, in which case the result is generic time-to-contact gating rather than tactile-error-aware gating.

Pilot-based power simulation may reveal that 30 paired trials are insufficient once ties, contact variability, and multiplicity across three gates are included, forcing either more trials or a narrower confirmatory claim.
The conformal withdrawal clause may trigger, removing the calibration framing and lowering novelty to 2.
Exchangeability fails under closed-loop gating and under jar/compliant-food transfer, so coverage numbers remain descriptive and cannot support any deployment guarantee.
Conservative velocity fallback may cause timeouts on harder tasks, trading force safety for success at a sample size too small to adjudicate success non-inferiority.
The public corpus plus at most 150 new egg episodes may leave too few effective in-contact calibration episodes for stable thresholds, restricting reporting to tolerance intervals.

refinements.originalIdeaTitle: Conformal Risk Gating for Tactile-Distilled VLAs (CRG-TD)
critiquesAddressed: Separated a pre-registered diagnostic (does joint conformal radius track tactile-token error and contact failure?) from the deployment claim (gated execution improves safety), avoiding a single unfalsifiable compound hypothesis.

Specified the mechanistic bridge: teacher–student action-prefix residuals are hypothesized to covary with distilled tactile-token L2 error and peak grasp-force violations, with oracle tactile logging used only offline for validation—not as a deploy-time baseline conflated with the primary claim.

Scoped compute to fit 8×H100×7 days by assuming 400–500 demos from an existing HapticVLA-compatible corpus plus ≤150 new teleop episodes on one primary fragile task (egg grasp-place); secondary tasks used only for threshold transfer checks, not full retraining.

Replaced simultaneous 90% success retention and 25% force-reduction targets with a tiered success criterion: primary endpoint is force-violation reduction at fixed success tolerance (≤10% absolute drop vs ungated distilled), secondary is risk–coverage calibration.
Added mandatory marginal (non-joint) and random-gating controls to isolate whether joint-prefix conformal structure—not generic uncertainty—is doing the work.
Explicitly excluded teleop collection and real-robot wall-clock from the GPU budget and flagged them as the binding feasibility constraint.
refinements.revisedHypothesis: When a frozen HapticVLA-style distilled VLA is paired with a lightweight teacher–student residual scale head and FabriVLA-style joint conformal action-prefix calibration, the resulting radius R will rank-order in-contact failures on a primary fragile manipulation task and correlate (Spearman ρ≥0.35) with offline-measured tactile-token prediction error relative to an oracle teacher; uncertainty-gated receding-horizon execution that shortens executed prefixes and caps approach/grasp velocity when R>τ will reduce peak grasp-force violations by ≥25% versus the same ungated distilled policy while keeping task success within 10 percentage points of ungated performance on the primary egg benchmark.
revisedMethod: Reuse 400–500 contact-rich teleop trajectories from a HapticVLA-compatible release (jar, compliant food, egg) and collect ≤150 new egg-focused demos with fingertip tactile, proprioception, and multi-view RGB on one 6–7 DoF arm.
Fine-tune a SmolVLA-scale SA-RWFM teacher with safety-aware tactile rewards on the combined corpus (~30–40k updates, batch 8–16, ≤2 GPU-days).
Distill and freeze a vision+proprio tactile-token student (HapticVLA TD) and train a 0.5–1M-parameter residual scale head on frozen student features (~1.5 GPU-days).

Calibrate joint conformal radius q̂_α on 15–20% held-out rollouts using absolute teacher–student action-prefix residuals (FabriVLA JCAC); select τ on validation to target 90% prefix coverage on in-distribution egg episodes (~0.5 GPU-day).

Pre-register diagnostic before deployment gating: on held-out episodes with oracle tactile logging only, report Spearman correlation among R, tactile-token L2 error, and binary in-contact failure/force violation.

Deploy gating on the primary egg task: if R>τ, execute first k_safe≪H prefix steps at reduced velocity and re-query; else execute standard prefix; include marginal per-step uncertainty gating and random-τ shams as controls.

Evaluate with 30 seeded trials×primary egg plus 10 transfer trials each on jar and compliant food without re-calibration; report success, peak/mean grasp force vs task ceiling, empirical coverage, false-abort rate, and control frequency.
refinements.rationale: The idea targets a real deployment gap and the revised two-stage hypothesis is falsifiable, but novelty remains compositional: JCAC, tactile distillation, and contact-phase failure analysis are all established; the new claim is empirical linkage between action conformal radius and latent tactile miscalibration, which is promising yet unproven and still risks a null result if residuals do not track tactile-token error. Feasibility is not fully closed: 8×H100×7 days plausibly covers training and calibration, but teleop augmentation and ≥150 real-robot evaluation episodes sit outside that compute envelope and can dominate wall-clock. Accept is withheld until round 2 shows a concrete data source commitment, a powered primary-endpoint analysis plan, and either preliminary evidence that teacher–student residuals correlate with tactile-token error or a sharper theoretical reason they must.
