turns.claim:
核心主张：CRG-TD 的机制桥接（tactile token 误标定 → 条件动作分布偏移 → 异方差重缩放后的联合前缀共形半径 R）是可证伪、可低成本先验的，应予保留；但需三处硬性修订，否则会因统计与效度问题而失败。

(1) 功效陈述必须修正。现评估同时写“≥25% 相对下降”与“25% 绝对下降”，二者不等价。基线违规率 0.40、n=30 配对试验、α=0.05 单侧时，McNemar 仅对约 0.40→0.15（绝对 25 点）有 ~80% 功效；0.40→0.30 需 n≈180。修订：主端点改为配对连续量——同一随机种子下抓取窗口腕部 F/T 峰值取对数，Wilcoxon 符号秩检验，n=30 对 d≈0.55 达 ~80% 功效；二元违规率降为共同主端点，预注册为绝对下降 ≥20 点。

(2) Stage-1 相关性须去混杂。R 与 token 误差可能同被“接触相位/指令速度/接触力幅值”驱动而产生虚假 ρ。修订：预注册偏 Spearman（控制 time-to-contact、指令速度、力幅值）ρ≥0.35；与 vision-only 对照的 Δρ≥0.15，用 episode 级 block bootstrap（10k 次）给 95% CI；追加“标签置换 scale head”作为第二阴性对照。

(3) 可交换性单位须显式声明。同一轨迹内时间步高度相关，若以时间步为校准单位，覆盖保证名存实亡。修订：以 episode 为可交换单元，接触段内取 max 归一化非一致性分数；n_cal≈150、α=0.1 时经验覆盖的 Beta 容差区间约 ±4~5 个百分点，须直接报告区间而非点估计。

让步：(a) joint 对 marginal 的严格优越不应作为阻断性端点——在强时序相关误差下两者差距可能 <5 点，应降级为次要端点，报告效应量与 CI 而非二值判定；(b) 门控本身改变状态分布，破坏部署后可交换性，故覆盖有效性只在未门控 held-out rollout 上声明，门控后覆盖仅作描述性统计；(c) 若公开 HapticVLA 语料的 egg 分布不足，≤150 集新采集可能不够，需预设扩采触发条件。

风险控制：Stage-1 完全离线，仅用已有公开数据与冻结 student，约 0.5 GPU-day 即可先跑；若偏 ρ<0.35 则在任何新采集与真机试验前终止，沉没成本 <1 GPU-day。
evidence: 功效重算：McNemar 配对二元端点在基线 0.40、n=30、α=0.05 单侧下可检出约 0.40→0.15；0.40→0.30 约需 n≈180。改用配对 log 峰值力的 Wilcoxon 检验，n=30 即可检出 d≈0.55，功效来源从“罕见二值事件”转为“每次试验都有信息”。
分裂共形有限样本性质：经验覆盖服从 Beta(n+1-l, l)，n_cal=150、α=0.1 时约 90%±4~5 点；且有效样本量取决于可交换单元数（episode 数），而非时间步数，故必须以 episode 为单位并取接触段 max 归一化分数。
阴性对照矩阵可证伪：接触相位会同时抬高 R 与 token 误差，因此需偏相关（控 time-to-contact/速度/力幅）+ 标签置换 scale head + vision-only 蒸馏三重对照；三者同时通过才能归因于“潜在触觉幻觉信号”而非相位混杂。
阶段化成本闸门：Stage-1 诊断仅需公开语料与冻结 student（约 0.5 GPU-day），排在 ≤150 集新采集与 180 次真机试验之前；诊断不通过即止损，使整个提案的最坏成本落在 1 GPU-day 量级。

turns.claim:
当前主张混淆了“共形覆盖”与“故障排序”。若q̂α是校准集上的固定分位数，真正随样本变化的是尺度头输出或集合宽度，而非共形半径本身；应精确定义R(x)=q̂α·ŝ(x)，并证明排序增益来自异方差尺度，而非速度、接触强度或视觉难度。所谓token误差→动作残差的“Lipschitz桥”也未被识别：token L2未必对应动作语义，且teacher–student残差同时含teacher偏差、蒸馏误差与多模态动作歧义。vision-only学生因架构、训练目标和容量不同，不是隔离触觉幻觉的有效阴性对照。

可行性与评估仍偏乐观。按episode取max虽修复伪样本量，却把保证变成“整段所有前缀同时覆盖”的极保守目标；约150个校准episode还要按物体分层，egg有效样本可能不足。门控通过减速、缩短前缀和重查询同时改变三个因素，即使降低峰值力也不能归因于R或联合共形结构；腕部F/T还会混入惯性与机械臂接触，减速可机械性降低读数而非降低夹持力。

决定性测试应先于真机扩采：在完全独立episode上比较R、仅ŝ、未缩放JCAC、视觉难度基线及标签置换头的episode级偏相关和失败AUROC；若R不能显著优于仅ŝ与未缩放分数，机制主张失败。随后采用2×2析因试验（风险分数：真实/置换；执行：原速/统一减速），并令joint与marginal在实际执行步数、速度、重查询次数及成功率上匹配；只有joint仍降低经指端力传感器验证的峰值接触力，才支持核心新颖性。
evidence: 固定q̂α本身不携带样本排序信息；必须分别消融q̂α、ŝ(x)与原始非一致性分数，避免把尺度回归器的预测能力误称为共形贡献。
token L2不是任务语义度量：正交旋转、无关维度或token尺度变化都可改变L2而不改变动作；需以token扰动的动作Jacobian或因果干预验证桥接。
减速会同时降低腕部F/T惯性峰值并改变状态分布，因此“门控降低违规率”可能只是执行器混杂；统一减速和置换风险分数是必要对照。
n=30不足以可靠证明“成功率下降不超过10个百分点”的非劣性；该结论需要预设非劣性界、配对差异置信区间和明显更大的试验量。

turns.claim:
接受质疑者的形式化，并据此重写主张。明确定义 R(x)=q̂_α·ŝ(x)：q̂_α 是校准集常数，只提供覆盖标定，不携带排序信息；排序完全由尺度头 ŝ(x) 承担。因此把提案拆成两个可独立证伪的部分：(A) ŝ 能排序潜在触觉误差与接触失败；(B) 联合前缀共形层把 ŝ 转成有覆盖语义的阈值 τ，且在匹配执行开销下不劣于 marginal。(A) 失败即全案终止，不进入真机。

修订一：Stage-0 全离线决定性测试（≤1 GPU-day，公开语料+冻结 student，排在任何新采集之前）。消融矩阵为 ŝ-only、未缩放 JCAC 分数、视觉难度基线（RGB 熵/光流幅值）、标签置换尺度头。承认 R 与 ŝ-only 在排序上本质同构，故不再拿两者比较作为要求；预注册要求改为 R 相对未缩放 JCAC 与视觉难度基线的 episode 级 block bootstrap ΔAUROC≥0.07 且 95% CI 下界>0。

修订二：放弃 token L2 作为主诊断量。改用因果干预度量：同帧把 student 触觉 token 替换为 teacher/oracle token，经冻结动作头前向传播，取动作前缀差 D_act=‖a(z_s)−a(z_t)‖。它沿真实扰动方向积分 Jacobian，天然是任务语义量，避开 token L2 的旋转/尺度不变性问题。预注册 ŝ 与 D_act 的偏 Spearman（控 time-to-contact、指令速度、力幅）ρ≥0.35。

修订三：撤回 vision-only 阴性对照（架构与容量不可比，质疑成立）。改为同一冻结 student 的 token 干预对照：token 置零、跨 episode 错配 token。唯一变量是触觉信息内容。

修订四：Stage-2 采用 2×2 析因（风险分数 真实/置换 × 执行 原速/统一减速），joint 与 marginal 在执行步数、平均速度、重查询次数、abort 预算上强制匹配。主端点改为配对 log 指端峰值接触力（评测用指端传感器；腕部 F/T 仅辅助并做重力/惯性补偿），Wilcoxon，n=30 可检出 d≈0.55。

让步：成功率非劣性在 n=30 下不可判定，降级为描述性配对 CI，仅预设 10 点参考界；覆盖同时报 episode-max 与 per-step marginal，egg 有效校准 episode<60 时只报 Beta 容差区间而不作覆盖声明；joint 优于 marginal 降为次要端点，报效应量与 CI。
evidence: R=q̂_α·ŝ(x) 的分解意味着排序增益不可归因于共形层。故对照组重设为未缩放 JCAC 与视觉难度基线；共形层的唯一可检验贡献是阈值 τ 的有限样本覆盖语义，与排序能力分开报告。
token-swap 干预度量 D_act 直接读出动作头对触觉 token 内容的敏感度，等价于沿真实扰动方向的 Jacobian 积分，绕过 token L2 对正交旋转与尺度变换不敏感的问题；同架构 token 置零/错配对照使容量与训练目标保持不变。
2×2 析因加统一减速臂可分离“减速的机械效应”与“风险分数的信息效应”：若置换分数臂在同等减速下取得同样的峰值力下降，机制主张即被否证；评测改用指端力传感器避免腕部 F/T 的惯性伪影。
统计功效：配对 log 峰值力 Wilcoxon 在 n=30 下可检出 d≈0.55，每次试验均提供信息；相反，成功率 0.8 基线、10 点非劣性界的二元检验需 n≈300，故明确降级为描述性，不作结论性声明。

turns.claim:
修订提高了可证伪性，却也削弱了核心新颖性：R=q̂α·ŝ的排序完全来自监督尺度头，共形层只校准动作残差覆盖；它既不保证触觉错误覆盖，也不保证力风险控制。若直接验证集分位阈值与共形阈值表现相同，则“CRG”只是风险回归器加减速策略。

D_act仍非因果安全指标。把teacher token注入student动作头可能产生训练分布外组合；动作差大只说明策略敏感，不说明teacher正确或会导致更大接触力。尤其多模态动作中，两条安全轨迹也可有大前缀距离。必须用受控token插值/替换后真实或高保真闭环结果验证D_act的单调风险含义。

Stage-2功效仍不清：2×2再加joint、marginal及匹配条件，若n=30是总试验数，每格样本极少；若每条件30次，真机预算远超原计划。统一速度、执行步数、重查询次数和abort预算同时匹配，可能消除joint门控本应改变的执行行为，形成不可实现或无意义的比较。置换分数还须保持触发率、时间自相关及接触相位分布，否则不是有效sham。

决定性顺序应为：严格三分数据训练ŝ、校准q̂、独立测试；先比较ŝ、直接风险分类器、未缩放JCAC和非共形验证分位阈值。随后做token干预剂量—响应测试，要求D_act与独立测得指端力/失败在控制动作幅值后仍单调。最后按功效分析确定每个析因单元样本量，并仅在未门控分布声明覆盖；任一环节失败即撤回触觉—共形机制主张。
evidence: 共形覆盖针对所定义的动作非一致性分数，不会自动传递到token误差、失败概率或峰值力；这种传递需要额外结构假设与实证检验。
D_act由同一动作头定义，容易成为“对模型敏感度预测模型敏感度”的循环指标；闭环力学结果才是独立效标。
自适应门控改变后续状态与查询时刻，标准split conformal的可交换性不再成立，因此部署后90%覆盖不能作保证。
多臂析因设计的功效由每个比较单元及配对不一致率决定；总n=30无法沿用单一两条件Wilcoxon的d≈0.55功效结论。

turns.claim:
接受三项批评，并把提案改写为带自我否证条款的四道闸门；保留的最小内核是「触觉蒸馏误差可由冻结 student 特征在线预测，并用于接触相位执行门控」。

让步一（核心新颖性）：共形层不对 token 误差、失败概率或峰值力提供覆盖保证，只对所定义的动作前缀非一致性分数、且仅在未门控 held-out 分布上成立。故预注册正面对照：验证集经验分位阈值 τ_val vs 共形 τ_conf，在 egg 及 jar/compliant-food 迁移分割（不重标定）上比较实际覆盖偏差与触发率。若 |Δ覆盖偏差|<3 点且力端点无差异，则公开撤回「共形」为核心贡献，方法降级更名为监督风险门控（ŝ+阈值），novelty 自评从 4 降至 2。共形层唯一可主张的价值是小 n_cal 与分布迁移下阈值的有限样本保守性，而非排序。

让步二：D_act 具循环性，降为中介量，不作安全效标。改设 Stage-1 剂量—响应：token 插值 z(λ)=(1−λ)z_s+λz_t，λ∈{0,.25,.5,.75,1}，从同一初始位姿开环重放，以独立指端力传感器测峰值力；控制动作幅值 ‖Δa‖ 后要求 D_act 与实测峰值力单调（Jonckheere–Terpstra 预注册 p<0.05）。不单调则撤回机制主张，退回直接以指端力为标签训练 ŝ。

让步三：2×2 析因在 n=30 下无功效。Stage-2 瘦身为两臂配对：真实分数门控 vs sham 分数门控，sham 由真实分数在 episode 内循环平移生成，保持边缘分布、触发率、时间自相关与接触相位分布，两臂速度剖面、执行步数、重查询次数完全匹配；唯一变量是触发时刻是否与风险对齐。主端点为配对 log 指端峰值力，Wilcoxon，n=30 可检出 d≈0.55。joint vs marginal 降为离线重放与仿真的探索性分析，不在真机预算内声称。

Stage-0 仍为止损闸门（≤1 GPU-day，先于任何新采集）：按 episode 与物体严格三分，ŝ 须对未缩放 JCAC 与视觉难度基线取得 block-bootstrap ΔAUROC≥0.07 且 CI 下界>0，否则终止。最坏成本仍约 1 GPU-day。
evidence: 共形层的可证伪对照：与验证集分位阈值直接对撞，判据是迁移分割（jar/food，不重标定）与小 n_cal 下的覆盖偏差。n_cal≈150、α=0.1 时经验覆盖服从 Beta，约 90%±4~5 点；若共形与验证分位在此区间内无可分差异，即预注册撤回共形贡献。
破循环性：λ 插值开环重放把 token 内容变成唯一被操纵变量，效标改为与模型无关的指端力传感器读数；D_act 只作中介量并需在控制 ‖Δa‖ 后仍单调，否则机制主张撤回而非重新解释。
sham 设计：episode 内循环平移保持触发率、时间自相关与接触相位分布，只破坏与风险的时间对齐，因而同时吸收「减速机械效应」与「触发频次效应」，使 2×2 可压缩为两臂而不损失可归因性。
预算账：两臂配对 30 次真机可检出 d≈0.55；保留 2×2 并叠加 joint/marginal 需每格 ≥30 即 ≥120 次，超出 180 次总预算（含迁移检查），故 joint 优越性只在离线/仿真作探索性报告。

turns.claim:
四道闸门仍未挽救“共形”新颖性。τ_conf与τ_val若都取同一校准残差的经验分位数，split conformal通常只多一个有限样本秩修正；把二者当算法对照近乎同义比较。更关键的是，有限样本覆盖仅依赖可交换性，不赋予jar/food分布迁移下的保守性；迁移结果好只能是经验现象，不能归因于共形保证。

token插值实验也不能识别触觉误差的因果安全效应。z_s到z_t的线段可能离开token流形；其动作变化正是token操纵的中介，控制‖Δa‖会阻断待测路径并引入后处理偏差。所谓同一初始位姿开环重放不能复制接触几何、物体滑移和历史，λ趋势可能只是动作幅值或轨迹差异；若目标是运行时风险，应测试闭环扰动而非开环力峰值。

循环平移sham并不同时保持触发时刻的接触相位分布：它恰会把高风险触发从抓取关键瞬间移走；若限制在相位内平移，又可能因短窗口与风险持续性未真正破坏对齐。因此真实门控胜出既可能说明“接触时减速更有效”，也可能说明分数识别触觉错误。n=30的d≈0.55表述还把Wilcoxon功效简化为正态效应量，未纳入配对重复性、零差值和多闸门选择。

决定性测试：先承认共形与同分布经验分位仅作覆盖审计；Stage-0加入直接力/失败分类器并用嵌套独立测试集，要求ŝ在匹配容量下仍有增益。随后对token做流形内扰动（真实teacher-token近邻或生成模型条件采样），随机化闭环执行，估计总效应，不控制动作中介。最后采用相位内、触发率匹配的多个sham，并加入“仅按接触进程减速”基线；按先导数据中的配对差值分布仿真功效。若ŝ不优于直接风险模型，或真实分数不优于接触进程基线，应将贡献降为通用时序门控。
evidence: split conformal阈值本身就是带有限样本秩修正的校准经验分位数；二者差异通常不是独立算法贡献。
分布迁移破坏可交换性后，共形方法没有自动覆盖或保守性保证。
控制由token操纵产生的动作差属于控制中介变量，不能估计token对力的总因果效应。
循环平移保持全局边缘分布和周期自相关，但一般不保持相对接触阶段的触发分布。

debate.consensus: Three rounds converged on a much smaller but genuinely testable core: a lightweight scale head on frozen student features may predict latent tactile-distillation error well enough to gate contact-phase execution, and that claim can be killed cheaply offline before any new data collection. Both sides now agree that (1) the conformal layer contributes no ranking information, since R = q̂_alpha * ŝ(x) factorizes into a calibration constant and the supervised score, and its finite-sample coverage applies only to the defined action-prefix nonconformity score on an ungated, exchangeable held-out distribution — not to tactile-token error, failure probability, peak force, transfer splits, or the closed-loop gated distribution; conformal is therefore demoted from core contribution to a coverage audit reported alongside a plain validation-quantile threshold. (2) Token L2 and the teacher-token-swap quantity D_act are model-internal and circular, so they are demoted to descriptive mediators; the mechanism test becomes an on-manifold token perturbation dose-response with randomized closed-loop execution, scored against an independent fingertip force sensor, estimating the total effect without conditioning on the action-magnitude mediator. (3) The vision-only negative control is withdrawn as capacity-confounded and replaced by same-architecture token interventions plus, critically, a capacity-matched direct force/failure classifier that ŝ must not lose to. (4) The 2x2 factorial and the joint-vs-marginal superiority endpoint exceed the real-robot budget at any credible power; joint-vs-marginal moves offline/simulation-exploratory, and Stage-2 becomes a paired comparison of risk-aligned gating against phase-matched shams and a contact-progress-only deceleration baseline, with power estimated by simulation from pilot paired differences rather than a normal-theory effect size. What survives is honest, falsifiable, and cheap: Stage-0 costs about one GPU-day and terminates the program if ŝ does not beat unscaled JCAC and visual-difficulty baselines and at least match a direct risk classifier; core training and calibration stay at or below four GPU-days on 8xH100, well inside the seven-day envelope, with real-robot trials the binding wall-clock constraint. Impact is moderate rather than large, and novelty is downgraded from compositional-conformal to an empirical demonstration that distillation error is online-predictable and that risk-aligned timing (not merely slowing down near contact) reduces peak contact force. The moderator approves on that reduced and pre-registered basis, with the withdrawal clauses binding.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether on-manifold tactile-token perturbation (nearest teacher-token neighbors or conditional generative sampling) actually stays on the token manifold and identifies a total causal effect of token content on contact force, rather than an artifact of trajectory divergence.

Whether any sham can simultaneously match trigger rate, temporal autocorrelation, and contact-phase trigger distribution while genuinely destroying risk alignment; within-phase shifts may leave alignment intact because risk is temporally persistent.

Whether ŝ retains an advantage over a capacity-matched classifier trained directly on measured fingertip force or failure labels; if not, the tactile-distillation-residual framing is decorative and the contribution reduces to a supervised risk model.

Whether the conformal threshold is empirically distinguishable from a validation-set quantile at n_cal around 150; if the coverage deviation gap is under about 3 points and force endpoints are unchanged, the conformal contribution is pre-registered for public withdrawal.

Whether 30 paired real-robot trials give adequate power for paired log fingertip peak force once tied/zero differences, trial-to-trial contact-geometry variability, and multiplicity across gates are accounted for; the pilot-based power simulation may require enlarging or narrowing Stage-2.

Whether exchangeability can be restored in any principled way for the closed-loop gated distribution, where gating changes subsequent states and query times, or whether coverage claims must remain confined to the ungated audit.

Whether the public HapticVLA corpus plus at most 150 new egg episodes yields enough effective in-contact calibration episodes for stable thresholds, and how to report when fewer than 60 egg episodes survive splitting.

finalIdea.title: Tactile-Error Risk Gating for Distilled VLAs (TRG-TD), with Conformal Coverage Audit
finalIdea.hypothesis: For a frozen tactile-distilled VLA student (vision + proprioception only at inference), a lightweight scale head ŝ trained on frozen student features predicts latent tactile-distillation error well enough to rank in-contact risk: on a nested, episode- and object-disjoint test split, ŝ achieves block-bootstrap ΔAUROC >= 0.07 with 95% CI lower bound > 0 against unscaled JCAC action-residual scores, visual-difficulty baselines (RGB entropy, optical-flow magnitude), and a label-permuted head, and is not inferior to a capacity-matched classifier trained directly on measured contact-force/failure labels. Mechanistically, on-manifold interpolation of the student tactile token toward teacher-token neighbors produces a monotone dose-response in independently measured fingertip peak contact force under randomized closed-loop execution (pre-registered Jonckheere-Terpstra p < 0.05), estimated as a total effect without conditioning on action magnitude. Deployment-wise, gating triggered by ŝ (shortened prefix, reduced approach/grasp velocity, re-query) reduces paired log fingertip peak contact force on egg grasp-place relative to phase-matched sham gating and to a contact-progress-only deceleration baseline, showing that risk-aligned trigger timing, not deceleration per se, carries the effect. The conformal layer is claimed only as a coverage audit on the defined action-prefix nonconformity score under the ungated held-out distribution; it is pre-registered to be withdrawn as a contribution if it is empirically indistinguishable from a validation-set quantile threshold.
finalIdea.motivation: HapticVLA-style distillation removes tactile hardware at deployment but offers no runtime audit of when the hallucinated tactile token is wrong; ReTouch shows contact-phase prediction error drives failure but needs onboard tactile and blocking refinement. The natural bridge—conformal action uncertainty—was examined across three debate rounds and does not survive as a mechanism: with R = q̂_alpha * ŝ(x), the conformal constant carries no ranking information, and finite-sample coverage attaches to the action-residual score under exchangeability, not to token error, failure, peak force, or a closed-loop gated distribution. What remains defensible, and still unaddressed in prior work, is narrower and more directly useful: distillation error may be an online-observable quantity from frozen student features, and gating that is aligned in time with predicted tactile unreliability may protect fragile objects better than the obvious heuristic of slowing down whenever contact is imminent. The program is therefore restructured around a cheap offline kill gate, an on-manifold causal dose-response using a model-independent force criterion, and a deployment test whose only manipulated variable is trigger alignment.
method: Stage-0 kill gate, fully offline, <= 1 GPU-day, executed before any new teleoperation: using only the public HapticVLA teleop release and an existing frozen distilled student, split strictly by episode and object into train/calibration/test with a nested independent test set never touched during model or hyperparameter selection; train the 0.5-1M-parameter scale head ŝ on frozen student features and compare against unscaled JCAC action-residual scores, visual-difficulty baselines (RGB entropy, optical-flow magnitude), a label-permuted head, and a capacity-matched classifier trained directly on logged contact-force/failure labels. Pre-registered pass criteria: block-bootstrap ΔAUROC >= 0.07 with CI lower bound > 0 versus unscaled JCAC and visual baselines, and non-inferiority to the direct risk classifier. Failing the first criterion terminates the program; failing the second replaces ŝ with the direct classifier and withdraws the distillation-residual framing.

Data lock (only if Stage-0 passes): reuse the public HapticVLA teleop corpus (jar, compliant food, egg; roughly 400-500 contact-rich trajectories with fingertip tactile, proprioception, multi-view RGB) plus at most 150 new egg-focused teleop episodes on one 6-7 DoF arm with identical sensor layout and protocol; splits and all endpoints registered before any new data are collected, with 15-20% held out for calibration and audit.

Fine-tune a SmolVLA-scale safety-aware teacher with tactile rewards on the combined corpus (roughly 30-40k updates, batch 8-16, <= 2 GPU-days on 8xH100); distill and freeze the vision+proprioception tactile-token student and refit ŝ on the full corpus (<= 1.5 GPU-days).

Stage-1 mechanism test, on-manifold and closed-loop: perturb the student tactile token toward teacher content along an on-manifold path (nearest teacher-token neighbors or conditional generative sampling rather than raw linear interpolation), at 5 dose levels, with randomized assignment and closed-loop execution from randomized initial poses; criterion is independently measured fingertip peak contact force and binary failure, and the total effect is estimated without conditioning on action magnitude. Pre-registered Jonckheere-Terpstra p < 0.05 for monotone dose-response. D_act (action-prefix change under token swap) is logged as a descriptive mediator only and cannot support any safety claim. Non-monotonicity withdraws the tactile-error mechanism claim and falls back to training ŝ directly on measured fingertip force labels.

Threshold selection and conformal coverage audit (<= 0.5 GPU-day): fit both a plain validation-quantile threshold tau_val and a split-conformal threshold tau_conf on in-contact action-prefix residuals rescaled by ŝ; report empirical coverage deviation and trigger rate for both on egg and, without recalibration, on jar and compliant-food transfer splits. State explicitly that no coverage guarantee holds under transfer or under the gated closed-loop distribution. When effective egg calibration episodes fall below 60, report Beta tolerance intervals only and make no coverage claim. Pre-registered withdrawal clause: if |Δ coverage deviation| < 3 points and force endpoints are indistinguishable, the conformal contribution is publicly withdrawn and the method is renamed supervised risk gating.

Stage-2 deployment test, paired two-arm plus baselines: real ŝ-triggered gating (execute k_safe << H prefix steps at reduced velocity, then re-query) versus phase-matched sham gating that preserves marginal score distribution, trigger rate, temporal autocorrelation, and contact-phase trigger distribution while destroying risk alignment; at least two sham constructions are pre-registered because no single sham is known to preserve phase distribution and break alignment simultaneously. Additional arms: contact-progress-only deceleration (slow down as a function of estimated time-to-contact, no risk score) and the ungated student. Velocity profiles, executed step counts, and re-query counts are matched across gating arms.

Power by simulation, not by effect-size shorthand: run a pilot of 10-12 paired trials, then simulate Wilcoxon power on the observed paired log-force difference distribution including ties and zero differences, and adjust for multiplicity across Stage-0, Stage-1, and Stage-2 gates; final Stage-2 sample size is fixed by this simulation before confirmatory trials begin.

Joint-prefix versus marginal per-step gating is analyzed only offline on replayed rollouts and in simulation, as an exploratory comparison; no real-robot claim of joint-prefix superiority is made, because adequately powered factorial arms exceed the real-robot budget.

Real-robot budget: about 50 Stage-1 dose-response trials, 30 paired Stage-2 comparisons (60 trials), 30 contact-progress baseline trials, 30 ungated reference trials, and 20 transfer checks on jar and compliant food without recalibration, for roughly 190-200 trials total, all outside the GPU envelope.
GPU envelope: <= 4 GPU-days for teacher fine-tuning, distillation, scale-head fitting, and calibration; <= 3 further days for bounded sweeps, within 8xH100 for 7 days.
evaluation: Stage-0 gate (must pass before any new collection): ΔAUROC of ŝ over unscaled JCAC and visual-difficulty baselines on the nested independent test split, block-bootstrapped at episode level, requiring >= 0.07 with CI lower bound > 0; plus non-inferiority of ŝ to a capacity-matched direct force/failure classifier.

Stage-1 mechanism endpoint: monotone dose-response of independently measured fingertip peak contact force across on-manifold token perturbation levels under randomized closed-loop execution (Jonckheere-Terpstra, pre-registered p < 0.05), reported as a total effect with no mediator conditioning; D_act reported descriptively only.

Stage-2 primary endpoint: paired log fingertip peak contact force, real gating versus each phase-matched sham, Wilcoxon signed-rank with sample size fixed by pilot-based power simulation and multiplicity adjustment across gates; fingertip force sensing is the criterion, wrist F/T is auxiliary with gravity and inertia compensation.

Stage-2 discriminative baseline: real gating versus contact-progress-only deceleration on the same endpoint; failure to beat this baseline downgrades the contribution to generic time-to-contact gating and is pre-registered as such.
Descriptive secondary: egg task success difference versus ungated policy with paired 95% CI and a 10-point reference band, explicitly non-inferential at this sample size.

Coverage audit: empirical coverage and trigger rate for tau_conf versus tau_val on egg and on jar/compliant-food transfer without recalibration, with Beta tolerance intervals when effective calibration episodes are under 60, and an explicit statement that gated closed-loop coverage is not guaranteed.
Operational cost: false-abort rate, mean control frequency, wall-clock overhead versus ungated policy.

Control set: label-permuted scale head, unscaled JCAC, visual-difficulty baselines, direct force/failure classifier, contact-progress deceleration, ungated student, and an offline oracle-tactile-at-inference upper bound.
Exploratory only: joint-prefix versus marginal per-step gating on offline replay and simulation, reported with effect sizes and CIs and no deployment claim.
OOD stress tests (pose jitter, mid-grasp pull, height variation) reported descriptively, including whether gating benefit concentrates in in-contact phases.
finalIdea.expectedContribution: An honest, staged, pre-registered test of one claim: that latent tactile-distillation error in a sensor-free VLA student is predictable online from frozen features and that gating aligned in time with that prediction lowers peak contact force beyond what deceleration heuristics achieve. The methodological contributions are the cheap offline kill gate that terminates the program for about one GPU-day, the on-manifold randomized closed-loop dose-response that grounds the mechanism in a model-independent force criterion rather than model-internal token or action distances, and the phase-matched sham design that isolates trigger alignment from mechanical slowdown. Conformal calibration is retained only as an auditable coverage report with a pre-registered withdrawal clause, not as a claimed source of ranking, safety coverage, or transfer robustness.
finalIdea.impactAssessment: If the mechanism and deployment endpoints hold, autonomy stacks gain a low-overhead, hardware-free way to detect when a distilled tactile representation is unreliable and to modulate execution before damaging contact, using only RGB and proprioception at inference. If Stage-0 or Stage-1 fails, the negative result is informative and cheap: it shows that distillation error is not recoverable from frozen student features, or that token content does not causally drive contact force in a dose-dependent way, and it publicly closes off action-space conformal scores as a proxy for latent haptic error. Impact is moderate rather than field-changing, because the surviving contribution is an empirical risk-gating result on one fragile-object task family rather than a general uncertainty-quantification guarantee.
finalIdea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate and deliberately downgraded from the original framing. The conformal-uncertainty novelty did not survive scrutiny: R factorizes into a calibration constant times the supervised score, so ranking comes entirely from ŝ, and coverage does not transfer to token error, force, transfer splits, or the gated distribution; the split-conformal threshold is a rank-corrected calibration quantile rather than an independent algorithmic contribution. What remains new is the empirical demonstration that tactile-distillation error is online-predictable from frozen student features and beats both unscaled action-residual scores and a capacity-matched direct risk model, together with the phase-matched sham and contact-progress baselines that separate risk-aligned timing from generic deceleration, and the on-manifold closed-loop dose-response that avoids the circularity of model-internal criteria. Self-assessed novelty is 3 and drops to 2 if the conformal withdrawal clause triggers or if the direct force classifier matches ŝ.
finalIdea.resourceAssessment: Comfortably inside 8xH100 for 7 days: Stage-0 costs about 1 GPU-day and is the worst-case total loss if the program terminates; teacher fine-tuning about 2 days, distillation plus scale-head fitting about 1.5 days, calibration and coverage audit about 0.5 day, keeping core compute at or below 4 GPU-days, with up to 3 days of bounded sweeps. The binding constraints are outside the GPU envelope: at most 150 new egg teleoperation episodes and roughly 190-200 real-robot trials across Stage-1 dose-response, Stage-2 paired comparisons, baselines, and transfer checks. Trimming the 2x2 factorial and moving joint-versus-marginal offline is what makes the real-robot budget feasible; retaining them would have required at least 120 additional trials.
finalIdea.trainingResources: 8x NVIDIA H100 (80 GB), <= 7 days wall-clock. Stage-0 offline kill gate <= 1 GPU-day on the public corpus with an existing frozen student. If passed: ~2 days safety-aware teacher fine-tuning on a SmolVLA-scale backbone (30-40k updates, batch 8-16), ~1.5 days tactile-token distillation and scale-head training, ~0.5 day threshold fitting and conformal coverage audit, <= 3 days bounded sweeps; core training and calibration <= 4 GPU-days. Single 6-7 DoF arm with fingertip tactile for data collection and as the independent Stage-1/Stage-2 force criterion; inference uses RGB plus proprioception only. Teleoperation and roughly 190-200 real-robot trials are scheduled outside the GPU budget and dominate calendar time.
risks: ŝ may fail Stage-0 outright, or may merely match a capacity-matched direct force/failure classifier, reducing the contribution to a standard supervised risk model with no distillation-specific insight.

On-manifold token perturbation may still leave the token manifold or may change contact geometry and object slip so much that the dose-response reflects trajectory divergence rather than token content.

No sham may simultaneously match contact-phase trigger distribution and destroy risk alignment, leaving the Stage-2 primary comparison partially confounded between alignment and phase-specific deceleration.
Real gating may fail to beat the contact-progress-only deceleration baseline, in which case the result is generic time-to-contact gating rather than tactile-error-aware gating.

Pilot-based power simulation may reveal that 30 paired trials are insufficient once ties, contact variability, and multiplicity across three gates are included, forcing either more trials or a narrower confirmatory claim.
The conformal withdrawal clause may trigger, removing the calibration framing and lowering novelty to 2.
Exchangeability fails under closed-loop gating and under jar/compliant-food transfer, so coverage numbers remain descriptive and cannot support any deployment guarantee.
Conservative velocity fallback may cause timeouts on harder tasks, trading force safety for success at a sample size too small to adjudicate success non-inferiority.
The public corpus plus at most 150 new egg episodes may leave too few effective in-contact calibration episodes for stable thresholds, restricting reporting to tolerance intervals.

idea.title: Quantization-Sensitivity Gating for LLM-Generated Mobile CNNs: A Leave-One-Pool-Out Selector Study
idea.hypothesis: For INT8-exported CIFAR-10 CNNs produced by a locked LLM generator (NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag), the paired margin-shift statistic F = median(|margin_FP32 - margin_INT8|) computed on a fixed 512-image gating manifest (set A, seed 42) carries information about quantization loss L = top1_FP32 - top1_INT8 that is not redundant with FP32 accuracy, measured latency, parameter count, and depth. Two pre-registered predictions follow. (1) Signal: under leave-one-pool-out cross-fitting, adding F to a baseline predictor of the collapse label C = 1[L > 20 points] yields delta-AUC >= 0.05 with sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 (B = 10,000), and adds delta-R^2 > 0 for continuous L. (2) Selection: an equal-acceptance gate (m = 4 accepted per pool) that requires S = quant_top1 / min_median_latency >= 0.99 x pool best AND F <= tau selects architectures whose device-measured post-INT8 top-1 on a sealed 2,000-image manifest (set C) exceeds that of the strongest baseline gate (S plus a leave-one-pool-out FP32+latency+capacity predictor) in at least 6 of 8 independent candidate pools, with one-sided exact sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 on per-pool paired mean differences; the unit of analysis is the pool, not the candidate. The pre-registered practical-relevance marker is a 1.10 ratio, but the confirmatory threshold is simple superiority (paired difference > 0). The hypothesis is falsified if any of the following holds: (a) the cross-fitted incremental-signal test fails; (b) the per-pool paired permutation test on sealed-set accuracy fails, or the F-gate advantage disappears once selected sets are matched on FP32 accuracy; (c) in the paired-seed structural ablation, delta-F fails to predict delta-L after controlling delta-FP32 accuracy and parameter count (one-sided p >= 0.05). No causal claim about architectural primitives is made; F is a predictive sensitivity proxy.
idea.motivation: MobileDeploymentFinetuner runs show GPU top-1 rising to 67.6% while INT8 mobile accuracy collapses to about 18%, so workstation proxies are insufficient for neural architecture design. Generative NAS pipelines currently accept candidates on deployment ratios alone and have no cheap pre-deployment indicator of which candidates will collapse under post-training quantization. A host-side paired FP32/INT8 margin-shift statistic costs almost nothing once a model is exported, so the practically decisive question is not whether it is causally interpretable but whether it is non-redundant with the free signals a practitioner already has (FP32 accuracy, latency, capacity). Earlier framings of this study overclaimed on three fronts - causal auditing, arm-level generator improvement, and candidate-level sample size - each of which is either untestable at this budget or statistically invalid. This version keeps only the claim that the budget can actually adjudicate: whether F is a non-redundant selection signal, replicated across independent candidate pools and evaluated on a sealed holdout, plus a paired-seed structural probe of its origin.
method: Manifests (seed 42, CIFAR-10 test set, three disjoint splits, serialized with image indices and labels): set A = 512 stratified images used only to compute F and calibrate tau; set B = 512 stratified images used only for cross-fitted signal validation; set C = 2,000 stratified images, cryptographically sealed (hash committed at pre-registration) and unsealed exactly once for the primary endpoint. No model, threshold, or rule may be tuned on C.

Pools as replicates: generate 8 independent candidate pools from the locked NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag generator, each with a distinct generation seed and disjoint RAG shard, 16 candidates per pool (128 candidates total). Pools are the unit of resampling, permutation, and cross-fitting throughout.

Candidate pipeline: train each candidate 1 epoch on CIFAR-10 (8-way parallel on H100), export INT8 TFLite with a fixed calibration recipe, record export success, FP32 top-1, INT8 top-1 on A and B, parameter count, depth, and per-layer activation-range diagnostics. Compute F = median(|margin_FP32 - margin_INT8|) and U = IQR(|.|) on A; record the confidence-normalized variant F~ = F / median(margin_FP32) as a pre-specified sensitivity analysis only.

Latency: per pool, benchmark an 8-architecture device panel on Samsung Galaxy Tab SM-P613 (Android 14, CPU + GPU delegates) and fit a per-pool latency predictor over capacity/topology features; predicted latency is used for S and for latency control, with panel residuals reported.

Numerics validation: for 12 randomly chosen exports, compare host-side TFLite INT8 reference-kernel top-1 against on-device delegate top-1 on set B; require |delta top-1| <= 1 point, otherwise all F/S computation moves on-device and the pool count is reduced to stay within the device cap.
tau calibration: computed on set A only, as the bootstrap 95% upper bound (B = 10,000) of the 90th percentile of F, refit leave-one-pool-out so that no pool contributes to its own threshold.

Signal test (confirmatory component 1): baseline model for collapse label C = 1[L > 20 points] and for continuous L uses FP32 top-1, log latency, parameter count, depth; the augmented model adds F. Both are fit leave-one-pool-out and evaluated on the held-out pool's set-B measurements. Report delta-AUC, delta-R^2, and pool-level sign-flip permutation p (B = 10,000).

Selector test (confirmatory component 2): within each pool, apply four gates offline to the same 16 candidates with equal acceptance m = 4 - (i) S-only, (ii) S + F <= tau, (iii) random among valid exports, (iv) S + cross-fitted FP32/latency/capacity predictor. Record pairwise set overlap (Jaccard) per pool. Take the union of selected models (cap 8 unique per pool, 64 total) and measure post-INT8 top-1 for every one of them on sealed set C on-device. Primary statistic: per-pool paired mean difference (gate ii minus gate iv) with one-sided exact sign-flip permutation over 8 pools; secondary comparisons against gates i and iii; pre-specified re-analysis matching selected sets on FP32 accuracy to test whether any advantage is merely elimination of weak models.

Structural ablation (mechanism probe, not causal claim): 12 base architectures sampled across pools, each given three single-factor edits (ReLU vs H-swish, width x0.75, skip on/off) holding all else fixed, trained to a fixed 20-epoch schedule with 2 paired seeds (12 x 3 x 2 = 72 runs plus paired baselines). Test whether delta-F predicts delta-L in a mixed model with base architecture as random effect, controlling delta-FP32 accuracy and parameter count. Monotonic response to edits is not required or tested.

Exploratory generator component (estimation only, no alpha claim): 3 generator seeds x 2 arms (F-gate corpus vs S-only corpus) x 3 cycles of QLoRA fine-tuning on gate-accepted architectures, with equal acceptance counts and identical corpus format in both arms (fragility rationale text excluded from the main comparison and run as a separate ablation only if budget remains). Report per-trajectory effect sizes and intervals; explicitly state that R = 3 gives minimum seed-level permutation p = 0.125 and cannot support a confirmatory conclusion.

Compute plan on 8xH100 80GB for 7 days: about 13 GPU-days candidate training and export (128 candidates, 8-way parallel), about 4 GPU-days structural ablation (72 runs, 20 epochs), about 2 GPU-days paired FP32/INT8 host inference, about 10 GPU-days exploratory QLoRA, about 5 GPU-days buffer, total about 34 of 56 GPU-days. Device budget: 8 pools x 8-architecture latency panels plus 64 sealed-set INT8 accuracy runs (2,000 images each) plus numerics validation, estimated 35-45 device-hours against a 72-hour cap, via scripted overnight USB automation.

Pre-registration and stopping: manifests, tau rule, gate definitions, baseline feature list, permutation procedure, effect thresholds, and the C-unsealing date are committed before any candidate is generated. If the signal test fails, the selector test is still run and reported, but the study is reported as negative for non-redundancy.
evaluation: Confirmatory endpoint 1 (signal): leave-one-pool-out delta-AUC for collapse label C >= 0.05 with sign-flip permutation p < 0.05, and delta-R^2 > 0 for continuous L, when F is added to the FP32/latency/capacity baseline.

Confirmatory endpoint 2 (selection): per-pool paired mean difference in sealed-set post-INT8 top-1 between the F-gate and the strongest baseline gate, positive in at least 6 of 8 pools with one-sided exact sign-flip permutation p < 0.05; reported alongside the 1.10 practical-relevance ratio marker and the FP32-matched re-analysis.

Falsification tests: (1) signal test fails; (2) selector permutation test fails or the advantage vanishes under FP32-accuracy matching; (3) structural ablation shows no delta-F to delta-L relation after controlling delta-FP32 accuracy and capacity.
Mechanism probe: mixed-model coefficient and interval for delta-F predicting delta-L across paired-seed structural edits, with per-edit-type breakdown and explicit reporting of capacity confounding.

Design integrity metrics: gate set overlap (Jaccard) per pool, equal-acceptance verification, export and on-device success rate per pool (target >= 95%), host-vs-device INT8 numerics agreement, latency predictor residuals against the device panel, and confirmation that set C was accessed exactly once.

Exploratory generator readout: per-trajectory change in accepted-architecture sealed-set accuracy across cycles, reported as effect sizes with intervals and an explicit power statement (minimum attainable seed-level p = 0.125 at R = 3); no significance claims.

Descriptive diagnostics: distributions of F, U, and F~ per pool; Spearman correlation between GPU FP32 accuracy and INT8 accuracy restricted to models with INT8 top-1 > 10%; frequency and characteristics of collapse episodes.
idea.expectedContribution: A pre-registered, sealed-holdout, replicate-level evaluation of whether a cheap host-side quantization-sensitivity statistic is a non-redundant selection signal for LLM-generated mobile CNNs, distinguishing it from the free baselines (FP32 accuracy, latency, capacity) that practitioners already use. The study contributes a reusable three-manifest artifact and gating protocol, a leave-one-pool-out evaluation template that treats candidate pools rather than individual candidates as replicates, an equal-acceptance four-gate comparison that isolates the gate from acceptance-rate and corpus-size confounds, and a paired-seed structural probe that bounds how much of F reflects architectural sensitivity versus base model quality and calibration. A negative result is equally informative: it would show that inference-time margin-shift probes at 512-image scale add nothing beyond FP32/latency baselines, redirecting effort toward quantization-aware training signals or larger probe sets.
idea.impactAssessment: Moderate-to-high practical relevance, tightly scoped. On-device AutoML pipelines currently discover quantization collapse only after export and device benchmarking; a validated host-side gate would cut that cost substantially and directly targets the documented 67.6% GPU to 18% INT8 failure mode. The scope limits are explicit: one device, one dataset, one locked generator, post-training quantization only, so the result is a well-characterized existence claim about a signal rather than a general method. The negative branch retains value because it rules out a cheap fix that many pipelines would otherwise adopt on intuition.
idea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate (self-assessed 3, downgraded from 4 during the debate). Quantization-sensitivity statistics and deployment-aware NAS both exist; the contribution is their composition as an equal-acceptance gate for a generative architecture pipeline, together with the methodological rigor of disjoint manifests, a sealed endpoint set, pool-level replication, cross-fitted strong baselines, and a paired-seed structural probe. The originally claimed counterfactual causal audit of architectural primitives is withdrawn: the design observes naturally occurring architectures and, in the ablation, edits that necessarily perturb capacity and optimization alongside the targeted factor.
idea.resourceAssessment: Comfortably inside the 8xH100 x 7-day ceiling (56 GPU-days) at roughly 34 GPU-days: about 13 for 128 candidates at 1 epoch, about 4 for the 72-run paired-seed structural ablation, about 2 for paired FP32/INT8 host inference, about 10 for the exploratory QLoRA component, about 5 buffer. The key budget decision is reallocating GPU-days away from expensive adapter trajectories toward cheap independent candidate pools, which is what makes pool-level replication (n = 8, minimum permutation p = 0.0039) affordable. Device work is estimated at 35-45 hours against a 72-hour cap: 8 latency panels of 8 architectures, 64 sealed-set INT8 accuracy runs over 2,000 images, and 12 numerics-validation runs. If the numerics check fails and all quantized evaluation must move on-device, the pool count drops from 8 to 6 (minimum permutation p = 0.0156, still usable) to stay within the cap. CIFAR-100 is out of scope.
idea.trainingResources: About 34 of 56 available GPU-days on 8xH100 80GB. No large-scale pretraining; the generator is locked to NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag and only QLoRA adapters are trained, and only for the exploratory component. Candidate CNNs are small CIFAR-10 models trained 1 epoch (selector study) or 20 epochs (structural ablation). Device resources: one Samsung Galaxy Tab SM-P613 (Android 14, CPU and GPU delegates) under scripted overnight USB automation, capped at 72 device-hours.
risks: F may be predictive only for catastrophic collapse and useless for ranking non-collapsing models, in which case the selector advantage will be driven entirely by a small number of pools containing collapsed candidates and will be unstable across pools.

With 8 pools the exact sign-flip permutation floor is p = 0.0039, but power against modest effects is still limited; a real but small F-gate advantage could go undetected, and the study cannot distinguish 'no signal' from 'small signal'.
Host-side TFLite INT8 numerics may diverge from the device delegate, invalidating off-device F and S computation and forcing a reduction to 6 pools with correspondingly weaker inference.

Gate-selected sets will partially overlap across the four gates, compressing between-gate differences and biasing the comparison toward the null; overlap is reported but cannot be eliminated at m = 4 out of 16.

Structural edits change capacity, optimization difficulty, and FP32 quality simultaneously, so even a positive delta-F to delta-L relation supports only a predictive, not causal, reading of architectural sensitivity.
All pools come from one locked generator, so an F-gate advantage may reflect that generator's architectural prior rather than a transferable property of quantization sensitivity.

The exploratory generator component at R = 3 cannot resolve whether gating actually steers the generator; it risks being over-interpreted by readers despite the explicit estimation-only framing, and may be better dropped in favor of additional pools.

Single-device, single-dataset, post-training-quantization-only scope leaves training-time quantization interaction entirely unaddressed, so residual GPU-to-INT8 decoupling may persist even under a successful gate.
Sealed set C at 2,000 images gives roughly +/-1 point per-model precision, which may be coarse relative to the between-gate differences of interest.

refinements.originalIdeaTitle: Counterfactual Quantization-Audit Gating for LLM-Driven Mobile Architecture Search
critiquesAddressed: Three parallel QLoRA trajectories (dual-gate, mobile-only, GPU-only) on diverging corpora imply ~54 GPU-days for finetuning alone, exceeding the 56 GPU-day ceiling once candidate training, export retries, and ablations are included; GPU-only arm dropped or relegated to cycle-0 diagnostic.

Identical candidate pools per cycle do not yield comparable finetuning paths once gates accept different subsets; revised design separates shared generation/evaluation from a pre-registered two-arm fine-tuning comparison.

256-image holdout with cycle-0 P90 τ from n=20 is statistically unstable and may freeze augmentation; τ now uses pooled cycle-0 fragility with bootstrap CI plus a minimum-acceptance rule (≥1 candidate per cycle or τ relaxed by 10%).
Dual-dataset scope (CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100) with on-device latency benchmarking is the wall-clock bottleneck; CIFAR-10 is primary and pre-registered, CIFAR-100 is optional confirmatory.

Hypothesis bundles accuracy lift, Spearman ρ improvement, and mobile-score monotonicity into one falsification bundle; primary endpoint is ≥20% median post-INT8 top-1 gain at matched latency vs mobile-only, with ρ treated as secondary.
Spearman ρ(GPU, quant) is confounded by narrow accuracy ranges on CIFAR-100; correlation analysis restricted to CIFAR-10 and architectures with quant top-1 > 10%.

On-device throughput (~3 delegates × 20 candidates × 6 cycles × 2 arms ≈ 720 benchmark sessions) likely exceeds 7-day wall-clock; revised plan caps delegates to CPU+GPU, batches overnight, and pre-specifies fallback to 4 cycles if <80% of cycle-4 benchmarks complete by day 5.
refinements.revisedHypothesis: If an LLM architecture generator is fine-tuned under a dual acceptance gate requiring (a) non-decreasing mobile deployment score S = quant_top1 / min_median_latency and (b) bounded paired FP32-vs-INT8 counterfactual fragility F = median(|Δ margin|) ≤ τ on a fixed 256-image holdout, then over 6 cycles (fallback 4 if device budget binds) on CIFAR-10 it will achieve ≥20% higher median post-INT8 top-1 accuracy at matched latency versus the same generator fine-tuned with mobile-score-only gating on the same per-cycle candidate pools; if the dual gate fails to beat mobile-only by ≥20% (bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero) or accepts fewer than 3 cumulative augmentations, the hypothesis is falsified.
revisedMethod: Two-arm pre-registered study on CIFAR-10 (32×32, seed 42): dual-gate vs mobile-score-only; drop GPU-only as a finetuning arm and report it only as a cycle-0 upper-bound diagnostic on the shared pool.

Each cycle: generate K=20 candidates once from the shared base generator (ABrain or NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag); train each 1 epoch on GPU; export INT8 TFLite; run QuantCounterfactualAuditor (paired FP32/INT8 on 256-image holdout, Δ_i = margin_FP32 − margin_INT8, F = median(|Δ|), U = IQR(|Δ|)).

Compute mobile score S per candidate; offline apply both gates to the same pool—dual accepts if S ≥ 0.99×historical best and F ≤ τ and ≥2 valid exports; mobile-only accepts on S alone—then fine-tune separate QLoRA adapters (3 epochs/cycle) using only gate-passing architectures plus structured fragility rationales for the dual arm.

Set τ at cycle 0 as the 90th percentile of F over all valid candidates with a bootstrap 95% upper bound; enforce minimum acceptance of ≥1 candidate per arm per cycle by relaxing τ up to +10% if needed, logging relax events.

Primary endpoint: median post-INT8 top-1 on Samsung Galaxy Tab SM-P613 (Android 14) at matched latency (±5%) across arms at cycles 0–6; secondary: Spearman ρ(GPU, quant) on CIFAR-10 for architectures with quant top-1 > 10%, cycle-wise F/U diagnostics, export success ≥95%.

Compute budget: ~18 GPU-days QLoRA (2 arms × 6 cycles), ~12 GPU-days candidate training (120 models, parallelized on 8×H100), ~2 GPU-days counterfactual inference, ~5 GPU-days buffer—≤37 GPU-days total, leaving wall-clock for scripted overnight device benchmarking; optional CIFAR-100 replication only if primary arm completes by day 6.
refinements.rationale: The core idea—using paired FP32/INT8 counterfactual fragility as an architecture-generator acceptance signal alongside mobile deployment score—is coherent, falsifiable, and plausibly impactful, but the original plan triples divergent QLoRA trajectories and dual-dataset on-device benchmarking in ways that exceed both the 56 GPU-day and 7-day wall-clock envelopes once export retries are counted. Collapsing to a two-arm, shared-pool design with pre-registered primary endpoint, stabilized τ calibration, and explicit device-time fallback restores tractability without abandoning the central claim.

debate.topic: Whether a paired FP32-vs-INT8 margin-shift statistic (F) provides a non-redundant, budget-feasible gating signal for LLM-generated mobile CNN architectures, and at what level of claim (selector signal vs. generator steering vs. causal architecture audit) that claim is defensible under an 8xH100/7-day budget.

turns.claim:
该提案的核心机制（把量化反事实脆弱度 F 作为架构生成器的接受门）值得保留：两臂共享候选池、生成器锁定、cycle-0 信号验证，已经是同类 NAD 研究中少见的可证伪设计。但有四处预注册参数应在锁定前修正，且每处修正都可检验、成本近零。

（1）阈值自相矛盾：hypothesis 写“95% CI 排除 1.00”，method/evaluation 写“下界 > 1.20”。建议锁定双层终点——主终点为优效性（单侧 95% CI 下界 > 1.00），实用性终点为 > 1.10，把 1.20 降为探索性标注。理由：两臂共享同一池、同一生成器，唯一差异是 F 门；若 τ 取 F 的 90 分位自举上界，该门每周期仅淘汰约 10% 候选，这种选择压力与“中位数提升 20%”在数量上不自洽。

（2）τ 过松：改为预注册三档 τ ∈ {p50, p75, p90}，主分析用 p75，另两档作敏感性分析。这是纯离线重打门（同一批 export），零额外算力，且直接缓解“次级层回退过频、主层增广不足 3 次”的证伪风险。

（3）cycle-0 把关功效不足：n=12 时即使真值 ρ=−0.5，单侧 α=0.05 的功效仅约 50%；若真值恰为 −0.25，功效低于 20%。建议 cycle-0 生成 K=24（1 epoch CIFAR-10、8 路并行，增量 < 1 GPU-day），go/no-go 改为“ρ 点估计 ≤ −0.25 且自举 95% 上界 ≤ 0”，避免小样本噪声直接终止全实验。

（4）holdout 可免费放大：512 图 × 24 模型 × 双精度约 2.5 万次前向，远低于预留的 2 GPU-day；提到 2048 图（每类 200）可使 F 中位数标准误约减半，直接缓解“F 低方差”风险，seed 42 清单与可复现性不变。

需承认的弱点：其一，±5% 延迟分箱下每臂每周期仅 ≤6 个模型，架构级自举在稀疏分箱内会退化，应补一个预注册的协变量调整模型（post-INT8 top-1 ~ arm + log latency + cycle 随机效应）作为共同主分析，而非替换自举；其二，F 只探测推理期量化敏感性，无法覆盖训练期量化交互，这应写入结论边界；其三，单设备、单种子、CIFAR-10 单数据集，外推性有限，结论应限定为“在该协议下 F 门是否提供可用信号”，而不是普遍性主张。
evidence: 提案自述的失效模式量级足够大（GPU 67.6% 对 INT8 约 18%），说明门控信号确有价值；但该失效呈双峰（崩溃/不崩溃），中位数比值终点因此高度依赖崩溃发生率，支持把硬阈值从 1.20 降为分层的 1.00/1.10。
Spearman 功效：Fisher z 下检验量为 atanh|ρ|·√(n−3)。n=12、真值 ρ=−0.5 时为 1.65，单侧 α=0.05 功效约 50%；n=24 时为 2.52，功效约 80%。故 cycle-0 应取 K=24 而非 16。
反事实推理成本被高估：2048 图 × 24 模型 × FP32/INT8 双路约 10 万次前向，在小型 CIFAR CNN 上属分钟级 GPU 负载（INT8 TFLite 路径为 CPU 端但仍远低于 2 GPU-day 预算），因此扩大 holdout 不挤占算力预算。
主推断的样本结构：每臂每周期 ≤6 个可测模型、5 个周期共 ≤30 个，落入 ±5% 延迟分箱后单箱常仅 1–2 个架构，架构级重采样将产生退化重样本，需以协变量调整分析共同承担主终点。

turns.claim: 核心因果链尚未成立。F=median(|margin_FP32−margin_INT8|)只是输出扰动，不是“架构选择导致量化崩溃”的反事实效应；它会被FP32准确率、置信度尺度和校准共同混杂。验证F与INT8准确率负相关也不够，正确目标应是量化损失（FP32−INT8 top-1），并控制FP32性能与延迟。其次，“共享候选池”与两臂分别QLoRA更新存在逻辑冲突：下一周期若从某一适配器生成，另一臂不再具有同等提案分布；若始终从锁定基础生成器采样，则微调没有影响候选搜索，无法检验生成器是否被门控改进。第三，同一512图集被用于设τ、逐周期门控、信号验证及可能的准确率评估，属于自适应重复使用，五轮后会选择性过拟合，bootstrap不能修复数据泄漏。第四，≤6模型/臂/周期再按±5%延迟分箱，配对对象、空箱处理和中位数比值均可能不唯一；五个周期也不是五个独立重复，因为适配器和historical best路径依赖。把成功阈值降到1.00或加入混合模型不能解决这些识别问题，反而会弱化原先“≥20%”假设。最决定性的测试是：预留完全不可见的终评集；cycle-0比较F对量化损失的增量预测（相对仅FP32准确率、延迟和参数量的基线，交叉验证ΔR²/AUC）；明确采用两臂各自生成候选并用固定随机提示配对，或固定共享池但只检验选择器而不声称改进生成器；最后在预先定义的延迟目标点上训练并测量所有入选模型，以随机种子为重复单位。若F无增量预测力、独立终评收益消失，或仅靠淘汰低FP32模型获益，则机制与新颖性主张均不成立。
evidence: F取绝对margin变化会把有益与有害变化合并；其与INT8准确率的相关性不能区分量化脆弱性、基础模型质量和校准差异。
两套持续分化的QLoRA适配器无法同时生成“同一个下一周期共享池”；固定基础生成器又使循环微调不参与搜索。
同一512样本经τ估计和约80个候选的多轮筛选会形成自适应验证集过拟合；架构级重采样只估计抽样波动，不提供新图像。
每箱1–2个架构时bootstrap分布近乎离散，且周期因共享训练历史而相关；有效独立样本量远小于名义架构数。

turns.claim:
接受三点关键批评，给出零/低成本且可预注册的修正，机制主张本身保留。

（1）指标去混杂。F 只是输出扰动这一点成立。修正：目标量改为量化损失 L = top1_FP32 − top1_INT8（并保留崩溃标签 C = 1[L > 20pt]）；cycle-0 的 go/no-go 不再用 ρ(F, INT8 top1)，改为嵌套交叉验证下 F 相对基线特征（FP32 top1、延迟、参数量、深度）的增量预测力：ΔAUC(C) ≥ 0.05 且置换检验 p < 0.05，辅以控制 FP32 top1 与 log 延迟后的偏 Spearman ≤ −0.25。同时把 F 按置信度尺度归一（F̃ = median(|Δ|)/median(margin_FP32)）并拆分有符号分量，剥离校准与基础质量混杂。这些全部是同一批 export 的离线再分析，算力增量为零。

（2）数据复用。同一 512 图集既定 τ 又逐周期筛选又评估，确属自适应过拟合。修正：按 seed 42 把 CIFAR-10 测试集划为三份互斥清单——A(512) 仅算 F 与 τ；B(512) 仅用于 cycle-0 信号验证；C(2000，封存，cycle-5 结束时一次性解封) 承担主终点 post-INT8 top-1。门控集与终评集不相交，主终点不再被多轮筛选污染。

（3）两臂逻辑冲突。放弃“全程共享池”。cycle-0 用共享池建基线；cycle 1–5 改为配对提示生成：固定 24 个提示种子与解码温度，两臂各自从自己的适配器上以相同种子集生成候选，配对单位=提示种子。这样检验的确实是生成器是否被门控改进，且保持严格配对。

（4）推断。主分析改为混合模型 post-INT8 top1 ~ arm + log latency + (1|cycle) + (1|prompt seed)，延迟作协变量而非稀疏分箱，自举比值降为次要；阈值锁定优效性（比值下界 > 1.00），1.10 为实用性门槛，撤回 1.20。

需承认的边界：F 只探测推理期量化敏感性，不覆盖训练期量化交互；单设备、单数据集，结论限定为“在该协议下 F 是否提供可用且非冗余的门控信号”。若 cycle-0 增量预测力为零，或收益在按 FP32 top1 匹配后消失（即只是淘汰了弱模型），则机制主张不成立，按预注册出负结果报告。
evidence: 增量预测检验可直接证伪且成本为零：cycle-0 的 n≥24 个导出已记录 FP32 top1、延迟、参数量、深度，ΔAUC/ΔR² 与置换检验均为离线计算；若 F 相对该基线无增量，实验在第一周期即被证伪。
封存终评集在预算内：C 集 2000 图 × ≤12 个终评模型 × FP32/INT8 双路约 5 万次前向，远低于预留的 2 GPU-day；单次解封使主终点完全脱离 τ 标定与逐周期筛选。
配对提示生成恢复了对照与样本量：相同提示种子与温度下两臂唯一差异是适配器，配对单位 n = 24×5 = 120，优于原设计每臂每周期 ≤6 模型落入 ±5% 分箱后单箱 1–2 个架构的退化重采样；增量生成成本每周期 < 0.2 GPU-day。
效应量口径自洽：提案自述失效呈双峰（GPU 67.6% 对 INT8 约 18%），中位数比值由崩溃率主导，故并列预注册崩溃率差（主）与匹配延迟下的中位数差，比单一 ≥20% 阈值更可检验、也更贴合机制假设。

turns.claim:
修订解决了明显的数据泄漏与“共享池”矛盾，但仍不能支持因果结论。最大问题是伪重复：每臂只有一条持续更新的QLoRA轨迹，24个提示种子只是同一适配器的相关输出，不是24次独立处理分配；加入prompt随机效应不能把臂级n=1变成n=120。两臂差异也同时包含门控、接受数量、训练语料规模及“结构化脆弱度理由”，因此即使终评获益，也无法归因于F门。应设置等接受率、等增广量对照，并把理由文本作为独立消融。

cycle-0的n≈24不足以可靠估计含多个基线特征的嵌套CV ΔAUC；同一小样本同时选择归一化、有符号分量、阈值和停止规则，会产生高方差与研究者自由度。F̃在FP32中位margin接近零或跨架构校准尺度不同时也可能失稳。更关键的是，声称n=120与“封存C仅评估≤12个终评模型”冲突：真正的主终点样本仍很小，5个路径依赖cycle也不足以稳定估计随机效应。

新颖性应降为“量化敏感度代理用于生成式NAS门控”的工程组合；反事实措辞仍过强，因为没有干预具体深度、激活或跳连并保持其他因素不变。决定性实验是至少5个独立生成器初始化/数据顺序重复完整双臂轨迹；每次随机分配等数量候选至F门、随机门和由FP32/延迟预测器驱动的门，统一增广量且隐藏理由；在封存集测量所有最终候选。只有F门跨轨迹稳定优于强基线，且优势在等接受率、等FP32质量及理由消融后保留，才支持非冗余机制。
evidence: 实验处理施加在适配器轨迹层，而非提示层；每臂单轨迹使臂效应与初始化、训练噪声和路径历史完全混杂。
n=24下对多特征基线做嵌套交叉验证，ΔAUC呈离散且高方差；p<0.05与ΔAUC≥0.05并不能保证可复现的门控信号。
若封存C只测≤12个模型，则提示级n=120不能用于主终点；5个cycle也难以支撑cycle随机效应方差估计。
F比较的是自然形成的不同架构输出，未执行结构变量干预，因此最多是预测性敏感度指标，而非架构特征的反事实因果审计。

turns.claim:
接受三项核心批评，主张相应降级，但机制的可检验内核保留。

（1）措辞与新颖性降级。撤回“反事实因果审计”，改称“量化敏感度门控代理”F；新颖性自评由4降为3。同时补一个真正的结构干预消融：从cycle-0池取12个基架构，各施3类单因子编辑（激活ReLU↔H-swish、宽度×0.75、跳连开/关），其余固定，测ΔL=Δ(top1_FP32−top1_INT8)与ΔF。若F不随结构变量单调响应，则“结构选择驱动脆弱性”作废——这是唯一能回应“未做干预”的证据，约36次1-epoch训练、≈3 GPU-day。

（2）伪重复成立。臂级n=1，提示种子不是独立处理分配。把终点分两层：主终点（确证性）降为选择器主张——同一共享池上离线比较四种门（F门、仅S门、随机门、FP32+延迟预测门），等接受数m=4，配对单位为候选，n≈144，检验F门选出的架构在封存集post-INT8 top-1更高；生成器主张（门控是否改进生成器）降为探索性，R=3初始化×2臂×3周期，只报效应量与区间，不做α=0.05断言。

（3）去混杂。两臂每周期接受数固定m=4，语料规模相同；主比较中删除脆弱度理由文本，两臂语料格式完全一致，理由文本改为预算允许时的独立消融臂。

（4）cycle-0功效。3种子的cycle-0合并给出n≈48，预注册单一统计量（L的ΔR²、崩溃标签C的ΔAUC，置换B=10,000）；F̃与有符号分量事先固定为敏感性分析，不在小样本上同时挑选归一化、阈值与停止规则。

预算：QLoRA≈14、候选训练≈16、干预消融≈3、推理≈2，共≈35/56 GPU-day；设备端只跑每轨迹top-4共24个终评模型加每周期8架构延迟面板，其余延迟由面板拟合预测器给出，控制在72设备小时内。

边界：结论限定为“单设备、CIFAR-10、锁定生成器下，F是否是相对FP32准确率/延迟/参数量非冗余的选择信号”，不主张跨设备与跨数据集普适，也不覆盖训练期量化交互。若F无增量预测力、结构干预无响应、或收益在等FP32质量匹配后消失，按预注册出负结果报告。
evidence: 功效算术支持诚实降级：R=3时种子级配对置换最小p=0.125，R=5才0.031；R=5×2臂×3周期的QLoRA约24 GPU-day，叠加候选训练即超出56 GPU-day上限，故生成器主张只能作估计性研究，不能虚报确证。
选择器主张样本充足且零增量算力：3种子×16候选×3周期≈144个候选均已训练并导出INT8，四种门规则纯离线重选，配对候选级n≈144，可给出窄CI并直接检验F相对FP32+延迟基线是否冗余。
结构干预可执行：12基架构×3单因子编辑=36次1-epoch CIFAR-10训练≈3 GPU-day，是唯一“保持其他因素不变”的操作，能区分F是架构响应还是基础模型质量与校准的代理。

turns.claim:
修订后的确证性主张仍存在伪重复和终点评估矛盾。四种门是在每个池中选择top-4，处理单位是“池/轨迹”，不是144个候选；候选共享生成器、训练历史和周期环境，且不同门的入选集合可能重叠，不能把候选级观测当作144次独立配对。R=3意味着可靠推断仍近乎不可能。更直接的矛盾是：若封存集仅测24个轨迹终态模型，就无法评价四种离线门在约144个候选上的选择性能；若为全部候选解封C，则必须重算设备时长，并确保C不再用于任何模型、阈值或规则调整。

cycle-0合并48个候选也不是48个独立样本，且用同批数据拟合FP32+延迟基线、估计F增量并决定继续，会高估泛化能力。强基线必须只在其他轨迹训练，再对整条留出轨迹预测；否则“非冗余”可能只是小样本过拟合。

结构消融也不足以恢复因果措辞：宽度、激活和跳连编辑会同时改变参数量、优化难度及FP32质量；单次1-epoch训练的ΔL可能主要是欠训练噪声，而且不存在普遍应当“单调响应”的方向。应采用配对训练种子、收敛训练，并检验ΔF能否预测控制ΔFP32与容量后的ΔL，而非要求任意结构编辑单调。

决定性方案是以独立轨迹/候选池为重采样与置换单位，预注册留一轨迹外推；在封存集评估每种门所有入选模型，等接受率并报告集合重叠；加入跨轨迹训练的强预测门和随机门。若F门优势不能在每条留出轨迹复现，或层级区间跨零，则只能声称一次工程筛选案例，不能声称稳定的非冗余选择信号。
evidence: top-4门比较产生的是每池一个集合结果；池内候选相关且门间集合重叠，候选级n≈144严重夸大有效样本量。
封存C仅评估24个模型与“比较四种门对144个候选的终点”不相容；未测入选模型不能贡献选择器效应。
合并三个轨迹不能消除小样本模型选择偏差；增量预测必须按整条轨迹交叉拟合和留出。
结构编辑改变容量、优化与FP32质量；无重复种子和充分训练时，ΔF—ΔL关系无法归因于结构量化敏感性。

debate.consensus:
After three rounds the two sides converge on a substantially narrowed but genuinely testable program, and the moderator approves that narrowed version rather than the original proposal.

Agreed corrections that are now binding on the final idea: (1) The causal framing is withdrawn. F is a quantization-sensitivity proxy computed over naturally occurring architectures, not a counterfactual audit of depth/width/activation/skip choices; the word 'counterfactual' is removed from the title and claims and self-assessed novelty drops from 4 to 3. (2) The original single-manifest design leaked: the same 512 images calibrated tau, filtered candidates every cycle, and scored the endpoint. The final design uses three disjoint, seed-42 manifests (A for F and tau, B for signal validation, C sealed for the endpoint), with C unsealed once and never used to tune any threshold, rule, or model. (3) The two-arm generator claim is pseudoreplicated. Treatment is applied at the adapter-trajectory level, so prompt seeds are not independent assignments and R<=3 trajectories cannot support an alpha=0.05 claim; the generator-steering claim is demoted to an exploratory, estimation-only component reported with effect sizes and intervals. (4) The confirmatory claim becomes a selector claim, but with the pool/trajectory as the unit of analysis rather than the candidate: candidates within a pool are correlated and gate-selected sets overlap, so candidate-level n=144 was an overstatement. The final design buys statistical power the honest way, by reallocating GPU-days from QLoRA to eight independent candidate pools (distinct generator seed plus RAG shard), giving an exact sign-flip permutation test with attainable p as low as 0.0039. (5) Confounds are equalized: equal acceptance count m=4 across gates, identical corpus format, and fragility rationale text moved to a separate optional ablation. (6) The baseline must be strong and cross-fitted: the competitor gate is an FP32-accuracy + latency + capacity predictor trained leave-one-pool-out, so 'non-redundant' cannot be an artifact of in-sample fitting. (7) The 20% effect threshold is withdrawn; the endpoint is superiority (paired difference > 0) with 1.10 as a pre-registered practical-relevance marker. (8) The endpoint/device-budget contradiction is resolved by evaluating every model selected by any gate on the sealed set (union capped at 8 per pool, 64 total INT8 device runs) and by predicting non-panel latencies from a per-cycle 8-architecture device panel. (9) The structural ablation survives only in corrected form: paired training seeds, sufficient training rather than one epoch, and the test is whether delta-F predicts delta-L after controlling delta-FP32 accuracy and capacity, not whether F responds monotonically to arbitrary edits.

What remains defensible after these cuts: a pre-registered, sealed-holdout, leave-one-pool-out evaluation of whether a cheap host-side quantization-sensitivity statistic adds selection value over strong FP32/latency baselines for on-device deployment of LLM-generated CNNs, plus a paired-seed structural probe of where that sensitivity comes from. Impact is real but scoped (single device, CIFAR-10, one locked generator, inference-time quantization only), novelty is moderate engineering composition rather than a new causal method, falsification is explicit and three-pronged, and the compute plan uses roughly 34 of 56 available GPU-days with device work under the 72-hour cap. The skeptic's demand for at least five independent trajectories is honored by making pools, not adapters, the replicated unit, which is affordable precisely because 1-epoch candidate training is cheap while QLoRA is not.
unresolvedQuestions: Whether eight pools drawn from a single locked generator are genuinely independent replicates or share a generator-level architectural prior that makes any F-gate advantage non-transferable to other generators; the design cannot distinguish these without a second generator, which the budget excludes.

Whether host-side TFLite INT8 reference kernels reproduce Galaxy Tab SM-P613 delegate numerics closely enough that F and S computed off-device remain valid gating inputs; the 12-model agreement check bounds but does not eliminate this risk.

Whether F retains incremental value after controlling FP32 accuracy specifically among non-collapsing models, or whether its entire signal is the ability to flag catastrophic (>20pt) collapse, which cheaper heuristics such as activation-range statistics might also catch.

Whether the exploratory generator-steering component, at R=3 trajectories and three cycles, can produce intervals narrow enough to inform a follow-up study, or whether it should be dropped entirely in favor of more pools.

Whether the structural ablation's edits (activation swap, width 0.75x, skip on/off) can be made capacity-matched enough that delta-F to delta-L attribution is interpretable, given that width scaling inevitably changes both capacity and optimization difficulty.
Whether a single 2,000-image sealed set gives sufficient per-model accuracy precision (roughly +/-1 point standard error) relative to the between-gate differences being tested.

finalIdea.title: Quantization-Sensitivity Gating for LLM-Generated Mobile CNNs: A Leave-One-Pool-Out Selector Study
finalIdea.hypothesis: For INT8-exported CIFAR-10 CNNs produced by a locked LLM generator (NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag), the paired margin-shift statistic F = median(|margin_FP32 - margin_INT8|) computed on a fixed 512-image gating manifest (set A, seed 42) carries information about quantization loss L = top1_FP32 - top1_INT8 that is not redundant with FP32 accuracy, measured latency, parameter count, and depth. Two pre-registered predictions follow. (1) Signal: under leave-one-pool-out cross-fitting, adding F to a baseline predictor of the collapse label C = 1[L > 20 points] yields delta-AUC >= 0.05 with sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 (B = 10,000), and adds delta-R^2 > 0 for continuous L. (2) Selection: an equal-acceptance gate (m = 4 accepted per pool) that requires S = quant_top1 / min_median_latency >= 0.99 x pool best AND F <= tau selects architectures whose device-measured post-INT8 top-1 on a sealed 2,000-image manifest (set C) exceeds that of the strongest baseline gate (S plus a leave-one-pool-out FP32+latency+capacity predictor) in at least 6 of 8 independent candidate pools, with one-sided exact sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 on per-pool paired mean differences; the unit of analysis is the pool, not the candidate. The pre-registered practical-relevance marker is a 1.10 ratio, but the confirmatory threshold is simple superiority (paired difference > 0). The hypothesis is falsified if any of the following holds: (a) the cross-fitted incremental-signal test fails; (b) the per-pool paired permutation test on sealed-set accuracy fails, or the F-gate advantage disappears once selected sets are matched on FP32 accuracy; (c) in the paired-seed structural ablation, delta-F fails to predict delta-L after controlling delta-FP32 accuracy and parameter count (one-sided p >= 0.05). No causal claim about architectural primitives is made; F is a predictive sensitivity proxy.
finalIdea.motivation: MobileDeploymentFinetuner runs show GPU top-1 rising to 67.6% while INT8 mobile accuracy collapses to about 18%, so workstation proxies are insufficient for neural architecture design. Generative NAS pipelines currently accept candidates on deployment ratios alone and have no cheap pre-deployment indicator of which candidates will collapse under post-training quantization. A host-side paired FP32/INT8 margin-shift statistic costs almost nothing once a model is exported, so the practically decisive question is not whether it is causally interpretable but whether it is non-redundant with the free signals a practitioner already has (FP32 accuracy, latency, capacity). Earlier framings of this study overclaimed on three fronts - causal auditing, arm-level generator improvement, and candidate-level sample size - each of which is either untestable at this budget or statistically invalid. This version keeps only the claim that the budget can actually adjudicate: whether F is a non-redundant selection signal, replicated across independent candidate pools and evaluated on a sealed holdout, plus a paired-seed structural probe of its origin.
method: Manifests (seed 42, CIFAR-10 test set, three disjoint splits, serialized with image indices and labels): set A = 512 stratified images used only to compute F and calibrate tau; set B = 512 stratified images used only for cross-fitted signal validation; set C = 2,000 stratified images, cryptographically sealed (hash committed at pre-registration) and unsealed exactly once for the primary endpoint. No model, threshold, or rule may be tuned on C.

Pools as replicates: generate 8 independent candidate pools from the locked NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag generator, each with a distinct generation seed and disjoint RAG shard, 16 candidates per pool (128 candidates total). Pools are the unit of resampling, permutation, and cross-fitting throughout.

Candidate pipeline: train each candidate 1 epoch on CIFAR-10 (8-way parallel on H100), export INT8 TFLite with a fixed calibration recipe, record export success, FP32 top-1, INT8 top-1 on A and B, parameter count, depth, and per-layer activation-range diagnostics. Compute F = median(|margin_FP32 - margin_INT8|) and U = IQR(|.|) on A; record the confidence-normalized variant F~ = F / median(margin_FP32) as a pre-specified sensitivity analysis only.

Latency: per pool, benchmark an 8-architecture device panel on Samsung Galaxy Tab SM-P613 (Android 14, CPU + GPU delegates) and fit a per-pool latency predictor over capacity/topology features; predicted latency is used for S and for latency control, with panel residuals reported.

Numerics validation: for 12 randomly chosen exports, compare host-side TFLite INT8 reference-kernel top-1 against on-device delegate top-1 on set B; require |delta top-1| <= 1 point, otherwise all F/S computation moves on-device and the pool count is reduced to stay within the device cap.
tau calibration: computed on set A only, as the bootstrap 95% upper bound (B = 10,000) of the 90th percentile of F, refit leave-one-pool-out so that no pool contributes to its own threshold.

Signal test (confirmatory component 1): baseline model for collapse label C = 1[L > 20 points] and for continuous L uses FP32 top-1, log latency, parameter count, depth; the augmented model adds F. Both are fit leave-one-pool-out and evaluated on the held-out pool's set-B measurements. Report delta-AUC, delta-R^2, and pool-level sign-flip permutation p (B = 10,000).

Selector test (confirmatory component 2): within each pool, apply four gates offline to the same 16 candidates with equal acceptance m = 4 - (i) S-only, (ii) S + F <= tau, (iii) random among valid exports, (iv) S + cross-fitted FP32/latency/capacity predictor. Record pairwise set overlap (Jaccard) per pool. Take the union of selected models (cap 8 unique per pool, 64 total) and measure post-INT8 top-1 for every one of them on sealed set C on-device. Primary statistic: per-pool paired mean difference (gate ii minus gate iv) with one-sided exact sign-flip permutation over 8 pools; secondary comparisons against gates i and iii; pre-specified re-analysis matching selected sets on FP32 accuracy to test whether any advantage is merely elimination of weak models.

Structural ablation (mechanism probe, not causal claim): 12 base architectures sampled across pools, each given three single-factor edits (ReLU vs H-swish, width x0.75, skip on/off) holding all else fixed, trained to a fixed 20-epoch schedule with 2 paired seeds (12 x 3 x 2 = 72 runs plus paired baselines). Test whether delta-F predicts delta-L in a mixed model with base architecture as random effect, controlling delta-FP32 accuracy and parameter count. Monotonic response to edits is not required or tested.

Exploratory generator component (estimation only, no alpha claim): 3 generator seeds x 2 arms (F-gate corpus vs S-only corpus) x 3 cycles of QLoRA fine-tuning on gate-accepted architectures, with equal acceptance counts and identical corpus format in both arms (fragility rationale text excluded from the main comparison and run as a separate ablation only if budget remains). Report per-trajectory effect sizes and intervals; explicitly state that R = 3 gives minimum seed-level permutation p = 0.125 and cannot support a confirmatory conclusion.

Compute plan on 8xH100 80GB for 7 days: about 13 GPU-days candidate training and export (128 candidates, 8-way parallel), about 4 GPU-days structural ablation (72 runs, 20 epochs), about 2 GPU-days paired FP32/INT8 host inference, about 10 GPU-days exploratory QLoRA, about 5 GPU-days buffer, total about 34 of 56 GPU-days. Device budget: 8 pools x 8-architecture latency panels plus 64 sealed-set INT8 accuracy runs (2,000 images each) plus numerics validation, estimated 35-45 device-hours against a 72-hour cap, via scripted overnight USB automation.

Pre-registration and stopping: manifests, tau rule, gate definitions, baseline feature list, permutation procedure, effect thresholds, and the C-unsealing date are committed before any candidate is generated. If the signal test fails, the selector test is still run and reported, but the study is reported as negative for non-redundancy.
evaluation: Confirmatory endpoint 1 (signal): leave-one-pool-out delta-AUC for collapse label C >= 0.05 with sign-flip permutation p < 0.05, and delta-R^2 > 0 for continuous L, when F is added to the FP32/latency/capacity baseline.

Confirmatory endpoint 2 (selection): per-pool paired mean difference in sealed-set post-INT8 top-1 between the F-gate and the strongest baseline gate, positive in at least 6 of 8 pools with one-sided exact sign-flip permutation p < 0.05; reported alongside the 1.10 practical-relevance ratio marker and the FP32-matched re-analysis.

Falsification tests: (1) signal test fails; (2) selector permutation test fails or the advantage vanishes under FP32-accuracy matching; (3) structural ablation shows no delta-F to delta-L relation after controlling delta-FP32 accuracy and capacity.
Mechanism probe: mixed-model coefficient and interval for delta-F predicting delta-L across paired-seed structural edits, with per-edit-type breakdown and explicit reporting of capacity confounding.

Design integrity metrics: gate set overlap (Jaccard) per pool, equal-acceptance verification, export and on-device success rate per pool (target >= 95%), host-vs-device INT8 numerics agreement, latency predictor residuals against the device panel, and confirmation that set C was accessed exactly once.

Exploratory generator readout: per-trajectory change in accepted-architecture sealed-set accuracy across cycles, reported as effect sizes with intervals and an explicit power statement (minimum attainable seed-level p = 0.125 at R = 3); no significance claims.

Descriptive diagnostics: distributions of F, U, and F~ per pool; Spearman correlation between GPU FP32 accuracy and INT8 accuracy restricted to models with INT8 top-1 > 10%; frequency and characteristics of collapse episodes.
finalIdea.expectedContribution: A pre-registered, sealed-holdout, replicate-level evaluation of whether a cheap host-side quantization-sensitivity statistic is a non-redundant selection signal for LLM-generated mobile CNNs, distinguishing it from the free baselines (FP32 accuracy, latency, capacity) that practitioners already use. The study contributes a reusable three-manifest artifact and gating protocol, a leave-one-pool-out evaluation template that treats candidate pools rather than individual candidates as replicates, an equal-acceptance four-gate comparison that isolates the gate from acceptance-rate and corpus-size confounds, and a paired-seed structural probe that bounds how much of F reflects architectural sensitivity versus base model quality and calibration. A negative result is equally informative: it would show that inference-time margin-shift probes at 512-image scale add nothing beyond FP32/latency baselines, redirecting effort toward quantization-aware training signals or larger probe sets.
finalIdea.impactAssessment: Moderate-to-high practical relevance, tightly scoped. On-device AutoML pipelines currently discover quantization collapse only after export and device benchmarking; a validated host-side gate would cut that cost substantially and directly targets the documented 67.6% GPU to 18% INT8 failure mode. The scope limits are explicit: one device, one dataset, one locked generator, post-training quantization only, so the result is a well-characterized existence claim about a signal rather than a general method. The negative branch retains value because it rules out a cheap fix that many pipelines would otherwise adopt on intuition.
finalIdea.noveltyAssessment: Moderate (self-assessed 3, downgraded from 4 during the debate). Quantization-sensitivity statistics and deployment-aware NAS both exist; the contribution is their composition as an equal-acceptance gate for a generative architecture pipeline, together with the methodological rigor of disjoint manifests, a sealed endpoint set, pool-level replication, cross-fitted strong baselines, and a paired-seed structural probe. The originally claimed counterfactual causal audit of architectural primitives is withdrawn: the design observes naturally occurring architectures and, in the ablation, edits that necessarily perturb capacity and optimization alongside the targeted factor.
finalIdea.resourceAssessment: Comfortably inside the 8xH100 x 7-day ceiling (56 GPU-days) at roughly 34 GPU-days: about 13 for 128 candidates at 1 epoch, about 4 for the 72-run paired-seed structural ablation, about 2 for paired FP32/INT8 host inference, about 10 for the exploratory QLoRA component, about 5 buffer. The key budget decision is reallocating GPU-days away from expensive adapter trajectories toward cheap independent candidate pools, which is what makes pool-level replication (n = 8, minimum permutation p = 0.0039) affordable. Device work is estimated at 35-45 hours against a 72-hour cap: 8 latency panels of 8 architectures, 64 sealed-set INT8 accuracy runs over 2,000 images, and 12 numerics-validation runs. If the numerics check fails and all quantized evaluation must move on-device, the pool count drops from 8 to 6 (minimum permutation p = 0.0156, still usable) to stay within the cap. CIFAR-100 is out of scope.
finalIdea.trainingResources: About 34 of 56 available GPU-days on 8xH100 80GB. No large-scale pretraining; the generator is locked to NNGPT-UniqueArch-Rag and only QLoRA adapters are trained, and only for the exploratory component. Candidate CNNs are small CIFAR-10 models trained 1 epoch (selector study) or 20 epochs (structural ablation). Device resources: one Samsung Galaxy Tab SM-P613 (Android 14, CPU and GPU delegates) under scripted overnight USB automation, capped at 72 device-hours.
risks: F may be predictive only for catastrophic collapse and useless for ranking non-collapsing models, in which case the selector advantage will be driven entirely by a small number of pools containing collapsed candidates and will be unstable across pools.

With 8 pools the exact sign-flip permutation floor is p = 0.0039, but power against modest effects is still limited; a real but small F-gate advantage could go undetected, and the study cannot distinguish 'no signal' from 'small signal'.
Host-side TFLite INT8 numerics may diverge from the device delegate, invalidating off-device F and S computation and forcing a reduction to 6 pools with correspondingly weaker inference.

Gate-selected sets will partially overlap across the four gates, compressing between-gate differences and biasing the comparison toward the null; overlap is reported but cannot be eliminated at m = 4 out of 16.

Structural edits change capacity, optimization difficulty, and FP32 quality simultaneously, so even a positive delta-F to delta-L relation supports only a predictive, not causal, reading of architectural sensitivity.
All pools come from one locked generator, so an F-gate advantage may reflect that generator's architectural prior rather than a transferable property of quantization sensitivity.

The exploratory generator component at R = 3 cannot resolve whether gating actually steers the generator; it risks being over-interpreted by readers despite the explicit estimation-only framing, and may be better dropped in favor of additional pools.

Single-device, single-dataset, post-training-quantization-only scope leaves training-time quantization interaction entirely unaddressed, so residual GPU-to-INT8 decoupling may persist even under a successful gate.
Sealed set C at 2,000 images gives roughly +/-1 point per-model precision, which may be coarse relative to the between-gate differences of interest.
